You're in luck! The d
bluejetty:00066214:ios.description:
The idea of the game is simple: You are building your dream skyscraper, developing businesses with it, earning profit, and competing with other players. Sounds great, but what if you think one skyscraper isn't enough?
You're in luck! The developers have got you covered—more ambitious players can create their own cities and invite other players to live there and make theirs the greatest city ever.
Want to know whose city is the snazziest? Check the best city rating. If you rank high enough, that will prove to everyone that you've got real business acumen and your city is the cream of the crop.
Game features:
• PLAY FOR FREE
• BUILD the highest skyscraper to be the crown jewel of your city and earn you millions
• ORGANIZE your enterprise however you like on every level of the skyscraper. Choose for yourself: Do you want coffee shops, beauty salons, maybe a barber shop or a tailor?
• MANAGE your staff. Hire and fire workers, and find everyone's dream jobs, buy goods, and collect the proceeds
• CREATE your very own city, become its mayor, and invite your friends to live in it and build a business empire together
• ASSEMBLE a complete collection of stars and celebrities to visit your skyscraper and give you a real leg up on other businesses
• EXPLORE a labyrinth in search of untold treasure
• INTERACT using the chat, and make new friends
Gameplay:
The game sucks you in from the very first minute. When you enter the game, you are met by a small building of several floors with a few residents. They are dying to work, but pay close attention to them—each one has different preferences.
Keep an eye on the elevator. Your skyscraper will occasionally be visited by clients with a VIP status, and their visits will make your wallet a bit thicker! There is also an entire floor of the skyscraper just for celebrities. The more of them who come there, the better your city's reputation will be.
Earn your first profits and begin building new levels and opening stores, bars, salons, and shops.
If your skyscraper reaches 10 levels, and you still want to do more—welcome to the city. You can ask to join someone else's or you can make your own and be its mayor. Invite other players to your city and work together to improve it.
To make construction and development even more interesting, the game includes a general rating system. Do you have the best skyscraper out there? Then you win the gold medal!
Is life in your city so amazing that the population is huge and your coffers are overflowing? You're on top of the world, and the other players will know all about it!
No time to come and collect your profit? Overmobile has you taken care of; hire a personal manager who can look after things in your absence.
Bonuses:
The game has two kinds of daily tasks: special and city. When you complete them, you get cool bonuses that will help your business grow.
Like keys to the labyrinth. If you open all 10 doors of the labyrinth and never hit a dead end, you'll get a spectacular reward: a chest full of gamer's treasure—gold coins, bucks, and other cool stuff you can use to expand your business.
The developers frequently surprise the players with deals and events that make in-game coins and skyscraper and city upgrades a real bargain.
Want to consult with more experienced entrepreneurs? Join the chat right in the game and talk with the whole game world.
Pocket Tower will whisk you away from the drudgery of everyday life and immerse you in a thrilling world of business and economics, with stunning graphics, realistic interiors, and with a city and characters waiting just for you.
Your childhood dreams come true! Build your own skyscraper and show the world that you are the best of the best!

bluejetty:00090092:ios.name: Rabbit Mobility
bluejetty:00090092:ios.summary:
Rabbit is the first micro-mobility company in Egypt and North Africa. Flag-shipped with our unique electric scooters and electric powered bikes, we aim to change the way people commute and we’re still expanding to much more.
No more getti
bluejetty:00090092:ios.description:
Rabbit is the first micro-mobility company in Egypt and North Africa. Flag-shipped with our unique electric scooters and electric powered bikes, we aim to change the way people commute and we’re still expanding to much more.
No more getting stuck in traffic or driving around to find a parking spot, unlock a Rabbit and hop away.
HOW TO START YOUR RIDE:
Download the app, sign up, add your preferred payment method and get ready to feel the freedom!
- Find a nearby Rabbit vehicle on the map.
- Scan the QR code or enter the scooter ID to unlock the vehicle.
- Push with your foot to get going, use the throttle button to accelerate
- Enjoy the ride.
HOW TO END YOUR RIDE:
- Find a safe area within any of the green zones to park the vehicle, flick the kickstand back down.
- If the vehicle has a lock attached to it, find a bike rack or a post and tie the lock around it, then close down the lock.
- Open the Rabbit app and tap 'End Ride'.
- Enjoy your day!
NEED TO KEEP THE VEHICLE FOR A LITTLE LONGER?
- You can rent your personal vehicle (2 days minimum), and we'll deliver it to your door!
- Open the Rabbit app, select 'Day Rentals'.
- Select your personal vehicle type; an e-scooter or an e-bike.
- Select your preferred plan, type in your address and select the delivery date.
- Once we confirm your order, we'll deliver the vehicle to you.
- Enjoy your own Rabbit!
NEED HELP?
Open the Rabbit app and tap on 'Help' either from the navigation menu or on the map.
AVAILABILITY.
- Unlock & Go vehicles are currently available in select locations.
- Day Rentals vehicles are currently available in Cairo, Giza and more.
Whether you’re going from your house to the beach or to the market, Rabbit is ideal for short trips. It’s a fun way of exploring new destinations, and it also helps you build a cleaner future.

bluejetty:00183846:ios.name: MoneyStats - Budget Planner
bluejetty:00183846:ios.summary:
Your budget, your finances, your plan! Control your income and expenses and save cash!
With MoneyStats you have full control of your personal finances, your budget and your income and expenses! Create financial overviews, evaluate, track a
bluejetty:00183846:ios.description:
Your budget, your finances, your plan! Control your income and expenses and save cash!
With MoneyStats you have full control of your personal finances, your budget and your income and expenses! Create financial overviews, evaluate, track and manage your money! Keep an eye on your budget, manage your money and various bank accounts, categorize expenditures, discover new ways to save money, load current and historical exchange rates, manage your finances on different devices, automatically categorize your transactions, create recurring income and expenses, import from external data sources such as CSV-files and analyze your current and future finances! MoneyStats is more than just a money app!
Features:
- Manage transactions and bank accounts
- Bank connection for your payment accounts (only in selected countries)
- Create budgets and track your expenses and income
- Categorize your transactions
- Your finances in charts and graphs
- Financial forecasts & reviews
- Manage different currencies
- Get current and historical exchange rates
- Set savings goals for your small and big investments
- Discover ways to save money
- Create account statements and other useful reports
- Synchronization for all your devices
- Share your data with family and friends
- Easy-to-use, intuitive navigation, tags for your categories and more
- Import and export data sources, such as CSV, QIF and TXT files
- Many cool designs (incl. Dark Mode for all iOS 13 devices)
- Your financial data is well-secured and your privacy is paramount
Here are some sample questions you will be able to answer with MoneyStats:
- How much income was generated last month?
- What are my monthly gas costs?
- What is my annual profit?
- When will I be able to buy my own home?
- How much money can I spend on clothes this month?
- What is the current exchange rate of a specific currency?
- What was my highest electricity bill?
- In which quarter did I make the biggest profit?
- What percentage do I spend on food?
- What is my average insurance cost?
Data protection:
Your privacy is very important to me! I do not ask you for any personal information. And you don't need to register in order to use this app. By default, your data is only stored on your devices, giving you complete control of all your sensitive information. For additional protection, you can setup access locks which prevents unauthorized users from accessing your financial data. You can find further details in my privacy policy: https://ttdeveloped.com/en/apps-2/moneystats/privacy-policy/ and the terms of use here: https://ttdeveloped.com/en/apps-2/moneystats/terms-of-use/.
Download and try for free:
All essential functions of this app are free! With MoneyStats Pro you can create unlimited transactions without ads and unlock many more features for a one-time fee! Other in-app purchases such as data synchronization, exchange rates or reports can be purchased additionally. As an optional subscription model, we now also offer bank connection for your payment accounts (only available in selected countries). This feature allows you to connect your bank directly to the app and automatically import your latest transactions. 
Support:
I've tried to make MoneyStats as intuitive and helpful as possible and I continue to make improvements and add new features. I look forward to all feedback, suggestions and questions and I will respond to your email as soon as possible. With your help, MoneyStats will be even more awesome!

bluejetty:00062905:ios.description:
- You don't need to convert video files to MP4 to play them in your mobile device. nPlayer enable you to play all kinds of video formats and codecs without file converting efforts.
- You don't need to store video files in your device with limited storage space. nPlayer's powerful and various network technologies will help you to stream them from remote devices. 
- With your finger tip, you can adjust playback position, move to previous and next subtitle position, adjust location and font size of subtitles, control volume and brightness.
- Experience nPlayer, thousands of users recommendations.
* This version of nPlayer contains advertisements.
* Features
- Supports iXpand Flash Drive
- Supports HDMI output
- Supports video files : MP4, MOV, MKV, AVI, WMV, ASF, FLV, OGV, RMVB, TP etc.
- Supports audio files : MP3, WAV, WMA, FLAC, APE etc.
- Supports subtitle files : SMI, SRT, SSA, IDX, SUB, LRC, SUP, MLP2 etc.
- Supports image files : JPG, PNG, BMP, GIF, TIFF etc.
- Supports playlist files : CUE, M3U, PLS
- Supports WebDAV, FTP, SFTP, HTTP, SMB/CIFS, NFS
- Supports UPnP/DLNA (supports subtitles if DLNA server provides subtitles information.)
- Supports cloud service (Box, Dropbox, OneDrive, Yandex.Disk)
- Supports in-app web browser
- Supports iTunes video/audio play (except for DRM contents)
- Supports videos and pictures in Album
- Playback speed control : 0.5x ~ 4.0x
- Resume playback
- AB repeat(specific section repetition)
- Screen lock
- Supports AV1/HEVC/H.264/MPEG4 Hardware acceleration
- Supports 3D video mode
- Screen flip horizontally, vertically. brightness and saturation control
- Aspect ratio : Default, 1:1, 3:2, 4:3, 5:3, 16:9, 1.85:1 etc 
- Supports multi-track audio
- Supports audio boost
- Supports audio sync
- Supports lyrics display
- Supports embedded subtitles
- Supports multi-track subtitles
- Supports user’s selection of subtitle files
- Supports addition of optional subtitle files while playback
- Supports subtitles font, color, shadow, outline customization
- Supports subtitles sync
- Supports external subtitle fonts
- Supports SAMI(SMI) tag
- Supports SSA/ASS with full styling, embedded subtitles
- File management : Delete, Move, Rename, Create a folder
- Playlist management : Add, Delete, Modify
- Supports recently played list
- Folder lock
- Supports Open-in
- Supports UI theme
* Gesture Features
- Tap : Menu
- Double tap : Pop-up play
- Drag horizontally : Playback position adjustment
- Drag vertically on right half of the screen : Volume control
- Drag vertically on left half of the screen : Brightness control
- Pinch on the screen : Screen size adjustment
- Drag horizontally on subtitle text : Move to previous/next subtitle text
- Drag vertically on subtitle text : Subtitle position adjustment 
- Pinch on subtitle text : Subtitle font size adjustment
- Supports finger gesture customization

- Supports HDMI output

- Supports subtitle files : SMI, SRT, SSA, IDX, SUB, LRC,  SUP, MLP2 etc.
- Supports image files : JPG, PNG, BMP, GIF, TIFF etc.
- Supports playlist files : CUE, M3U, PLS

- Supports WebDAV, FTP, SFTP, HTTP, SMB/CIFS, NFS

- Supports in-app web browser
- Supports iTunes video/audio play (except for DRM contents)
- Supports videos and pictures in Album

- Playback speed control : 0.5x ~ 4.0x
- Resume playback
- AB repeat(specific section repetition)
- Screen lock

- Supports 3D video mode
- Screen flip horizontally, vertically. brightness and saturation control

- Supports audio boost
- Supports audio sync
- Supports lyrics display

- Supports multi-track subtitles
- Supports user’s selection of subtitle files

- Supports subtitles font, color, shadow, outline customization
- Supports subtitles sync
- Supports external subtitle fonts
- Supports SAMI(SMI) tag
- Supports SSA/ASS with full styling, embedded subtitles

- Playlist management : Add, Delete, Modify
- Supports recently played list
- Folder lock
- Supports Open-in

- Supports UI theme

- Tap : Menu
- Double tap : Pop-up play
- Drag horizontally : Playback position adjustment
- Drag vertically on right half of the screen : Volume control
- Drag vertically on left half of the screen : Brightness control
- Pinch on the screen : Screen size adjustment
- Drag horizontally on subtitle text : Move to previous/next subtitle text
- Drag vertically on subtitle text : Subtitle position adjustment 
- Pinch on subtitle text : Subtitle font size adjustment
- Supports finger gesture customization

- Mastery (6–7 years): Learn 1,000 English words, and solve math within 100.

bluejetty:00061357:ios.summary: L-Card Pro is the most complete and advanced electronic business card design & management app on the market. It is loaded with cutting-edge features, including the ultimate Digital Business Card Design Suite, award-winning OCR card scanning
bluejetty:00061357:ios.description:
L-Card Pro is the most complete and advanced electronic business card design & management app on the market. It is loaded with cutting-edge features, including the ultimate Digital Business Card Design Suite, award-winning OCR card scanning, Smart E-mail Signature, Video Sharing, L-Card Analytics, L-Card Enterprise & so much more.
The recipients of your digital cards DO NOT need to have the app to save contact information.
SOME OF THE MAIN FEATURES:
* Create unlimited personal business cards using the professional Card Design Suite.
* Touch Free scanning of paper business cards.
* Read cards in 38 languages.
* Access your business card library and scan cards while your device is offline or in Airplane Mode.
* Edit your cards & INSTANTLY UPDATE THE INFORMATION IN ALL CARDS YOU HAVE
PREVIOUSLY SHARED WORLDWIDE.
* Permission based, instant L-Card exchange for quality lead generation.
* Card Radar – Instantly exchange L-Cards with an unlimited number of contacts at meetings & other business events.
* Directly Export cards to Outlook. Create CSV files and upload data into your favorite CRM.
* Share short company info & custom messages.
* Allow users to add card information to their general Contacts on their devices.
* Restore deleted cards from Trash.
* Use the L-Card QR code scanner, Text, Email or social media to share and receive cards.
* Add notes to cards and personal reminders to your calendar.
* Share your social media address links.
* Save received cards within custom groups.
* Call, Text, or Email your contacts directly from a selected card using the Quick Connect Buttons.
* Locate addresses in Maps and get driving directions with a single tap.
* Transfer Videos with Cards: Advertise your products and services by adding instant or pre-recorded videos as often as you like. A video alert system will notify your contacts whenever a new clip is received & moves your digital card to the top of the users’ library. Videos from YouTube, Vimeo and other online video streaming sites are supported.
* The Smart L-Card button email attachment enables unlimited business card exchanges by adding your L-Card to your Email signature.
* Add your digital card to website pages.
* Print selected cards or the entire card library on a sheet of paper for filing or other purposes.
* Access your business cards on All Devices from anywhere in the world using smartphone, tablet or Web App.
* Create custom L-Card QR code designs. Print the code on promotional materials for attractive and innovative business card sharing.
* Use L-Card Analytics to track the performance of your business cards & promotional videos in real time.
EXTRA FEATURES FOR TABLETS:
* The card Listing feature allows users to list cards on tablets for the business event participants to scan and collect. Great for displaying business cards at offices, trade shows & other business events.
* Add a moving headline in your corporate color to the card listing screen to advertise your brand or event.
L-Card Pro is the most user-friendly electronic business card app with a clean interface that is indispensable for every professional in today’s digital era.
Enjoy using L-Card Pro? We’d love to hear from you. Help us improve by sharing your email at support@lcardapp.com. 
Happy L-Carding!
For any queries on the application, contact us on :
Facebook: @lcardapp 
LinkedIn: L-Card
Twitter: @LCardApp

bluejetty:00124112:ios.description:
Pente is a board game that is easy to learn, difficult to master. Compete with players all over the world on a 19x19 board. There is 
- turn-based play,
- realtime (live) play,
- play against 2 different computer players,
- participate in tournaments,
- play King of the Hill and earn a crown,
- search the game database by position for the most popular or best move!
Gomoku: To win, place 5 (not more) of your stones in a straight continuous line (either horizontally, vertically or diagonally).
Pente is like Gomoku but you can win by getting more than 5 in a row.
In Pente you can capture stones by enclosing a pair of your opponent's stones. For example, if the stones are like this XOO and you place your stone so it becomes XOOX, then your opponents' stones are removed from the board, leaving X__X. You can also win at Pente by capturing 10 or more of your opponents stones. You can't play into a capture. 
Rated games have a "Tournament Rule". It restricts player 1's second move so that player 1's second move must be at least 3 intersections away from the center of the board.
Keryo-Pente is like Pente but you can also capture 3 stones in a row.
G-Pente restricts player 1's second move, like the tournament rule. It additionally prohibits playing on the 4th and 5th intersections away from the center of the board that are one the same horizontal or vertical line as player 1's first move. (These are the most common 2nd moves for white).
D-Pente: Player 1 places 2 white and 2 black stones as a first move. Then player 2 decides to play as player 2, or decides to swap seats and take over as player 1! Afterwards, play continues like regular Pente.
Poof-Pente: The main difference is that you can play into a capture! (e.g., from XO_X player plays XOOX) then the stones are "poofed" (removed from the board and counted as captures). Normal captures are still allowed and the number of captures to win remains at 10 stones. Up to 5 stones could be poofed in one move! Also note that my current implementation performs the following actions in sequence after a move:
 Check if move captured any opponents stones, if so remove stones from the board.
 Check if move creates a poof position, if so remove stones from the board.
 Check if player has a 5-in-a-row, if so the player wins.
A player could capture and be poofed in the same move and the capture count could end up as 10-10. The game keeps going until one player has an advantage (i.e., gets more captured stones or gets five-in-a-row). There are no draws.
Boat-Pente differs in the end game. Once a Pente is made (5 stones in a row), the game continues as long as the opponent is able to capture across the Pente! Capturing 5 pairs is still a win like in Pente and the tournament rule is used for rated games.
Connect6: The goal is to be the first player to get 6 pieces in a row, either vertically, horizontally or diagonally. Player one plays one stone at the center of the board. After that each player gets to place two stones on the board at a time.
DK-Pente is D-Pente with Keryo-Pente rules.
O-Pente combines Keryo, Poof, and Boat Pente
Go is also available on 3 different board sizes: 19x19, 13x13, and 9x9.
Swap2-Pente is Pente with Swap2 rules.
Swap2-Keryo is Keryo-Pente with Swap2 rules.
------
This app offers a 1 year auto-renewable subscription for $4.99 USD/year. Payment will be charged to your iTunes account, and your account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period. Auto-renewal may be turned off at any time by going to your settings in the iTunes Store after purchase. Prices may vary in countries other than the U.S. and are subject to change without notice. No cancellation of the current subscription is allowed during the active subscription period. If you don’t choose to purchase a subscription you can simply continue playing for free.
The privacy policy and TOS can be found at https://pente.org/help/helpWindow.jsp?file=privacyPolicy

bluejetty:00180854:ios.description:
Counting more than one thing at once? Counter+ puts all your counters on one screen. Tap to count, review every change in the history log, and export a report when you're done.
Counter+ is a simple, intuitive, and powerful counter app designed to help you track multiple values with ease. Whether you are managing daily habits, work tasks, classroom activities, event attendance, inventory, workouts, scores, or personal goals, Counter+ gives you a clean and reliable way to keep everything organized.
Key Features:
- Multiple Counter Support: Manage several counters at the same time, perfect for tracking people, scores, tasks, progress, activities, or item quantities.
- Vibrant Color Themes: Choose from a variety of color themes to make your counters easier to recognize and more enjoyable to use.
- Customizable Counters: Set unique names, values, and increments for each counter to match your exact tracking needs.
- Comprehensive History Log: Keep a clear record of your counting activity, making it easy to review previous changes and monitor progress over time.
- Multi-Counter View: View all your counters on a single page for quick comparison, easier monitoring, and faster decision-making.
- Exportable Reports: Generate and share reports of your counter values and history, ideal for work, study, teaching, events, and personal records.
- iPhone and iPad Support: Enjoy a redesigned interface with support for larger screens, making it more comfortable to view and manage multiple counters.
- Left-Handed Mode: Built for lefties, too.
- Interactive Feedback: Every tap feels like a real clicker.
- Flexible Reset Options: Reset individual counters or all counters at once whenever you need a fresh start.
- Clean and Focused Experience: Designed to be easy to use from the moment you open it, without unnecessary complexity.
Whether you are tracking habits, recording classroom activities, counting attendance, managing inventory, logging workouts, or setting personal goals, Counter+ is your reliable companion for clear and organized counting. Download Counter+ today and start counting with confidence!

bluejetty:00130928:ios.description:
FlashPath Canada driving test 2026 app ensures you pass your official driving knowledge test on the first try. Our province-specific study material for car, commercial, and motorcycle is built directly from official driving handbooks, making your 2026 test prep highly accurate. Master your exam with real past questions cross-referenced to manual pages for total confidence.
◆ Province-Specific Lessons & Questions: Content is derived from the official driver’s manuals for all Canadian provinces and territories.
◆ Manual Cross-Referencing: Each practice question includes a direct reference to the relevant section of your province’s driving handbook for verification.
◆ Real Exam Questions: Access a database of questions that have appeared on actual BC, SGI, MTO and other provincial written tests.
◆ Untimed Mock Tests: Practice with mock exams that utilize real questions from previous knowledge tests without the pressure of a timer.
◆ Mistake Review: Track and revisit questions you answered incorrectly to focus your study time on your weakest areas.
◆ Difficult Lessons: Identify and review specific sections of the manual where you need more practice to ensure full comprehension.
◆ Bookmarking: Save specific lessons and tricky questions to your personal list for quick access during your final review.
◆ In-App Support: Submit queries and get professional answers to your specific driving and exam-related questions.
Province-Specific Content:
All content is tailored to the unique traffic laws of each province, covering everything from G1/G2 (Ontario) to Class 7/5 (Alberta & BC). We cover:
• Alberta • British Columbia • Manitoba • New Brunswick • Newfoundland and Labrador • Nova Scotia • Ontario • Prince Edward Island • Saskatchewan • Northwest Territories • Nunavut • Yukon
License Categories:
◆ Car: G1, Class 7, Class 5 knowledge test prep.
◆ Commercial: Class 1, Class A, and Air Brake endorsements.
◆ Motorcycle: Class 6 and Class M knowledge tests.

FlashPath is an independent educational tool and is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or operated by any government agency. For official legal information and the most current road regulations, please consult your province’s official driving handbook directly:
Alberta (open.alberta.ca), British Columbia (gov.bc.ca), Manitoba (apps.mpi.mb.ca), New Brunswick (gnb.ca), Newfoundland and Labrador (gov.nl.ca), Nova Scotia (novascotia.ca), Ontario (ontario.ca), Prince Edward Island (princeedwardisland.ca), Saskatchewan (sgi.sk.ca), Northwest Territories (inf.gov.nt.ca/en), Nunavut (gov.nu.ca), and Yukon (yukon.ca).
Finding the app useful? Please leave a review and let us know what you think. Have questions, problems, or feedback? Reach out to us at support@flashpath.app

bluejetty:00074359:ios.description:
- PDF Scanner for Doc, Files, JPEGs & More
Convert your iPhone and iPad into a powerful scanner and scan documents everywhere.
- Smart OCR:
Wrinkled documents? No problem. The advanced cropping and enhancement will help you produce high-quality scans. 
- Instantly Convert Documents into PDFs:
It just takes a minute to scan and generate PDFs of your scanned documents.
- Easily Convert Documents into Images:
Other than PDFs, you can also convert your scanned documents into images.
- Extract text with the advanced OCR Technology:
Once you have scanned a document, you can easily extract and copy the text.
- Scan your Handwriting:
One of the few very advanced scanners that let you scan even your handwriting and convert into PDF.
- Print Your PDF Documents:
With the built-in technology, you can easily send scanned documents to your printer and take printouts in minutes.
- Share Your PDFs Online:
It really just takes a minute to share your scanned documents and PDFs everywhere. You can share them on Facebook, Instagram, Pinterest, WhatsApp, iMessage, WeChat, and almost anywhere else. 
My PDF scanner app makes it really convenient and easy for you to scan documents on the go, convert them into various formats, and share them with your clients, friends, teachers, bosses, and family members. 
Multiple Format Conversion at Your Fingertips
Scan any document and convert it into a crisp, high-resolution PDF in seconds. Need an image instead? Convert your scans into JPEG or PNG formats instantly. Perfect for students, business professionals, or anyone needing versatile document options.
Scan Anything—Even Handwritten Notes
Not just for printed pages. Our scanner captures handwritten notes, whiteboards, blackboards, and personal notes with clarity. Convert your handwritten content into PDFs and share them just like typed documents.
Seamless Document Management
Once scanned, organize your files effortlessly. Rename, reorder, merge, or delete pages. Save your scans securely or export them to the cloud. With our app, your mobile device becomes a complete document management hub.
Print Directly from Your Device
With built-in AirPrint support, print scanned documents directly from your iPhone or iPad. Whether it’s an invoice, contract, form, or homework, hard copies are just a tap away.
Share Your PDFs Anywhere
Export your documents to the cloud or send them via email, messaging apps, or social media. Our app supports instant sharing through WhatsApp, iMessage, Instagram, Facebook, Pinterest, WeChat, and more—perfect for both professional and personal use.
Designed for Speed and Simplicity
We’ve built this app with usability in mind. Scan documents in a flash, without clutter or confusion. Whether scanning receipts, contracts, notes, or business cards, our intuitive interface helps you get the job done quickly.

bluejetty:00141809:ios.description:
Alarm! The hordes of aliens have invaded your city! Grab your guns, team up with other survivors, and get through endless waves of aliens! You have to survive by any means! 
Survive Squad is a fast-paced casual roguelike survival io game with some RPG elements. Your primary goal is to build a team and remain alive in the survival arena as long as you can! The squad alpha must stay alive!
FIGHT FOR YOUR LIFE
Zombies, vampires, and other undead creatures are in the past — there's a bigger concern. In this survival io game, you must get through the endless waves of aliens that far outnumber you! The stronger enemies await you at every stage!
Get ready to battle the deadly bosses with unique abilities. Be fast, smart & furious to defeat them all, and loot treasures together with new upgrades.
ASSEMBLE THE SQUAD
Start the game as a lonely survivor surrounded by thousands of evil creatures. Move around the city, find other warriors, and build the strongest team ever! Rifleman, mad scientist, paladin, archero, and many other heroes are ready to join your squad!
Take down as many aliens as you can to level up the team members during the game! Collect new equipment and weapons, unlock new perks, and upgrade the heroes' abilities to deal more damage to the monsters!
SURVIVAL GAME FEATURES:
- Assemble the squad with unique weapons & talents
- Build unique skill combinations while upgrading the team at every level
- Take down hordes of monsters at once & fight mighty bosses
- Explore dozens of survival arenas full of tough challenges
- Control your shooters with one finger
–––
Are you ready to meet the challenge? Stand against hordes of enemies, test your shooting and survival skills, and remain alive in the survival io game! Download and play Survive Squad for free right now!

bluejetty:00151388:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00151388:ios.description:
Why Choose RelaxWatch?
In today’s fast-paced world, stress has quietly become one of the most common health challenges. Endless tasks, constant notifications, and poor sleep gradually weaken focus, raise heart rate, and drain energy. These signals are often overlooked until the body issues stronger warnaings.
The RelaxWatch team, focused on health technology and Apple Watch integration, discovered that HRV (Heart Rate Variability) is one of the most important scientific indicators of stress and relaxation. Yet for most users, HRV data is complex and difficult to interpret.
That’s why we created RelaxWatch, a professional stress monitoring companion for Apple Watch users. Our goal is to transform complex HRV and heart rate data into clear, actionable insights—helping you manage stress, improve sleep quality, and maintain long-term health.
Core Features: 8 Key Dimensions of Stress & Health Management
1. Real-Time Dynamic Stress Monitoring
 * Continuously tracks your HRV and heart rate in the background.
 * Automatically updates and shows your current stress level, whether you are relaxed, balanced, or overloaded.
2. Rich Watch Face Widgets
 * Multiple Apple Watch complications designed for quick access.
 * A single glance at your wrist keeps you informed of your stress state.
3. Smart Alerts & Stress Warnings
 * When stress levels remain high, RelaxWatch sends intelligent notifications.
 * Encourages timely actions such as breathing, meditation, or a short break to prevent overload.
4. Deep Sleep Quality Analysis
 * Combines HRV and heart rate data during the night to analyze sleep quality.
 * Identifies possible factors behind poor rest and helps you optimize recovery.
5. Personalized Health Plans
 * Creates tailored programs based on your unique data trends.
 * Includes recommendations for stress relief, exercise, meditation, and balanced routines.
6. Comprehensive Stress Trend Reports
 * Provides daily, weekly, monthly, and yearly trend reports for long-term tracking.
 * Correlates stress, sleep, activity, and lifestyle habits, helping you understand patterns clearly.
7. User-Friendly Design
 * Clean, intuitive, and simple to navigate.
 * Ensures anyone can easily interpret HRV and stress insights without technical knowledge.
8. Bio Age
 * Combines HRV, heart rate, sleep, and activity data to give you a simple view of your current physical condition.
 * See how daily habits like stress relief, better sleep, and exercise can improve your Bio Age over time.
Continuous Support for Your Health
RelaxWatch focuses on consistent tracking and clear feedback. You’ll see how your stress, sleep, and heart rate change daily, with easy-to-read insights that guide you toward healthier routines. RelaxWatch is built to be your everyday Apple Watch partner in achieving lasting health improvements.
Subscription & Policy
For unlocking all features and content, Premium Membership offers some auto-renewable subscription options:
* Weekly Membership: $6.99 per week, automatically renewed.
* Yearly Membership: $49.99 per year, automatically renewed.
End of trial and subscription renewal:
* Payment will be charged to iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase.
* Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period.
* Account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period, and identify the cost of the renewal.
* Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user’s Account Settings after purchase.
* Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription to that publication, where applicable.
* Terms of Use: https://www.relaxwatch.ai/terms
* Privacy Policy: https://www.relaxwatch.ai/privacy

bluejetty:00027409:ios.description:
LectMate: A must-have for students. Professional recording, real-time voice-to-text transcription, and high-precision simultaneous translation; improve learning efficiency, and top students are using it.
[Application scenarios]
* Real-time translation for Zoom online classes and video conferences. No need to worry about accents from teachers or classmates, the transcription will still be accurate.
* Offline classes can also be translated, with real-time Chinese subtitles to easily understand every sentence.
* Take notes easily and export bilingual transcripts at any time to save time on reviewing and not miss any important knowledge.
* Record phone calls and no longer fear to communicate with customer service.
* Switch to conversation translation mode when going out to avoid social awkwardness and understand the other party's thoughts.
* Collect inspirations at any time and improve your oral expression ability.
[Core features]
* Audio noise reduction: Even in noisy environments or when recording distant sources, high-quality voice-to-text transcription results can be obtained.
* Intelligent transcription: The world's leading AI technology, #1 in the 2021 international automatic speech recognition challenge, provides high-precision, accurate, and fast transcription with high recognition rates.
* Affordable price: 180 minutes of free transcription time per month, and only 0.27 yuan per hour for VIP members, which is only 1/2 the price of similar services.
* Comprehensive functionality: Recording audio, taking notes, viewing translations, and exporting in multiple formats. All functions are available.
We will continue to update more useful features to help you easily tackle all learning problems and improve efficiency.
[Main features]
* Real-time transcription: Record audio and take notes in real-time with high accuracy. Automatically save text and voice records after the session.
* Keywords: Automatically extract key content and generate keyword summaries.
* Import and export: Import audio files from other applications with one click and automatically generate text notes for efficient processing of audio content.
* AI intelligent engine: Recognizes mixed Chinese and English speech, automatically distinguishes uppercase letters, adds punctuation, and corrects mistakes intelligently.
* Search and replay: Quickly search for any word or sentence in the whole recording. Replay audio at your preferred speed for efficient review.
* Multiple scenarios: Suitable for all classes, meetings, phone calls, interviews, lectures, and daily voice conversations. AI saves you time and effort.
[71 supported languages]
We stand with users from all over the world, continuously providing the most advanced services, making it easier for you to record every important moment in your daily life.
Currently supported languages include:
English, Spanish, Chinese, Arabic, German, French, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Dutch, Polish, Portuguese, Russian, Thai, Turkish, Bulgarian, Catalan, Czech, Danish, Greek, Finnish, Hebrew, Hindi, Croatian, Hungarian, Indonesian, Lithuanian, Latvian, Norwegian, Romanian, Slovak, Slovenian, Serbian, Swedish, Ukrainian, Vietnamese, Afrikaans, Amharic, Azerbaijani, Bengali, Estonian, Basque, Persian, Filipino, Galician, Gujarati, Armenian, Icelandic, Javanese, Georgian, Khmer, Kannada, Lao, Macedonian, Malayalam, Mongolian, Marathi, Malay, Burmese, Nepali, Punjabi, Sinhalese, Albanian, Sundanese, Swahili, Tamil, Telugu, Urdu, Uzbek, Cantonese, Zulu.

bluejetty:00125894:ios.description:

A crossword consists of black and white shaded squares that form a square grid. The challenge of the puzzle is to fill the white squares with letters, forming words or phrases by solving the clues that will lead you to the answers.

6 grid sizes of 5x5 (beginner), 7x7 (beginner), 9x9 (beginner), 11x11 (novice), 13x13 (novice) and 15x15 (expert) are available, so whether you've never played a crossword or you play them all the time - you can be sure that this is the crossword app for you!
Other Features:
• Display errors if you're entering incorrect words.
• Show the word if you need help
• Add 4 letters to the board
• Check out your score in the leaderboard
• Puzzle completion times are displayed upon completion.
• Auto save crossword puzzles

bluejetty:00023723:ios.description:
The world of humans has ended; the Age of Apes has begun! Monkeys are at war to launch Rockets into space in search for... bananas! Become part of the strongest Horde, fight other apes and be the first monkey to explore the galaxy!
Glorious gifts await those brave enough to battle in Age of Apes !
- Manage your outpost, build an army, become the most powerful monkey of your Horde and lead them to war in this free MMO strategy game!
- Use great new social tools to cooperate with your Alliance members, share game screenshots and personalize them with cool stickers!
- Watch our in-game TV channel reporting live game news, and covering your own actions!
- Explore a world of fascinating ruins, steal, fight, and strategize to bring your Rocket to victory!
- From defeating White Mutants to stealing precious resources from other Hordes, you can contribute to your monkey Horde in many ways and be the hero of all primates! 
- What will your strategy be to win this post-apocalyptic space race?
COOPERATION
• Choose to be part of an elite pack of monkeys, in one of the 5 legendary Hordes
• Protect and lead convoys of precious resources to power up your Rocket!
• Fight monkeys from other Hordes and take part in massive PVP wars!
• Make friends with other players of your Alliance!
STRATEGY
• Build or hijack convoys of resources from other Hordes
• Develop your outpost to dominate the monkey world
• Create your own army and train the most powerful monkeys!
• Plan to get ahead of the other Hordes in the Rocket race!
EXPLORATION
• From Roger the Intendant to Junior the terrifying Horde Leader, meet our cast of awesome monkeys
• Explore a post-apocalyptic world full of surprises
• Fight PVE battles against the terrifying White Mutants.
• Travel all around the map, discover ancient Ruins, and huge Bosses!
COMMUNICATION
• Plan strategies with your allies through our new unique social system!
• A picture is worth a thousand words! Take snapshots of the game and personalize them with cool stickers and drawings!
• Become a famous monkey, get many followers, and follow other primates too!
• Watch our in-game TV news channel with real-time coverage of game events, including your own actions!
Are you monkey enough to go bananas, and have fun in this crazy Age of Apes?
NOTE: This game requires an internet connection to play.
Terms of Use (EULA) : https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

bluejetty:00100522:ios.name: Dwarves: Glory, Death and Loot
bluejetty:00100522:ios.summary: Command a fearless band of dwarves in a roguelike auto-battler filled with chaos, strategy, and loot. Every run challenges your tactics as you recruit, equip, and position your squad against waves of enemies that grow stronger with every ba
bluejetty:00100522:ios.description:
Command a fearless band of dwarves in a roguelike auto-battler filled with chaos, strategy, and loot. Every run challenges your tactics as you recruit, equip, and position your squad against waves of enemies that grow stronger with every battle. Glory, death, and loot await those who dare to lead.
Build your legion of dwarves
Recruit and customize up to ten unique dwarves, each with their own class, stats, and abilities. Create powerful synergies by mixing tanks, assassins, healers, and mages. Every item and formation choice can decide victory or defeat.
Strategize before the battle begins
Your dwarves fight automatically, but the outcome depends on your preparation. Arrange your formation, manage your resources, and pick upgrades that complement your team’s strengths. The right setup is the difference between triumph and a total wipeout.
Gather gear and legendary loot
Collect weapons, armor, and accessories after every encounter. Upgrade your heroes, craft new builds, and experiment with combinations to discover deadly strategies.
Master the roguelike loop
Each run is a fresh challenge. Choose your rewards, face unpredictable enemies, and push deeper for greater treasures. Even failure brings progress as you unlock new dwarves, skills, and permanent upgrades.
Face growing threats
Battle orcs, trolls, dragons, and countless monsters across varied stages. Adapt to enemy types and evolve your strategy with each run.
Easy to play, hard to master
With one-tap controls and endless strategic depth, Dwarves: Glory, Death and Loot is a game for players who love tactical thinking, build experimentation, and the thrill of progression.
Lead your dwarves to glory, embrace the chaos, and claim your loot.

- Discover and join public groups
- Material You design

- Custom emotes and stickers
- Spaces

- Encrypted chat backup
- Emoji verification & cross signing

FluffyChat comes with a dream!
Imagine a world where everyone can choose the messenger they like and is still able to chat with all of their friends.
A world where there are no companies spying on you when you send selfies to friends and lovers.
And a world where apps are made for fluffyness and not for profit.

++++

3. «Несгораемая» сумма (после 5-ого и 10-ого вопроса)
4. Три уровня сложности игры
5. Музыкальное сопровождение
6. Игра с таймером различной длительности или возможность игры без таймера

8. Весело анимированные подсказки ответов ( статистика )
9. Игра на телевизоре с компанией друзей (Apple TV)
10. Управление скоростью анимациями
11. Возможность переслать нам Ваши вопросы для викторины (мы включим их в следующую версию )
12. Возможность указать на неверный вопрос. Мы проверим Ваш запрос и изменим содержание в следующей версии.
13. Игру можно теперь ставить на паузу
14. Если Вы не уверенны в правильности ответа, то можете забрать игровые деньги
15. Можно играть разными игроками, соревнуясь в достижениях

#Бенгалуру#Дели#Карачи#Джайпур#

iPhone and iPod game with standard multiple choice questions. In order to win the grand prize of millions game rubles, you must correctly answer 15 questions from various fields of expertise on the highest level of the game.

bluejetty:00071755:ios.description:
The AI Art Generator app is a tool that uses artificial intelligence to generate unique and creative images. The app uses a technique called deep learning to analyze and understand the content of a given photo, then applies a variety of filters and effects to create a new, AI-generated image. This process is known as "ai art" as it is the middle process of creating an image.
One of the key features of the app is the ability to apply a wide range of filters to a photo, allowing users to experiment with different styles and effects. Users can also upload their own photos to the app, and use them as the starting point for their AI-generated art.
The app is free to use, and generates high-quality images that can be used for a variety of purposes, such as portraits, graphics for social media, and text-based art. Overall, the AI Art Generator app is a powerful tool for anyone interested in creating unique and interesting images using the latest technology in AI.

bluejetty:00073034:ios.name: Sunrise - Intermittent Fasting
bluejetty:00073034:ios.summary:
Sunrise Fasting is an intermittent fasting tracker designed to help you build healthy habits, stay motivated, and track your fasting progress over time.
Whether you're new to intermittent fasting or already have an established routine, Sun
bluejetty:00073034:ios.description:
Sunrise Fasting is an intermittent fasting tracker designed to help you build healthy habits, stay motivated, and track your fasting progress over time.
Whether you're new to intermittent fasting or already have an established routine, Sunrise Fasting makes it easy to track fasts, monitor weight goals, view history and stats, and stay consistent with a fasting schedule that works for you.
~~ FEATURES ~~
[+] Track your fasts with live progress updates and fasting timer countdowns to your goal.
[+] View fasting history, weight goal progress, badges, milestones, and detailed stats throughout your journey.
[+] Learn helpful fasting tips, advice, and information through curated articles and videos.
[+] Apple Watch app, Home Screen widgets, and Lock Screen widgets are supported.
~~ TYPES OF FASTS ~~
[+] 16-Hour (16:8) Intermittent Fast: one of the most popular fasting schedules.
[+] Sunrise Fast: fast from sunrise until sundown. Commonly practiced during religious observances such as Ramadan.
[+] Sunset Fast: fast from sundown through sunrise. Also used in some religious customs.
[+] 18:6, 20:4, 1 day (24 hours), and 1.5 day (36 hours) fasts.
[+] Custom fasts of any duration, up to 168 hours.
~~~~
Sunrise Fasting integrates with Apple Health to sync your weight data.
~~~~
Sunrise Fasting+ is an optional subscription. Sunrise Fasting+ unlocks premium features like trends and insights, scheduled fasts, and fast presets. It also removes in-app advertisements. Your subscription will automatically renew if not canceled.
Sunrise Fasting is intended to be a tool for tracking intermittent fasting and is not a medical or healthcare service. The content within Sunrise Fasting is for informational purposes only. You should consult a medical professional before starting intermittent fasting or any other weight loss program, especially if you are pregnant or have a medical condition.
Terms of Service: https://sunrisefasting.com/terms
Privacy Policy: https://sunrisefasting.com/privacy

bluejetty:00026868:ios.summary:
THE BASICS:

bluejetty:00026868:ios.description:
THE BASICS:
1.⁠ ⁠Yummy and healthy recipes, using natural ingredients. No artificial sweeteners, etc.
2.⁠ ⁠I love to replace „bad“ ingredients of classic recipes - for example cane sugar or white flour - with more healthy alternatives. Therefore we can still eat dessert. But we get important nutrients, vitamins and minerals at the same time. The result? Food and sugar cravings will say goodbye.
3.⁠ ⁠Quick & easy! I know, it’s not possible to spend hours in the kitchen every day.
4.⁠ ⁠All recipes are perfect for a fit lifestyle. Huge amounts of fats or sugar (alternatives) are therefore not part of the Pam app.
5.⁠ ⁠Take responsibility! If you want to feel amazing, you have to know about what you eat, the quality of the ingredients and how your dish was prepared. You should not give the responsibility about your health to somebody else. That means: less processed foods, more homemade meals!
GET READY FOR:
•⁠ ⁠A big selection of recipes - with weekly updates.
•⁠ ⁠Special „search“ filters, so you can find the food that YOU enjoy. High protein, no nuts, low carb or vegan? Simply select your preferences.
•⁠ ⁠Blog articles and helpful tips on: food knowledge, cooking & fitness tricks, motivation, personal topics and much more.
•⁠ ⁠Direct access to all of my workout videos, incl. search filters to find the right video for your goal.
• AI Custom Meal Planner that creates a personalized plan based on your preferences, goals, macros, and calories
• Macros and Calories Calculator so you can calculate and understand your daily needs easily
• Journal feature to reflect, track your Mind and Body journey, and see how far you have come
•⁠ ⁠Meal & Workout Plan: structure your week of meals and workouts with the intuitive planner feature. Not sure where to start? Just add my „Pam Plan“!
•⁠ ⁠Shopping List: add all ingredients of a recipe or have fun writing your own list.
•⁠ ⁠Notifications: enable if you want to be notified whenever I publish new content.
RECIPES
•⁠ ⁠All recipes are created by me, my brother, mom or my cousin!
•⁠ ⁠95% for a fit lifestyle, 5% by my brother Dennis & 100% delicious.
•⁠ ⁠Breakfast, Lunch, Dinner, Sweets, Drinks & Snacks.
•⁠ ⁠The recipes are perfect for everyday use, including meal prep ideas. But luckily we also have the time to bake a cake or muffins now and then!
•⁠ ⁠Easy step-by-step cooking instructions.
•⁠ ⁠Calories & macros included with every recipe.
•⁠ ⁠Type in the number of portions you want to cook. The amounts of ingredients will change accordingly.
•⁠ ⁠Meal Planner: structure your week with the meal planner tool.
•⁠ ⁠Shopping List: make sure you have all ingredients by using the shopping list.
WORKOUTS
•⁠ ⁠Direct access to all my workouts videos.
•⁠ ⁠Filter according to your training needs: difficulty level, workout type and focus area.
•⁠ ⁠Workout Planner: structure your week of exercise with the workout planner tool. If you want, you can also copy one of my 13 Pam Plans.
PAMMUNITY
• A safe space to connect, share, and grow together with other Pammies.
• Join groups around cooking, workouts, wellness, self care, and more.
• Ask questions, start conversations, and support each other along the journey.
• Post, comment, and share your thoughts with a community that grows together.
• Need quick advice? Ask Pam directly and be part of the conversation.
• This is just the beginning. We’ll continue growing and building Pammunity together.
MEMBERSHIP OPTIONS
•⁠ ⁠Free: The app is free to try out, with a selection of free content.
•⁠ ⁠Premium: Choose between a monthly or yearly subscription plan to unlock premium recipes and blog content. The first week is free and you can cancel your subscription any time.
•⁠ ⁠My Cookbook: unlock all recipes and articles of my last bestseller „You Deserve This“.
I would love to welcome you in the Pam App!
Lots of love,
Pam

bluejetty:00090461:ios.description:
Individualized diet plans are tailored to client needs and supervised by our dietitians.
Diet Care services fulfill the needs of the following population groups:
• Healthy people with special dietary needs, for example: pregnant and lactating women, growing teenagers, the elderly, athletes;
• People requiring therapeutic diets for disease treatment, for example: hyperlipidemia, diabetes mellitus, hypertension, IBS;
• Healthy people, who wish to protect good health, reduce weight and prevent lifestyle-related diseases.
Diet Care App will give you variety options of dieting programs, all what you have to do is to choose which one fits you the best.
Our unique app design help you to explore different types of diet membership and its food contents in a single page. 
Through Diet Care application you can:
• Create Account/Continue as guest to explore our membership choices. 
• Customize your Membership.
• Manage your membership.
• Renew membership.
• Manage DC Club (Loyalty Program).
• Select your menu.
• Book your appointments.
• Manage your delivery address.
• Manage your dislike & food allergies.
• Manage your body measurements & medical history.
• Track your target weight.
• Manage your off days and freeze/unfreeze membership.
• View your profile with membership details.
• Monitor and view your progress.
• Choose Diet Care boutique option for quick delivery.(Explore varieties of meals & drinks with quick delivery option).
Our application supports both Arabic and English language.
Our simple & smooth noncomplex menu selection help you to explore healthy dietary solutions to people of all categories.
Guest user feature of Diet Care app provides you unique and hassle free experience to explore the membership package and meal plans. 
User dashboard in the application will provide you all the user related data in one place.
Stay logged in our application and track the remaining days of your current diet food subscription. And renew instantly from the app itself, if current subscription being expires. 
Feel free to contact us for any queries related to your membership using different modes of contact us options from the Diet Care app.
References:
https://www.nutritioncaremanual.org/?set_ga_opt_in_cookie=1&set_ga_opt_in=Save+Settings
https://www.krausenutrition.com/
https://www.nutrition.gov/topics/diet-and-health-conditions

THIS IS TO REMIND THAT WE AT DIET CARE PAY HIGH ATTENTION TO THE INDIVIDUALIZED MEDICAL HISTORY SITUATION AND WE HAVE CONSIDERED THIS IN OUR MOBILE APP, HOWEVER, USERS SHOULD SEEK A DOCTOR'S ADVICE IN ADDITION TO USING DIET CARE MOBILE APP BEFORE MAKING ANY MEDICAL DECISIONS.

bluejetty:00037684:ios.description:
Nutstore is a cloud storage service that lets you access your photos, videos, and documents anywhere and anytime. After you install Nutstore on your computer, any file you save to your Nutstore will automatically synchronize to all your Mac, PC and the Nutstore website. WebDAV protocol is well supported so that popular apps, like iWork, GoodReader, notability, Zotero, etc., can read and write files stored in Nutstore. 
Initiative feature, Favorite Folder, is designed for offline access. All files in the favorite folder will be updated from LAN desktop client, fast and automatically. Then You can access these favorite files anywhere even without network. 
Nutstore allows you sync any folder. Organize files as your wish and share with friends easily. Nutstore also has other great features: incremental backup, history version restoring, share access control and etc. 
With the Nutstore app, you can easily access your Nutstore from iPhone and iPad. 
Features: 
- Favorite folder for offline access
- View Office, PDF, Photos and Multimedia files directly.
- Smart file viewer: automatically save and restore file reading position.
- Cache opened files for offline access. 
- Create and edit text file; automatically upload to the server after saving.
- Upload/Backup photos, videos and documents to Nutstore. 
- Easily share files with friends. 
- Easily access all your files in Nutstore.
We offer in-app purchases for "Nutstore Standard Pro" and "Nutstore Advanced Pro" which include unlimited upload and download data transfer, and additional features. The amount will be charged to your iTunes account and will vary by plan and country. You’ll see the total price before completing payment.
"Nutstore Standard Pro" and "Nutstore Advanced Pro" are auto-renew subscriptions.The subscriptions are valid for one year.
"Nutstore Standard Pro" is $40.99 yearly and "Nutstore Advanced Pro" is $86.99 yearly(pricing may vary in countries other than the U.S.)
To avoid renewal, you must turn off auto-renew at least 24 hours before your subscription ends. You can turn off auto-renew at any time from your iTunes account settings.

bluejetty:00019317:ios.description:
Have fun with the new Super Phase Rummy game. Super Phase Rummy is a variation of popular card game "Liverpool Rummy", similar to "Shanghai Rummy", with special cards and improved rules for more fun.
The objective of the game is to be the first player to complete all 10 game phases with defined card sets. The rules are easy to learn and suitable for all ages. 
A game phase is a combination of cards and can be composed of sets, runs, cards of one color, or combination of these. 
'Runs' consist of 3 or more cards in numerical order. The cards do not have to be the same colors.
'Sets' consist of two or more cards of the same number. The cards do not have to be the same colors.
'Color Sets' consists of two or more cards of the same color.
Phase Rummy game play:
Players draw a card from either the deck or the top of the discard pile at the beginning of their turn. At the end of their turn, they must discard a single card.
Completing phases:
When you are able to fully meet the requirements of the phase, you may complete it. Additionally, you may play extra cards as you play the phase if they fit into the phase. For example, if you completed phase '2 sets of 3' you could play three 4’s and three 6’s. You could play additional fours or sixes as part of your sets, but you could not add a different set.
Hitting:
After making a phase, players may “hit” onto other phases in play. The cards you add to the completed phases must fit into the phase, and you can only hit after your own phase is in play.
Ending the round:
Players end the round by playing all of the cards from their hand. The player who goes out first wins the hand and scores points from the remaining cards of other players. Players who completed their phase move on to the next phase. Any players who were unable to complete their phase during the round must attempt to complete it again during the next round.
Points scoring system:
When the player has finished his phase, the counting of the card points begins. For each additional card the player gets points.
When a round is over, the points of unplayed cards of all players are all given to the winner.
If several players have laid the last phase, then the player with the most points wins.
Cards from 1-10 count 5 points each
11-12 cards count 10 points each
Skip-cards count 15 points each
Jokers count 25 points each
Download Phase Rummy today for endless hours of fun!
=== Features ===
- Randomly generated or predefined phase goals
- Configurable number of players: 2-4
- Configurable game difficulty: 1-10
- World wide player score ranking
- Configurable game speed
- Clear UI design: NO music, NO irritating avatars!
- No online login required
Having problems? Any suggestions? We would love to hear from you!
Enjoy Phase Rummy!

listings.name: Super Phase Rummy
listings.description:
Have fun with the new Super Phase Rummy game. Super Phase Rummy is a variation of popular card game "Liverpool Rummy", similar to "Shanghai Rummy", with special cards and improved rules for more fun.

The objective of the game is to be the first player to complete all 10 game phases with defined card sets. The rules are easy to learn and suitable for all ages. 

A game phase is a combination of cards and can be composed of sets, runs, cards of one color, or combination of these. 

'Runs' consist of 3 or more cards in numerical order. The cards do not have to be the same colors.

'Sets' consist of two or more cards of the same number. The cards do not have to be the same colors.

'Color Sets' consists of two or more cards of the same color.

Phase Rummy game play:
Players draw a card from either the deck or the top of the discard pile at the beginning of their turn. At the end of their turn, they must discard a single card.

Completing phases:
When you are able to fully meet the requirements of the phase, you may complete it. Additionally, you may play extra cards as you play the phase if they fit into the phase. For example, if you completed phase  '2 sets of 3' you could play three 4’s and three 6’s. You could play additional fours or sixes as part of your sets, but you could not add a different set.

Hitting:
After making a phase, players may “hit” onto other phases in play. The cards you add to the completed phases must fit into the phase, and you can only hit after your own phase is in play.

Ending the round:
Players end the round by playing all of the cards from their hand. The player who goes out first wins the hand and scores points from the remaining cards of other players. Players who completed their phase move on to the next phase. Any players who were unable to complete their phase during the round must attempt to complete it again during the next round.

Points scoring system:
When the player has finished his phase, the counting of the card points begins. For each additional card the player gets points.
When a round is over, the points of unplayed cards of all players are all given to the winner.
If several players have laid the last phase, then the player with the most points wins.

Cards from 1-10 count 5 points each
11-12 cards count 10 points each
Skip-cards count 15 points each
Jokers count 25 points each


Download Phase Rummy today for endless hours of fun!

- Configurable game difficulty: 1-10
- World wide player score ranking
- Configurable game speed
- Clear UI design: NO music, NO irritating avatars!

Enjoy Phase Rummy!

bluejetty:00177630:ios.description:
Enjoy BBC Science Focus Magazine, the UK's leading science and technology monthly, on your iPhone and iPad. Dive into the latest issue, download the entire back issue collection and save more with a subscription. 
From space travel to brain science, BBC Science Focus Magazine will give you the lowdown on the latest discoveries and the big breakthroughs affecting our future. Interviews with leading scientists and world-leading experts will provide you with thoughtful, accurate analysis, helping you to understand what's going on in the fast-moving world of science. Plus, all your burning questions will be answered in the popular Q&A section.
Our App makes it easy to read and enjoy each issue with helpful features like text adjust, allowing you to amend the font size for clear reading on any device size. You can also bookmark your favourite features to revisit, and browse our archive of content with the handy search tool. Plus, you'll find stunning video and audio inside which bring each issue to life.
**Reality Check
Our team investigates the science behind the headlines. We pore over the research and talk to world-leading experts to find answers to questions like: How can you protect yourself from air pollution? Is screen time bad for you? Are all plastics bad for the planet?
**Features
Every month, the best science writers in the world explore the big mysteries of our time. From the inner workings of our brains to the cosmic machinations of our Universe, each issue is full of surprises.
**Radar
We share the best science TV, books, podcasts and radio of the month ahead. PLUS tech experts help us find the best gadgets that money can buy.

Subscriptions are available on monthly or annual terms & will unlock all premium content on the BBC Science Focus Magazine Apple News channel.

• You can manage your subscriptions and turn off auto-renewal by going to your Account Settings after purchase 
• No cancellation of the current subscription is allowed during active subscription period. This does not affect your statutory rights
• Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when you purchase a subscription
• The app may offer a free trial. At the end of the free trial period, the full price of the subscription will be charged thereafter. Cancellations must occur 24 hours before the end of the subscription period to avoid being charged. Visit http://support.apple.com/kb/ht4098 for more information.
The subscription will include the current issue if you do not already own it and subsequently published future issues. Payment will be charged to your iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase. 
If you would like more information or support please visit our App support page https://www.ourmediaapps.co.uk/apps-faqs/

bluejetty:00041293:ios.name: FitNotes 2 - Gym Workout Log
bluejetty:00041293:ios.summary:
Keep track of your progress in the gym with a workout tracker and planner.
• Based on the popular FitNotes app, the best workout planner app ever made on any platform
• Routines: Save your workout routines as templates, log them to a worko
bluejetty:00041293:ios.description:
Keep track of your progress in the gym with a workout tracker and planner.
• Based on the popular FitNotes app, the best workout planner app ever made on any platform
• Routines: Save your workout routines as templates, log them to a workout
• Personal Records are automatically tracked
• 1RM, Percents Calculator
• Plate Calculator with profiles per gym and multiple barbells
• Body Tracker: Record your weight, body fat and any other measurement. Integrates with Apple HealthKit.
• Goal Tracker: Set personal goals for exercises, such as a 1RM.
• Graphs: Helps to analyze your progress and plan your programming
• Rest Timer, EMOM, AMRAP and Tabata timers
• Notifications: Be notified when the rest timer ends for your next set
• Supports every kind of exercise: weight, reps, distance, time
• Use built-in exercises or create your own
• Mix pounds (lbs) and kilograms (kg) easily
• Add notes to workouts, sets, templates and body measurements
• Dark Mode
• Apple Watch app
• Apple Workout integration with or without Apple Watch
• Share workouts as text or an image
• Warmup sets
• RPE, RIR
• Attach images and videos
• Import the original FitNotes database and FitNotes CSV files
• Manual and automatic backups to iCloud
• Export your workouts in a CSV
• Export back to the original FitNotes. No lock-in.
• No account required
You can import CSVs from other fitness and workout log apps to bring your data over.
The free version of FitNotes 2 can save up to 12 workouts. Delete older workouts to continue using for free. All features are available free, the number of workouts is the only restriction.
To save more workouts, purchase FitNotes unlimited lifetime access or a subscription.
Terms of Use: https://getfitnotes.com/termsofuse
This app is not affiliated with other fitness apps. Purchase of FitNotes does not transfer to other platforms.
FitNotes Changes:
Version 14
- Batch import of templates
- Option to show workout set completion times
- Option to the % of Training Max that a workout set is
- Option to show moving average on body measurement charts 
- Abbreviations recognized in exercise search
- Improved workout CSV import/export for Hevy, FitBod and Strong, including RPE, RIR and warmup sets
- Fixed swiping workouts on iOS 26
Version 13
- Option to show the Next Set on the lock screen timer
- Up/down buttons to move selected workout exercises together
Version 12
- Record training max history
- Templates can program based on percentages of training max
- Import workout text and JSON
- Import HeavySet templates
- Attach photos and videos to notes
- Exercise video library
- French translation
Version 11
- Added a per-exercise option to exclude it from statistics and graphs
- Mark favorite exercises and keep them at the top of the list
- Can tap links in workout notes
- Plate calculator follows the next set
- Modify RPE and RIR from the watch
- Fix template Share and Move options
- Show newly created exercises even when 'Hide Unused Exercises' is on
Version 10
- Ability to hide exercises
Version 8
- Add option to skip the rest timer for the final set
- Long press notes to show the menu
- Update CSV format for the other FitNotes import
Version 7
- Export and import templates
- Added an option to copy previous sets when adding an exercise to a workout
- Add 'Copy' to the long press menu on workout notes
Version 5
- Add the rest timer to the lock screen. 
- Add 'By Year' to statistics time groupings
- Add an option to double an exercise's weight when calculating volume. You can use this for unilateral or dumbbell exercises.
- Add RPE and RIR to workout sets
- Add custom rest times to a single workout set
- Add an option to show the workout set notes without opening the notes screen
- Flag sets as 'warmup'. Warmup sets are excluded from graphs, statistics and goals.
- Fix the rest timer buttons not working after uses EMOM/AMRAP timers

bluejetty:00051149:ios.description:
Rapidus is a local, same-day, 24/7 delivery service.
Drivers use our mobile app to receive delivery requests based on their location and schedule.
Looking to request delivery instead? Search for "Rapidus - Local, Professional, Same-day Delivery".
We built an effective shipping & delivery network, connecting drivers with clients. Our service allows drivers to build own schedule and route, without much modifying existing work routine. We offer a cost effective delivery system for clients and a profitable job opportunity for drivers.
JOB
- Simply pick up and deliver various packages, paperwork, objects, artifacts, etc.
- You can choose to do so exclusively or along your commute route - an extra income with little to no change of your business routine.

- Higher payout than Uber, Lyft & other ridesharing companies
- Own schedule, weekends, nights, lunch time, holidays
- Clean car, no mess and never have to deal with uber-drunks in your car
- No need to socialize with your packages

Are you a friendly person with positive attitude, 18 years or older, having a valid driving license and a car, truck, van - anything with the wheels? (Older cars are accepted, too.) 
You can apply! Go to http://www.rapidus.com/drive 
Rapidus is currently available anywhere in California, Denver, Colorado, and Seattle, Washington, and expanding into more cities soon.
Continued use of GPS running in the background can dramatically decrease battery life.

bluejetty:00085803:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00085803:ios.description:
Multi-journey passes purchase, carnet purchase and Tap&go, credit card details saved in your profile and a new layout for a user experience easier and faster.
With the app you can:
- Buy train tickets, Stibm fares included
- Buy or renew all kinds of rail passes
- Buy Malpensa Express tickets
- Buy multi-journey passes and activate them through Tap&Go
- Add trains, lines and stations to favourites and have them always in the homepage
- Enable notifications to be updated about your line or train
- Find out the Discovery Train promotion or the Trenord Subscribers promotion
SEARCH, BUY AND TRAVEL
Search your next trip with the “Where are you going” button or the purchase button in the menu.
Use the chronology of last trips searched to buy what you need in very few steps.
Buy Trenord tickets, Stibm fares included, one way or round tickets and Malpensa Express tickets for Terminal 1 and Terminal 2.
Safely pay by Credit Card, Paypal or Satispay and save your credit card details for quicker purchases. Save your invoices information to ask for the invoice directly from the app.
Get to the Train Station or continue your trip using Moovit suggestions.
BUY YOUR RAIL PASS OR MULTI-JOURNEY PASS
With the App 3.0 you can buy a 10 trips multi-journey pass and activate single tickets through Tap&Go. You only need to go to “my tickets” in the menu and tap on Carnet.
From now on, you can also buy your rail pass through the app, not only renew it. Select your trip, type of rail pass and add your card.
SAVE YOUR CREDIT CARD DETAILS
Pay with your Visa, Mastercard or American Express credit card or use your Paypal or Satispay account. 
In the new app you can save your credit card details for future purchases
MY TICKETS
A new area of the app dedicated to all your tickets, multi-journey pass or rail pass to easily have them when you need them.
Check the validity of tickets and activate your multi-journey pass or your Stibm ticket through Tap&Go.
CUSTOMIZE YOUR HOMEPAGE
The customizable homepage will give you only the information you really need: favourite lines, trains and stations. 
From your profile select the vertical or horizontal view of favourites in the homepage.
PROMOTIONS
Check promotion of the day with Discovery Train or the Subscribers promotions. Special prices for many events around Lombardy.
Contact us:
Do you have any report about the app or any suggestion to give us? We’ll love to hear from you! You can easily reach us at apphelpdesk@trenord.it

bluejetty:00018950:ios.description:
Bus Simulator : EVO puts you in the driver’s seat and lets you become a real Bus Driver! Featuring detailed maps all over the world, a wide variety of modern city buses, coach buses and school buses with realistic interiors and a groundbreaking 1:1 physics engine.
Get behind the wheel and drive your bus to complete all the routes! Drive a diesel, hybrid, electric, articulated, coach bus or school bus and customize your bus as you wish. 
This bus simulation game features next-gen graphics, a wide variety of buses to choose from, and multiple cities from around the world to explore in career mode, freeride, and online multiplayer with friends.
Completely realistic Coach Bus Simulator.
Features: 
- Realistic intracity and outside of city maps: United States of America (San Francisco,Texas, Boston, and Interstate 95), South America (Buenos Aires), Europe (Germany, Spain, Berlin, London, Prague, St. Petersburg), Dubai, Shanghai and more… 
- Multiple diesel, hybrid, electric, articulated, coach bus and school buses to choose from.
- Six real coach bus
- Career, Free-ride and Multiplayer modes.
- Lots of bus customization options including paint, accessories, body parts, air conditioning, flags, decals and many more. 
- Detailed and customizable interiors. 
- Open/Close Doors button, animated people entering/exiting the bus
- Steering wheel, buttons or tilting controls. 
- Locations of any kind: city, countryside, mountain, desert and snow
- Multiple time of day and weather conditions to choose from.
- Drive kids to school using three different school bus models. 
- Bus company management system with hired drivers for your buses and custom route scheduling. 
- Intelligent Traffic System
- Immersive online multiplayer cooperative gameplay. 
- Add your friends, use live chat and invite them to play in coop bus routes. 
- Leaderboards, achievements and rankings.
Become the best bus driver in the world with Bus Simulator : EVO!

Epic Battles
• The character design style is cute, bright, like vivid cartoons, taking you into a magical world based on Eastern myths and legends.
• Advanced graphics technology turns each match into a stage to show off skills, eye-catching effects, and epic cutscenes.
Hundreds of Heroes to Collect
• How did Sun Wukong learn the 72 transformations? What's behind Tang Monk's 10 reincarnations? What is the secret bẹhind the Fengshen list? Want to learn more about the origin of all the heroes? Recruit them to your team and find out their secrets for yourself!
Hero Switch! Mastering The Meta
• Meta changes, need a stronger lineup? In X-Wukong: Chaos of Realms, players can freely adjust their strategies thanks to the Inheritance feature, which allows for the immediate transfer of experience, equipment, and resources between heroes. 
• Don't forget to use the Hero Exchange feature to search for the champions you want from the ones you currently have!
Lifetime Daily 10x Draws
• Say goodbye to saving up for days just to perform a draw! X-Wukong: Chaos of Realms 10x draws every day forever! 
• In particular, logging in the first 7 days will receive 150 draws. Getting heroes you like has never been easier!
Kick Back and Relax
• Want to take a break after battles? Want to spend more time with your heroes? Then try out the fun Homeland feature and win exciting prizes. In X-Wukong: Chaos of Realms, you can always take a break and enjoy your time!

bluejetty:00151251:ios.description:
Fresh – AI-Powered Meal Planner & Smart Pantry Manager
Fresh makes eating well effortless: track every ingredient, turn what’s in your kitchen into chef-level meals, and restock in one tap. No more forgotten spinach or last-minute “what’s for dinner?” stress—Fresh keeps your food, your wallet, and your goals on track!
Key features
• Smart Pantry Tracking – Automatically log what you buy, watch expiry dates, and get alerts for ingredients you should use next.
• Snap-to-Stock – Take a picture of your fridge or pantry; Fresh’s vision AI recognizes items and updates your inventory in seconds.
• AI Meal Planner – Daily or weekly plans built around what you have, your diet preferences, and macro goals. Swap dishes with one swipe.
• One-Tap Grocery Lists & Delivery – Missing two items? Generate a list instantly and order via Instacart or DoorDash without leaving the app.
• Guided Video Recipes – Cook with 60-second, step-by-step clips, timers, and hands-free voice prompts—perfect for busy weeknights.
• Automatic Macro & Calorie Tracking – Nutrition dashboard fills itself in as you cook and log meals.
• Social Recipe Feed – Scroll, like, and save dishes from a community of food lovers; publish your own creations to inspire others.
• Premium Nutrition Assistant – Unlock deeper insights, personalized suggestions, and advanced goal tracking (keto, high-protein, low-waste, and more).
• Food-Waste Score – See how much food (and money) you save each week and share your impact with friends.
Why Fresh?
• Cuts meal-planning time from hours to minutes.
• Helps you waste less food—saving up to $1,500 a year.
• Keeps macros, calories, and grocery budgets on target automatically.
Join thousands turning their kitchens into smart, sustainable cooking hubs with Fresh. Download now and cook like a pro tonight!
