bluejetty:00014688:ios.summary:
Scan Master turns your iPhone into a document scanner, PDF converter, and OCR text reader. Scan paper to PDF in seconds, convert it to Word, JPG, or TXT, then sign, annotate, and share.
Contracts, invoices, receipts, tax returns, medical r
bluejetty:00014688:ios.description:
Scan Master turns your iPhone into a document scanner, PDF converter, and OCR text reader. Scan paper to PDF in seconds, convert it to Word, JPG, or TXT, then sign, annotate, and share.
Contracts, invoices, receipts, tax returns, medical records, notes, textbook pages. Everything stays sharp and organized.
Get perfect scans
- AI Enhanced clears shadows, glare, and desk lamp reflections, so a page shot in a normal room still comes out clean
- Straighten fixes the angle for you, no lining the page up perfectly or holding the phone flat
- Switch between color, grayscale, and high-contrast black and white depending on what you are scanning
- Set the look once and apply it to the whole document instead of page by page
Multi-language text recognition
- Pull the text out of a scan so you can search, copy, and reuse it instead of retyping the page
- Detects the language for you, or pick one yourself
- Fix a typo or reformat the result before you send it, right inside the app
- Copy it as plain text, or export as PDF, DOC, or TXT
Sign and mark up without printing
- Sign a contract and send it back in a minute, no printer, no scanner, no trip to the office
- Draw your signature once and reuse it on everything after that
- Highlight the clause that matters, or leave a note for whoever reads it next
- Add a stamp or your own watermark before the file leaves your phone
Export in the format you need
- PDF to file it, JPG to share it, DOC or TXT when you still need to edit it
- Send only the pages that matter instead of the whole document
- Adjust size and quality so the file is small enough to email
- Straight out to email, AirDrop, print, or Files
Your documents stay on your device
Tax returns, contracts, medical records, and ID documents are not the kind of files that belong on someone else's server. Scan Master scans, processes, and stores everything locally on your iPhone.
- Your documents are never uploaded, and no account is required
- Text recognition runs on your iPhone, not in the cloud
- Lock individual documents behind a password
- Add encryption to any file before you export it
Scan Master Premium
Scan Master is free to use. Premium unlocks batch file import, watermark-free export, file encryption, OCR result export, and advanced editing: signatures, markup, comments, stamps, and custom watermarks.
Free users can export one page at a time with a Scan Master watermark. Selecting multiple pages requires Premium.
Privacy Policy: https://scanmaster.io/scan-master-privacy-policy.html
Terms of Use: https://scanmaster.io/scan-master-terms-conditions.html
Questions or suggestions? Email us at getsupport@scanmaster.io.

bluejetty:00021339:ios.name: Plants vs Goblins 4
bluejetty:00021339:ios.summary: In recent times, the Garden Kingdom has evolved to be a haven for the plants, since all the cold and gruesome wars with the Goblins, it had regenerated an air of harmony, flourishing the gardening art and culture. They had festivals and com
bluejetty:00021339:ios.description:
In recent times, the Garden Kingdom has evolved to be a haven for the plants, since all the cold and gruesome wars with the Goblins, it had regenerated an air of harmony, flourishing the gardening art and culture. They had festivals and competitions, and the youthful saplings sang the melodies and listened to accounts of war veterans. The great number of lives laid forth by the heroic plants raised a field full of blooming red strawberries after the Battle of Peasburg, and as a tribute to the fallen heroes and to pick up their insight and power, the young green warriors sow strawberries, to grow other plants and to gain flower-like points.
The Kingdom had established good relations with the neighboring pumpkin and ginseng fields. The tremendous corn fields likewise trained their cobs with the green warriors. They welcomed the bordering forest beasty carnivorous plants into civilization. They had all pledged allegiance to the garden realm, in time of peace and war, to secure each knoll and turf, garden and nursery alike. Who knew the war wouldn't be that long to come?
The archenemy vile goblins had donned on their facade of conceit. The goblins devised the biggest artillery with the help of the shrewdest of ghouls, elves, gnomes, pixies, and ghosts. They have been plotting ever since and gathered the biggest force the world has ever seen. They hadnít left but were biding their time until they destroy all the plants from the face of the earth. With the standing army of millions of destructive armored goblins, the thick billows of war were encompassing the Garden Kingdom and the air of dread and death was stirring.
One fine morning, an immense tremor shook the grounds of the Garden Kingdom. The sky turned gloomy. The plants saw a rising tsunami and off came a Goblin Cyclop, pulverizing everything in its way. The war was declared, sirens aloud, the green warriors ready to protect. The Goblin army was something unseen before, covering every inch of sky, land, and water, with the goblin flying bombers, archers, warriors, and goblin riders. The flying goblin was back with the dynamite, which could kill all the plants within seconds. Nonetheless, the sons of the Garden Kingdom, with chlorophyll running in their veins fought with all their might, entangling and the goblins, the pumpkin cannonballs crushed the flying goblins, joined by ginseng, corn, and carnivorous plants in the onslaught. Planting strawberries helped increment the plant power yet remained the question of the dynamite.
Plants are devising ways to take and dismantle the dynamite, with every 21 plants against 17 goblins, with much more surprises and 46 new levels. Who will win? Let's play and find out.
Here's Tip: Grow more strawberries to get more rewards!

Tracking and counting your rows has never been easier with that knit companion. We have asked knitting enthusiasts what the
bluejetty:00134163:ios.description:
Easy Knitty row counter, row tracker is your new yarn app or knitting tool for all your knit and crochet projects. 
Tracking and counting your rows has never been easier with that knit companion. We have asked knitting enthusiasts what they want and we have developed the manual counter app focused on user experience. That's why we've included features such as a huge "add row" button or why we didn't include any bothering sounds stopping your favorite podcast... we have simply made a user-friendly knitting tool to help all the knit and yarn lovers that we are!
____MAIN FEATURES OF THE EASY KNITTY ROW COUNTER APP____ 
- Huge "Add Row" button that you can easily smash
- Create, Edit or Delete Projects with 1 or several parts
- Create, Edit or Delete Parts of projects (in other words: sub-projects)
- Counting rows 1 by 1 or X by X (can be use as a stitch counter as well)
- Add/Remove rows or reset the row counter
- Using the stopwatch to track how long you spend on each part of your knitting or crochet project
- Alternatively you can use the stopwatch to track the time for each of your knitting sessions
- Adding notes about a specific project (Project status, Needle Size, Project starting date, Yarn details and Dye Lot)
- Adding extra notes for each part directly on the row counter page
- Design and development focused on user experience
- NO sound (that means: listen to your podcast or favorite playlist freely with another app in the background)
- Manual counter 
- Dark mode
____STAY IN TOUCH GUYS____ 
This new app has been designed by a young couple of 1 professional developer and 1 passionate knitter. We would love to get your review on that knit row counter app, but also feedback and ideas for feature improvements!
Thank you and enjoy!

bluejetty:00174379:ios.name: Checkbook - Bills to Budget
bluejetty:00174379:ios.summary: Late fees and overdrafts can cost more than $30 each — and wreck your credit score. Bills to Budget is the modern checkbook register that helps you stay organized, track every bill, and know exactly what's cleared and what's still pending.
bluejetty:00174379:ios.description:
Late fees and overdrafts can cost more than $30 each — and wreck your credit score. Bills to Budget is the modern checkbook register that helps you stay organized, track every bill, and know exactly what's cleared and what's still pending. If you've ever been surprised by a payment hitting your account at the wrong time, this app is for you.
FINALLY KNOW WHAT'S REALLY IN YOUR ACCOUNT
The biggest problem with online banking? It only shows what's cleared. Bills to Budget lets you mark payments as "Paid but not Cleared" — so you always know your true available balance, not just what the bank says. No more mental math. No more overdrafts from forgotten pending checks.
STAY AHEAD OF EVERY BILL
Add your bills once, and Bills to Budget reminds you before they're due. Mark a bill as paid, and it automatically resets for next month, next quarter, or whatever schedule you need. See everything organized by your pay schedule, so you always know what's due before your next paycheck arrives.
BUDGET WITHOUT THE SPREADSHEETS
Once your bills are under control, take the next step: create simple spending budgets and track purchases as they happen. See exactly where your money goes — whether you pay by check, debit card, or cash. Get alerts when you're close to overspending, so you can adjust before it's too late.
SEE YOUR FINANCIAL FUTURE
The calendar view shows your complete financial picture: upcoming bills, paydays, and projected balances all in one place. Spot problems days or weeks before they become stress. Know exactly how much you can afford to spend today.
BUILT FOR REAL LIFE
- Works on iPhone, iPad, and Mac with seamless iCloud sync
- Supports multiple accounts — checking, savings, credit cards
- Tracks check numbers for your checkbook register
- Family sharing lets everyone stay on the same page
- Widgets put your bills and budgets front and center
- Siri Shortcuts support for quick access
Bills to Budget brings the reliability of a traditional checkbook register into the modern age — helping you organize your bills, track your spending, and finally feel in control of your money.

Track every point with real-time tennis scores, match stats, live streams (select events), player alerts, exclusive interviews, and more.
Whether it’s Grand Slams, ATP, WTA, or Challenger events — TennisONE keeps you closer to the sport you love.

KEY FEATURES
LIVE Tennis Scores & Match Tracking
Real-time point-by-point scoring
Live match stats (aces, break points, win probability & more)
ONETennis alerts for your favorite players

Live Streaming & Video Content (select events)
Match streams
Practice court streams
Tournament draw reveals
Post-match interviews & highlight videos

Match Chat & Fan Community
Chat with fans worldwide during matches
Share reactions, predictions & match insights

Personalized Experience
ACE AI match insights to explore player and tournament stats
Player alerts (match start, set scores, final results)         
 
Tournament-level notifications (draws, updates)
Access to X, Instagram, and YouTube feeds for live tournaments
TennnisONE team created articles for exclusive analytical content

MULTILINGUAL SUPPORT
Access live tennis in the language you prefer. Available in: English, Spanish, French, 
German, Portuguese, Italian, Polish & Dutch.

TOURNAMENT COVERAGE INCLUDES:
Grand Slams
Australian Open
Roland Garros (French Open)
Wimbledon
US Open
ATP & WTA + Premier Events
Indian Wells (BNP Paribas Open)
Miami Open
Monte-Carlo Masters
Madrid, Rome, Cincinnati, Shanghai
Laver Cup, Davis Cup, Billie Jean King Cup
Nitto ATP Finals, WTA Finals
ATP Challenger Tour
All other ATP & WTA events

WHY TENNISONE?
We partner with premier tournaments as their Official App, giving fans exclusive court 
access, video content, and on-site experiences not available anywhere else.

Terms & Conditions: https://www.bleachr.co/terms-and-condition

bluejetty:00087578:ios.description:
This is the most classic and amazing shooting bubble buster game.
Enjoy this classic, fun bubble shooter game with 2000+ awesome puzzle levels!
Shoot, pop and explode all the bubbles and enjoy this amazing stress relief game anytime you want. 
With plenty of amazing puzzles and challenges, cool boosters and effects, you simply won’t put it down!
The best shoot-bubble style game!
SHOOT and POP the colored balls in this fun, addicting puzzle game and master all the challenges! 
If you are looking for a fun way to spend time, we have a perfect game for you.
Much more interesting levels are coming soon!
KEY FEATURES
* 2000+ puzzles filled with fun and amazing challenges!
* Super easy to learn yet challenging for the brain.
* No need for WiFi. Enjoy the game offline!
* Fun for all ages and gender!
* Really addicting to play and helps relaxing your brain and finger!
* Classic Bubble Blast and uniquely challenging obstacles.
* You will have many levels and unique features that make it better then the other puzzle game.
* You don’t just burst bubbles and finish the level, here you have very special levels design and unique ball mechanic that will keep you playing for long time.
* This will keep you playing for long time with many unique levels.
* Hundreds of exciting levels in a colorful setting!
HOW TO PLAY
* Just Aim and shoot the bubble!
* Match 3 or more bubbles of the same color as the bubble.
* If you match consecutively, you can get higher score. Get 3 stars.
* Use fewer shots to get higher scores.
* Unlock powerful boosters to help you blast through hard levels.
* Drop bubbles to get booster items and clear levels more easily.
* Clear all the bubbles on the screen.
* Swap the bubbles to match & pop more.
NOTES
* This contains some ads which are banners, interstitials and videos ads.
* This is free to play game, but some in-app purchases are included.
* It’s a free puzzle tactic game with no time limit.
Match the colorful bubbles to pop and blast large groups and clear the screen.
Play today and discover amazing graphics, cool features, and exciting bubble puzzles.
The bubble shooting fun starts NOW!
Thank you!

A Masterpiece That Breaks Mobile Limits
Pixel Adventure RPG Guardian Tales
Twist-filled stories, high-quality pixel art, and endless content await!
A Legendary Journey Begins!
Explore a vast world, meet Champions, and uncover the kingdom’s fate.
Adventure like never before—only in Guardian Tales!
◆ An RPG Packed with Story and Surprises!
A world filled with unexpected twists and charming characters.
Hope and despair collide—what truth will you uncover?
◆ Over 150 Unique Pixel Heroes!
Unique combat styles, vibrant voice acting, and adorable costumes!
Summon, collect, and grow your team to victory!

Lift boulders, throw bombs, and uncover hidden treasures!

Guild content, Co-op Raids, Team Deathmatch, and more await!
◆ Relax and Customize Your Own Space!
Create your floating castle, "Heavenhold," design your "My Room," and personalize your profile card! 
Enjoy farming, ranching, fishing, and peaceful moments with your beloved heroes!

bluejetty:00128635:ios.description:
Love fridge organizing, sorting puzzles, and the satisfying feeling of a perfectly tidy space? Open the fridge, kitchen cupboards, and storage areas around the home, then give every item the spot where it belongs.
This is more than a fill-the-fridge game. The new experience expands into more than 10 home scenes, from fridge shelves and pantry storage to the bathroom, laundry room, and vanity. Restock snacks, drinks, milk, and eggs; arrange toiletries, clothes, cosmetics, and many more everyday objects.
Every scene brings a different layout, storage space, and item mix. Look at the available room, plan the best order, and drag each object into place. A cluttered shelf slowly becomes a neat, cozy corner of the home—and every finished level brings that satisfying before-and-after feeling.
FEATURES
• More than 10 themed home-organizing scenes
• 100 new levels with varied layouts and items
• Simple drag, sort, stack, and tidy gameplay
• Fridge, kitchen, pantry, bathroom, laundry, vanity, and more
• Warm, cozy visuals inspired by everyday home spaces
• New objects and organizing challenges to unlock
Start with one fridge shelf and work your way through the whole home. Whether you enjoy relaxing games, sorting puzzles, restocking, or home organization, there is always another space ready for a satisfying makeover.

bluejetty:00041647:ios.description:
Feature Overview
Vocal Extractor separates songs in your Music Library into vocals and accompaniment with just a tap of a button on the main screen (*1), instantly creating karaoke and a cappella tracks.
The generated vocal and backing (karaoke) tracks can be saved as files and exported to iCloud, Dropbox, Google Drive, and other platforms. This allows you to use the isolated tracks in other applications or on different platforms (*2).
Unlike traditional apps based on OOPS (Out of Phase Stereo) technology, Vocal Extractor leverages AI and deep learning to separate vocals from songs, including monaural recordings and tracks where the vocals are not center-panned—cases where traditional apps cannot remove vocals.
You can import music files in mp3, m4a, or wav formats from iCloud, Dropbox, Google Drive, and other sources. This includes live recordings created with other apps, allowing you to remove or extract vocals from them.
The embedded player allows you to toggle between the original, vocal, or backing tracks while playing the audio.
*1. Only songs downloaded to your device and not protected by DRM can be used as source data.
*2. Saved output files will have a sampling rate of 44.1kHz and be in m4a or wav format, either mono or stereo. Saving files is an in-app purchase feature. We recommend testing the vocal separation quality in the embedded player before purchasing.
How to Use
1.Launch the App
 After the launch screen, the main screen will appear. Tap the Music Library button, select a song, and load it into the app.
2.Extract Vocals
 Tap the Vocal Extract button in the center of the main screen. The extraction process will begin, and once completed, the Vocal, Backing, and Save buttons will become active.
3.Playback Tracks
 Select either the Original, Vocal, or Backing track and tap the Play Back button to listen to the chosen track.
4.Save Tracks
 After extraction, the Save Vocal and Save Backing buttons will be enabled. The first time you tap one of these buttons, the in-app purchase screen will appear. Before purchasing, we recommend confirming the quality of the vocal separation in the embedded player. Once purchased, the in-app purchase screen will no longer appear, and you can save files after confirming via a pop-up.
5.File Naming
 Saved files will be named with the original file name (excluding the suffix) plus "_vocal.m4a" or "_backing.m4a". File renaming is not supported in this version. Output files are in 44.1kHz m4a or wav format.
6.Export Files
 To export files from the app container, tap the Export button. A list of saved files will appear. Select a file and tap the Export menu in the navigation bar. The document provider screen will appear, allowing you to choose a location to save the file. A pop-up will confirm when the export has started successfully. Exporting occurs in the background.
7.Import Source Files
 You can use m4a, mp3, and wav files as source data. Place these files in iCloud, Dropbox, Google Drive, or another document provider configured on your iPhone. Then, tap the Import button to add the file to the app's container.
8.Load Imported Files
 After importing a file, tap the File button to see a list of imported files. Select a file and tap the Load menu in the navigation bar to load the content for extraction or playback.
9.Document Provider Compatibility
 Import and export functions only work with document providers properly configured on your device.
For more information, visit http://vocalextractor.com/en/.
Some icons used on the main screen are sourced from Icons8. https://icons8.com

bluejetty:00187495:ios.description:
Vous êtes à la recherche d’une formation ? Découvrez l'application Ma Formation de France Travail (anciennement Pôle emploi) accessible à tous !
RECHERCHEZ VOTRE FORMATION IDÉALE
• Trouvez votre formation en sélectionnant une formation ou un métier ainsi que le lieu,
• visualisez le détail de chaque formation : contenu de la formation, taux de retour à l’emploi, notes et avis des anciens stagiaires…,
• contactez l'organisme de formation pour obtenir plus d'informations.
AJOUTEZ EN FAVORIS
• Ajoutez des formations en favoris pour les retrouver facilement,
• visualisez en un coup d’œil les informations clés de chaque formation,
• triez en fonction des critères importants pour vous.
PRENEZ RENDEZ-VOUS ET SUIVEZ VOS PROJETS
• Demandeurs d'emploi inscrits, prenez directement rendez-vous avec l'organisme de formation pour une réunion d'information,
• suivez vos rendez-vous d'information,
• gérez vos projets de formation.
ÉTUDIEZ ET ACCEPTEZ VOS DEVIS AIF
• Demandeurs d'emploi inscrits, visualisez et étudiez vos demandes de devis d'Aide Individuelle à la Formation,
• en quelques clics, acceptez ou refusez les propositions de devis.
France Travail évolue ! Grâce à vos retours, nous améliorons et enrichissons régulièrement les applications mobiles pour mieux servir notre objectif commun : votre retour à l’emploi.
N’hésitez pas à nous faire part de vos questions et vos suggestions à l’adresse support.smartphone@francetravail.net

Vous êtes à la recherche d’une formation ? Découvrez l'application Ma Formation de France Travail (anciennement Pôle emploi) accessible à tous !

RECHERCHEZ VOTRE FORMATION IDÉALE

• Trouvez votre formation en sélectionnant une formation ou un métier ainsi que le lieu,
• visualisez le détail de chaque formation : contenu de la formation, taux de retour à l’emploi, notes et avis des anciens stagiaires…,
• contactez l'organisme de formation pour obtenir plus d'informations.

AJOUTEZ EN FAVORIS

• Ajoutez des formations en favoris pour les retrouver facilement,
• visualisez en un coup d’œil les informations clés de chaque formation,
• triez en fonction des critères importants pour vous.

PRENEZ RENDEZ-VOUS ET SUIVEZ VOS PROJETS

• Demandeurs d'emploi inscrits, prenez directement rendez-vous avec l'organisme de formation pour une réunion d'information,
• suivez vos rendez-vous d'information,
• gérez vos projets de formation.

ÉTUDIEZ ET ACCEPTEZ VOS DEVIS AIF

• Demandeurs d'emploi inscrits, visualisez et étudiez vos demandes de devis d'Aide Individuelle à la Formation,
• en quelques clics, acceptez ou refusez les propositions de devis.

France Travail évolue ! Grâce à vos retours, nous améliorons et enrichissons régulièrement les applications mobiles pour mieux servir notre objectif commun : votre retour à l’emploi.

N’hésitez pas à nous faire part de vos questions et vos suggestions à l’adresse support.smartphone@francetravail.net

bluejetty:00060882:ios.description:
Restaurant managers all over the world use Avero’s Logbook to communicate with their teams about important events that occurred in their operation throughout the day.
Good communication is critical in restaurant environments since one shift picks up where the last shift left off. The Logbook makes sure that every team can start with a complete picture of what’s going on in the restaurant.
A custom set of fields (e.g. Maintenance Issues, VIPs, Service Notes, 86’ed Items, Employee Issues, etc.) let managers contribute the qualitative story of notable events and issues during the previous shift.
This app replaces expensive physical notebooks found in the back office of restaurants. Whereas notebooks are static, susceptible to loss and damage, and aren’t integrated with sales and labor performance data, Avero’s Logbook pulls data directly from the POS and time clock systems to provide quantitative performance insights.
Plus, local weather information and national holidays are included to help set expectations for upcoming shifts. Add national sporting events and local happenings with a few clicks, and include your promotions, live music, and happy hour specials too.
With all this data in one place, Avero's Logbook paints a complete picture of performance. This is vital information to successfully planning the next shift, week, month, or same day next year.
The beta version of Right Now reporting is here! We are testing these NEW features - available to all users that have Right-Now data. Now, Avero users can conveniently find Logbook & Reporting functionality in one location.

bluejetty:00166326:ios.description:
【AI Song Generator: Transform Ideas into Music】
Welcome to Sona AI, the AI song generator that turns your lyrics, ideas, or prompts into fully produced songs. Whether you’re looking to write a song, create a custom track, or generate lyrics with ease, Sona AI offers an intuitive and innovative approach to music creation.
【Generate Songs from Prompts】
With Sona AI, you can transform any prompt into a unique song. From catchy pop melodies to soulful ballads, our AI crafts songs that reflect your desired genre, mood, and style. Whether you input your own lyrics or use the lyric generator for inspiration, our system will build a complete, high-quality song tailored to your vision.
【Custom Song Creation】
Use our powerful AI to create a custom song written for you in minutes. Add vocals and intricate melodies to your track or let Sona AI build everything from scratch. It’s not just a song maker—it’s your creative partner that brings your music to life with stunning results.
【AI Music Generator: Create Music with AI Precision】
Sona AI offers more than just lyrics and songs; it’s a full AI music generator that allows you to produce music in a wide range of genres and styles using simple prompts. Whether you’re interested in creating rhythms, melodies, or full instrumental pieces, Sona AI seamlessly converts text-based prompts into complete musical works.
【Generate Beats and Moods】
Leverage our beat creator and music maker features to produce intricate rhythms or mood-specific compositions. While Sona AI isn’t a traditional music editing tool, it excels at creating new songs, beats, and instrumentals through advanced music AI capabilities, all based on your input.
【From Idea to Melody】
Simply describe what you want to create—be it an upbeat track, a relaxing instrumental, or a moody ballad—and let our music generator handle the rest. The entire process is seamless, allowing you to make beats or create a song without technical complexity.
【AI Cover: Sing with Your Own Voice】
With our AI Cover feature, you can now perform songs using your own voice. Train Sona AI with your vocal data, and it will reproduce any generated song as if you were singing it yourself. Whether it’s a custom composition or a recreated classic, this feature gives you full vocal presence—without ever stepping into a studio.
【Share Your Creations】
Once your masterpiece is ready, share your songs with friends, family, or on social media. Impress your audience with personalized music generated by AI music creation. Every track is uniquely crafted to reflect your individual style, thanks to our lyric generator, song writer AI, and more.
【Why Choose Sona AI?】
Effortlessly write a song or create a track with our AI song writer.
 Utilize AI music generation tools for creating beats, melodies, and vocals.
Reproduce songs with your own trained voice using the AI Cover feature.
Generate engaging music, from simple rhythms to complex songs, all from a single prompt.
Experience Sona AI and unlock a new way of making music.
Note: All features, including AI Cover, custom track creation, and advanced music generation tools, require premium access.

Terms & Conditions: https://sunraymobile.net/sonaai/terms.html
EULA: https://sunraymobile.net/sonaai/eula.html
Support: info@sunraymobile.net

bluejetty:00170358:ios.description:
Hello there, farmer! Is your lawnmower ready to cut grass? Then dive into the world of lawn mowing games for thrilling adventures and the serenity of a farming life! 
In this captivating lawn-mower simulator, you step into the shoes of a virtual farmer who plows and mows through endless fields and develops a thriving farm! Get your tractor ready and rev it up to explore the lush green islands, delivering perfect grass cuts and boosting your skills in lawn mowing games! The satisfying hum of the lawnmower, the soothing process of mowing grass that goes as smoothly as leveling the ground on a bulldozer, and the delightful visuals of this mower game make it a masterpiece among other lawn mower games. 
Mow And Trim is not just about the cuts and the simple tasks as in other lawn mower games; it's about the whole farming experience! You'll not only have to cut the grass but also explore islands on tractors and take care of animals in our fun grass cutting game! Switch gears and delve into the heart of a bustling farming simulator where you can build an idle farm, cut the grass with your lawn mower or shape the land on your bulldozer or excavator for your cows and chickens, and sell the animal products for your farm to grow! Experience the joy of growing your virtual empire in this extraordinary mower game!
The fun doesn't stop there! The cuts of grass bring you money, too! After your character plows and mows, shift your focus to selling your harvest! Spend the earned money to upgrade your tractors: sharpen your saw, make your excavators faster, and expand the capacity of your grass cutter to store more grass! Explore the world of heavy machinery in this truck simulator!
Our lawnmower game is also an idle game that blends the excitement of cutting grass games with relaxing content to elevate your gaming experience! Immerse yourself in the simplicity of just mowing. The gentle hum of the lawnmower or grass cutter, the lush green landscape, and the pure joy of mowing grass make Mow and Trim more than just a grass cutting game—it's a therapeutic escape!
With stunning graphics and an array of features, from adorable animals to powerful excavators, Mow And Trim sets the gold standard for lawn mower simulators or any farming simulator. Dive into the captivating world of lawn mower games, where you’ll manage your idle farm to become the ultimate idle tycoon in this digital realm of lawnmower games! 
Here are some features of our lawn-mower simulator:
- Simple mechanics: As in other lawnmower games, get in your tractor to mow lawn grass and cut it all in our popular truck simulator from cut games category!
- Stunning graphics: While you mow the lawn, enjoy the vibrant fields this cut game teleports you to!
- Various upgrades: Improve your vehicles—from a basic lawnmower to a powerful excavator—to cut grass faster and make your farm the nicest it can be in our mowing simulator!
- Amazing farm: Mow lawn, harvest, and cut grass to raise animals in our cut game!
- Idle empire: Mow the lawn to make money and develop your agricultural empire in this idle lumber-like mowing simulator! 
- Relaxing idle game: Enjoy the chill vibes of just mowing and building your dream farm in our lawnmower game.
- Exciting cut games: Sharpen your saw, get to the fields, and cut it all to become the ultimate idle lumber tycoon with grass instead of trees!
- Never-ending lawn mower simulators: Our mowing simulator has plenty of levels for you to explore and cut grass with your saw!
So, what are you waiting for, future farmer? Join the ranks of the most popular and skilled virtual farm tycoons in the world of cutting grass games!
Download our tractor simulator now and embark on your journey as the ultimate idle tycoon of the digital farmlands. Let's get those cuts with your lawnmower and create the most epic idle farm ever in our cool tractor simulator!

bluejetty:00155206:ios.description:
Brand new design and exciting new features for homebrewers at any level of experience.
Connect with the global homebrewing community and enjoy your craft wherever you go. Our new and improved Community Mobile App allows you to create, brew and share beer recipes using a variety of brewing tools, calculators, recipe styles and equipment profiles.
Use our step by step messaging system to guide you through a brew on ANY brewing system as well as connect remotely to the Grainfather Connect Control Box. You can read articles, take our Brewing 101 Course and keep track of Homebrew and Craft Beer Events on the go.
With new offline use, you can create recipes offline and sync them to your profile when you connect again.
FEATURES
• Brand new user interface
• Upgraded messaging system to guide you through the brewing process. Now also available on non-Grainfather equipment
• Create and edit recipes, brew sessions and equipment profiles without an internet connection and your changes will be synced when you’re back online
• Explore and brew thousands of community recipes from the app
• Create mash and fermentation profiles once, and easily import them into your recipes and brew sessions
• Create and manage your recipes with more styles available (now supporting BJCP Beer, BJCP Cider, BJCP Mead, and Brewers Association styles)
• Share recipes and sessions with your friends
• Manage your brewing equipment, compatible with all brewing systems
• 22 Brewing Calculators to improve accuracy and efficiency and make every brew replicable
• Manage ingredient profiles and add custom ingredients
• Monitor and manage fermentation with a range of different IoT devices including Tilt, Plaato and iSpindel
• The recipe editor now has a new recipe stats view
• Personalise your brewing experience according to your level of experience and favourite beer styles
• Take our Brewing 101 course and start your experience with some basic brewing knowledge
• Explore articles on all things brewing 
• Explore and brew thousands of community recipes
• Customise your account settings
• Check out brewing events happening locally or around the world
•   No advertising!

Love classic block puzzles with a refreshing twist? Block Puzzle is your one stop puzzle game for mind bending fun and stress relief!
Unleash the Block Blaster Within!
Looking for a fun and FREE way to play puzzle? Look no further than Color Block Blast, the addictive block puzzle game!
Classic Block Puzzle : Fit a variety of cool colored blocks onto an 8x8 grid. Smash rows and columns to rack up points and keep the board clear. Simple, yet highly addictive!

Endless Fun: With countless block combinations and increasing difficulty, Cube Block Puzzle offers endless entertainment for players of all skill levels.
Offline Play - Color Blast fun on the Go!
Enjoy Cube Block Puzzle game anytime, anywhere! No WiFi or internet connection required. Perfect for commutes, waiting rooms, or just a relaxing break.
Download Color Blast today and discover a world of block blasting fun!

bluejetty:00140418:ios.name: Video Pencil
bluejetty:00140418:ios.summary:
Make it obvious. Draw it.
Draw over any video or your camera, pause where it matters and record what you mean, right on your iPad.
MAKING VIDEOS
Tutorials, reviews and walkthroughs, with your drawings and your voice together. No editing.
bluejetty:00140418:ios.description:
Make it obvious. Draw it.
Draw over any video or your camera, pause where it matters and record what you mean, right on your iPad.
MAKING VIDEOS
Tutorials, reviews and walkthroughs, with your drawings and your voice together. No editing.
COACHING
Break down match footage and share it with the team. Put it on the TV at training, at half-time or in the team meeting, and show the whole squad what happened, and what should have.
TEACHING
Walk through a diagram, a worked example or an experiment, step by step.
NEW: THE SOCCER TOOLKIT
Made with coaches, from professional clubs to youth and grassroots teams.
• Tap a player to number them. Press play and the number follows them.
• Drag out the space a player is running into.
• Link two defenders with a line that tracks them as the play continues.
• Arrows for passes, runs and the path of the ball.
An in-app subscription.
TAKE PEOPLE THROUGH A VIDEO
Load any video from your library, play or pause, and scrub to the perfect moment. Then just start drawing. Or switch to your iPad's camera, or a USB camera, and draw over it live.
Record your drawings and your voice as a finished video, or as a transparent drawing layer to put over your own footage.
DRAWING TOOLS CURATED FOR VIDEO
Every tool is chosen to stand out clearly on top of moving pictures. Set up your favourite pens and colours so they're always one tap away. Every line responds to Apple Pencil's tilt and pressure.
ACTION REPLAY
Pause and rewind any live camera: your iPad's own camera, a USB camera or an NDI feed. Jog the Shuttle Wheel back to the moment and draw on it frame by frame, while the live feed keeps playing picture-in-picture. Save the best moments as clips.
LIVE TITLES
Draw a line, say what you want it to say, and your text appears, sized to fit your line.
ON THE BIG SCREEN
Put your iPad on a TV or projector with Apple TV, AirPlay or an HDMI adapter. The big screen shows only the footage and your drawings; the toolbar stays on your iPad.
YOUR OWN BRANDING
Make it look like your club, school or business on every screen.
DRAW LIVE IN YOUR CALLS AND STREAMS
Video Pencil connects to your Mac or PC for Zoom, Teams, Google Meet, OBS, Ecamm Live and mimoLive. With CueCam Presenter on your Mac, you draw on your iPad and everyone sees it over you, live. Video Pencil also connects over HDMI, AirPlay and USB, and sends and receives NDI, including a transparent NDI feed for Ecamm Live, OBS, mimoLive or your switcher.
PART OF THE CUECAM SUITE
Video Pencil works on its own, and pairs with CueCam Presenter for Mac and Shoot for iOS. A CueCam subscription includes Video Pencil's core features.
FREE TO DOWNLOAD
One-off upgrades are yours for life: remove the watermark, add Action Replay, or get Lifetime Updates for every current and future feature that isn't a subscription.
“Best app out there for film day for coaching that isn't $600. Love it!” Coachfro25
“I cannot emphasise how amazing this app is. It's one that I use every day on my tutorials, client calls, and live streams.” Neil Farrimond, Creator Café
“This has been my favorite tool (besides ecamm of course) of 2026! Proudly endorsed by the ecamm team!” Jill, Ecamm Facebook Community
“I use Video Pencil connected via HDMI to a TV in the classroom for live game film review and I use the recording feature to create clips for the team or specific players. I could not do what I do without Video Pencil.” Echevarria Family
Made by a single developer, working in public. Tell me what to build next at videopencil.com.

Aachho is India's leading online ethnicwear fashion house, living up to the meaning of its Rajasthani name, 'Too Good' through its curated collections.
Description:
Welcome to Aachho, India's premier online destination for exquisite high-quality ethnicwear, where tradition meets contemporary elegance. Immerse yourself in our curated collections inspired by Rajasthan's rich cultural heritage, meticulously crafted to perfection.
Key Features:
Curated Collections: Explore our diverse range of ethnicwear collections, meticulously curated to reflect the vibrant cultural tapestry of Rajasthan.
Traditional Techniques: Experience the artistry of indigenous fashion traditions and traditional techniques infused into every design, blending heritage with modern sophistication.
Contemporary Aesthetics: Discover designs that strike the perfect balance between ethnic sensibilities and contemporary aesthetics, ensuring you stand out with timeless elegance.
Personalized Experience: Tailor your shopping experience with personalized recommendations based on your preferences and past interactions, making every purchase feel uniquely yours.

Discover Designs: Explore each design in detail, with high-quality images and comprehensive product descriptions to help you make informed choices.
Personalize Your Selection: Customize your shopping experience by selecting your preferred colors, sizes, and styles, ensuring a perfect fit for every occasion.
Secure Checkout: Enjoy peace of mind with our secure checkout process, powered by industry-leading encryption technology to protect your personal and payment information.
Track Your Order: Stay updated on the status of your order with real-time tracking information, ensuring you know exactly when your purchase will arrive.
Why Choose Aachho:
Authenticity: Experience the authentic essence of Rajasthan's cultural heritage infused into every design, ensuring a truly unique and unforgettable fashion experience.
Quality Craftsmanship: Embrace the artistry of traditional techniques combined with modern innovation, resulting in exquisite designs crafted to perfection.
Personalized Service: Enjoy personalized recommendations and attentive customer service, ensuring your shopping experience is seamless and enjoyable from start to finish.
Ethical and Sustainable: Support ethical and sustainable fashion practices with our commitment to preserving traditional textile crafts and promoting handmade fashion that's inherently sustainable.

bluejetty:00145761:ios.name: Peak: Health & Fitness Widgets
bluejetty:00145761:ios.summary:
Peak lets you make your own fitness dashboard, and always stay on top of it with a range of widgets
→ Your Personal Fitness Dashboard
Build a custom dashboard tailored to your needs by picking and choosing the exact metrics you want, such
bluejetty:00145761:ios.description:
Peak lets you make your own fitness dashboard, and always stay on top of it with a range of widgets
→ Your Personal Fitness Dashboard
Build a custom dashboard tailored to your needs by picking and choosing the exact metrics you want, such as steps, workouts, activity rings, sleep, and more
→ Blocks
Peak includes a wide range of blocks for all the different metrics, including:
- Charts: Simple charts which show your progress over the day, week, month, or year, along with some stats
- Benchmarks: Heat map-style charts which show how close you get to a benchmark you’ve set
- Totals: Aggregated stats for the week, month, and year, both the ongoing one and previous ones
- Comparisons: Side-by-side comparisons of your progress against the previous period, so you always know if you’re beating your past self
- Trends: See how your progress this week, month, or quarter compares to the previous 4 of each period
- Overview: All your stats for the current week, month, or year, and quickly filter them down to view the stats for a single workout type
- Recents: Your stats for the last week
- And of course, goals
→ Goals:
Goals are supercharged in Peak. You can make any number of goals you want, and for all the metrics you have. Peak includes two styles of goals:
- Show up goals, where you set daily goals and how often you’d like to accomplish them, be it daily, or a certain of days every week or month. These are great for building new habits in a sustainable manner
- Build goals, where you set an overall, long term goal for a whole week, month or year. These are recommended for anyone who is looking to maintain their habits. Their less strict definition helps you create more flexible targets
→ Workout-Specific Stats
You can limit blocks to any workout types you want. This means that you can set a goal to go for a swim twice a week, track trends in your runs, see charts of your strength training, and much more!
→ Widgets & Complications
Peak includes a wide variety of beautifully designed widgets and complications to help you keep track of your progress at a glance. These let you keep track of your stats for today, your progress towards your goals, and more. Each widget can also be customized with its own themes, for both light and dark mode
→ Recaps
Get a summary of your progress over the past day, week, month, and year! You can also quickly share your recaps on social media with beautifully designed images
→ Workout History
Browse your complete workout history in one place. Get rich summaries of your training across every week, month, and year, and quickly filter by workout type to find your runs, rides, swims, and more
→ Workout Details, Route Replays & Splits
Dive into any workout for an in-depth look at your effort. Explore your route on an interactive map and relive it with animated replays. Analyze your performance with interactive split charts, whether you want mile, kilometer, 5K, or 10K breakdowns, or halves to see if you ran a negative split
→ Share Your Workouts
Celebrate your effort with beautifully crafted designs. Choose from unique templates featuring your route map, fun stickers, or vibrant gradients, fine-tune the themes and layouts, and share your milestones with friends
→ An Assortment of Themes
Peak includes over 80 beautifully designed themes, so you can find the exact appearance for your tastes. You can even set different custom themes for light and dark mode
→ Private By Design
Privacy is one of the Peak’s core values. Health data is some of the most sensitive data people have, so there is no tracking or data collection
→ A Delight to Use
Peak feels right at home on your iPhone, iPad, Apple Watch, and Apple Vision Pro, and includes familiar patterns and a lot of small touches to make using the app a breeze. You can customize the whole app to fit your style including the app icon, themes, units, and more
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

bluejetty:00060866:ios.name: ApprovalMax
bluejetty:00060866:ios.summary: Our ApprovalMax mobile app is a native app that provides all key decision control capabilities of the ApprovalMax web version; in particular approving on the go, raising and submitting Purchase Orders, commenting approval/rejection decision
bluejetty:00060866:ios.description:
Our ApprovalMax mobile app is a native app that provides all key decision control capabilities of the ApprovalMax web version; in particular approving on the go, raising and submitting Purchase Orders, commenting approval/rejection decisions.
The ApprovalMax web version extends cloud accounting platforms such as Xero and QuickBooks Online with fully digital processes for efficient spend and revenue management. 
For Xero, ApprovalMax provides multi-role and multi-tiered approval workflows for Bills, Purchase Orders, Credit Notes, Sales Invoices, and enables Purchase Order creation and approval outside of Xero. It also facilitates x-way matching of Bills and Purchase Orders, and supports budgeting control.
For QuickBooks Online, ApprovalMax provides Purchase Order creation and approval outside of the accounting platform.
Please note: before you can start using our mobile app, the approval workflow must have been set up in the web app.
Key features of the iPhone app:
• Approving on the go
• Instant notification about new approval requests
• Real-time chat with Requesters and other Approvers
• Due date reminders 
• PO creation on the go
• Forcing approval decisions (for Administrators)
Should you have any questions, feel free to contact us on: support@approvalmax.com

bluejetty:00179404:ios.description:
Play the card game everyone's talking about!
Download Gin Rummy Super now, play online with real players, collect rare cards, and become a Rummy champion.
Love classic card games like Solitaire, Spades, or Hearts? You'll feel right at home.
Welcome to Gin Rummy Super - a social, strategic, and genuinely fun rummy experience built around smart gameplay, friendly competition, and real people from all over the world.
Whether you're a lifelong card player or just discovering Gin Rummy, every match is a fresh test of skill, timing, and good decisions. Master your melds, keep your score low, and climb the leaderboard at your own pace. Perfect for relaxed casual play and serious competition alike.
What's waiting for you:
Daily Tasks - log in, complete simple goals, and earn rewards every single day
Rolling Events - A new rotating event with new themes and rewards, updated regularly so there's always something new
Collections - unlock themed decks and complete unique albums
Challenges - take on special missions and earn bonuses you won't find anywhere else
Royale Hunt - chase exclusive rewards in our signature event
Fun Mini-Games - quick, light bonus rounds for an extra dose of excitement
Daily & Weekly Tournaments - compete for the top spot and prove your skills
Key Features:
Real Multiplayer Matches
Play live against real people, anytime - friends or new opponents from around the world
Multiple Game Modes
Enjoy classic Gin Rummy and exciting new ways to play, each with its own twist
Full Customization
Choose from a wide range of avatars and expressive emojis, and let your personality shine with every move
Daily Rewards & Events
Log in every day for free rewards, seasonal Holiday Events, and exciting challenges
Leaderboards & Rankings
Climb divisions, earn your place among the best, and track your progress
Rare Card Collections
Unlock themed decks and complete albums, perfect for players who love a good collection
Tips for New Players:
Keep your deadwood low - fewer points mean faster wins
Watch what your opponents pick up - it can reveal their strategy
Discard cards you don't need early - don't hold onto what doesn't help you
Did You Know?
Gin Rummy was created in the early 1900s and became an American classic
Golden Age Hollywood stars often played Gin Rummy between takes
The Oklahoma Gin variant is a longtime favorite among experienced players
Why Players Love It:
100% Free to Play - no pay-to-win, no pressure
Social & Competitive - play with friends or meet new opponents online
Strategic & Relaxing - every match is unique, skill-based, and fun
If you enjoy card and strategy games like Cribbage, Solitaire, Spades, or Hearts, this will be your next favorite app.
It's more than just a game - it's a growing community of smart, passionate players who love a great hand of cards.
Download now and become a true Rummy Master.
No real-money play, no stress — just pure card strategy, fun, and friends.
For support, contact: support@zarzilla.com

bluejetty:00077485:ios.name: Doc Scanner PDF, Convert & OCR
bluejetty:00077485:ios.summary: Welcome to Scanius Pro, your ultimate solution for effortless document scanning on the go! Say goodbye to bulky scanners and messy paperwork, as Scanius Pro transforms your smartphone into a powerful portable scanner. Whether you're digitiz
bluejetty:00077485:ios.description:
Welcome to Scanius Pro, your ultimate solution for effortless document scanning on the go! Say goodbye to bulky scanners and messy paperwork, as Scanius Pro transforms your smartphone into a powerful portable scanner. Whether you're digitizing receipts or contracts Scanius Pro simplifies the process, ensuring crisp, clear scans with just a few taps. Scanning, editing, signing, and sharing multipage documents in high-quality PDF, JPEG, PNG formats has never been easier.
INSTANT SCANNING
With Scanius Pro, capture documents in seconds. Simply point your camera, and Scanius Pro automatically detects edges, enhances image quality, and produces high-resolution scans. Scan quickly and smoothly:
- Business documents, agreements, letters, invoices, order sheets;
- Paper notes and sketches so they are always at hand;
- Rent payments, credit notes, invoices, or any other printed documents.
AI FUNCTIONS WITH GPT-5.1
- Work with text. Edit, summarize, reduce, enlarge, rephrase, and paraphrase.
- Translate text into any language in one click.
- Convert documents to pdf, png, jpg, docx, pptx, txt, xml, txt, json and more.
- Use assistants: study, work, horoscope, health, sports, etc.
CONVERT SCANNED DOCS TO VARIOUS FORMATS
- Convert pdf to other docs: docx, pptx and xlsx
- Convert pdf to images: png and jpg
AUTO-CROP & PERSPECTIVE CORRECTION
No need to worry about aligning your documents perfectly. Our intelligent algorithms automatically crop and correct perspective, delivering professional-looking scans every time.
OCR - OPTICAL CHARACTER RECOGNITION
Transform scanned documents into editable text with OCR feature. Easily extract text from scans, making it convenient to search, copy, and edit your documents. 
- Extract and modify text from books, invoices, scans, and more;
- Both printed and handwritten text are automatically detected;
- Translate recognized text.
SIGN SCANS IN THE APP
E-Sign scanned documents directly on your device:
- Create one or multiple signatures within the app;
- Easily add them to any scanned pages with a single tap.
MULTI-PAGE SCANNING
Effortlessly scan multiple pages into a single document. Scanius Pro streamlines the process, allowing you to add pages seamlessly to create comprehensive PDFs.
CUSTOMIZABLE SETTINGS
Tailor Scanius Pro to suit your preferences with customizable settings. Adjust resolution, file format, and other parameters to meet your specific scanning needs.
SECURE SHARING
Share your scans securely with password protected sharing feature. Send documents via email, messaging apps, or directly to colleagues and clients, knowing your data is protected.
- Email or messaging in PDF, JPEG, or PNG formats, or save directly to Photos;
- Export to Dropbox, Google Drive, or open in any third-party application.
ORGANIZATIONAL TOOLS
Keep your scanned documents organized with Scanius Pro's intuitive file management system. Create folders and easily locate your documents for quick access.
Scanius Pro is essential for remote workers, students, professionals in various industries such as accounting, real estate, management, and law. Effortlessly digitize essential documents including contracts, tax forms, tickets, receipts, handwritten notes, and assignments, then export them in PDF, JPG, PNG formats.
SCANIUS PRO
- Subscribe to access Pro features of the app. Payment will be charged upon purchase confirmation.
- A free trial period is available with the subscription, which automatically extends to a paid subscription after the trial period ends.
- Subscriptions automatically renew 24 hours before the expiration date. You can cancel the free trial or subscription at any time in the account settings on the App Store.
Privacy Policy: https://scaniusapp.com/privacy
Terms of Use: https://scaniusapp.com/terms
Your feedback matters! Share your thoughts by leaving a review to assist us make Scanius Pro better. And feel free to contact us support@scaniusapp.com

Cloze is like a personal assistant for your professional relationships that is always prompting you at the right moment and remembering what you don’t.
It pulls from your apps to automatically create one view of every person and company - all their contact details, and your complete history - every email back and forth, your phone calls together, meetings, notes, files, and messages.
It's all organized for you - without any busy work.
With everything in one place, Cloze figures out who is important and keeps them top of mind, and will even remind you to reach out to a contact and refresh a fading relationship.
SMART AI
• Understands action items and adds them to your Agenda (e.g. "Please review and get back to me by Friday.")
• Automatically reminds you when it’s time to reach out to key people
• Sees change to email signatures to update contacts
• Create newsletters, listing descriptions, and drip campaigns with built-in ChatGPT
UNIFIED CONTACT MANAGEMENT
• Brings all your contacts into one place
• Automatically keeps contacts up-to-date
PROFESSIONAL-CLASS EMAIL
• Get reminded if you don’t receive a reply to an important email
• Be notified when a recipient opens an email or clicks on a link you sent
• Templates: Create and reuse template emails Share them across your team
• Mail merge: Personalize email sent to many people at the same time
• Scheduled send: Write your email now, have Cloze deliver it later
• Built-in support for Do Not Contact and the GDPR
• Supports Gmail, iCloud, Office365, Exchange, Outlook, Yahoo!, IMAP
CRM WITHOUT THE BUSY WORK
• Reach your goals with real-time progress updates and adaptive pacing
• Track the activity around projects and deals automatically
• Next steps: Automatic reminders of what's next for any deal
• Add To-Dos to track things you have to get done
• Agenda: one place to see all your meetings, reminders and follow-ups
• Analytics: Pipeline, forecast, engagement, activity, and lead analytics
ONE VIEW OF EVERYTHING
• Emails: Automatically organizes mail by people, company, project, and deal
• Calls: Automatically log your calls
• Files: Automatically link files to your contacts
• Notes: Automatically match notes to contacts
• Messages: Track texts and other messages about your clients and customers
• Calendar: Meeting context at your fingertips
WORK AS A TEAM
• One team-wide view of all communication for every deal and project
• Always know who last talked to any customer, client, or prospect
• Assign and track who's responsible for contacts, next steps and to-dos
• Manage your all of your company's contacts, projects and deals in one place
Cloze is free to use for contact management and as a basic email app. Additional features require a subscription to Cloze Pro, Cloze Business (Silver, Gold, or Platinum) and are available as a 14-day no-obligation free trial or by monthly or annual subscription as an in-app purchase.
Prices vary by location. Subscriptions will be charged to your iTunes account and will automatically renew at the same price as the previous period unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Once paid, a subscription is non-refundable for that period. After purchase, your subscription may be managed, and auto-renewal turned off, in your App Store Account Settings.
PRIVACY & SECURITY PLEDGE
• We won't spam your contacts
• We won't sell your information
• It's your information not ours
You can find our terms of service here: https://www.cloze.com/app/legal/terms
And our privacy policy here: https://www.cloze.com/app/legal/privacy

bluejetty:00183148:ios.description:
Ambulance Duty Simulator Rescue Driving 3D
Ambulance duty simulator 3D is one of the best game among ambulance simulation games. It’s full of actions that you need to take on emergency calls for taking patients from emergency spot to hospital in minimum time. 
Being a part of devoted ambulance team you need to rush to the aid as you are responsible for saving precious lives. In this ambulance duty rescue simulator game you have been given the role of a skilled ambulance driver, keep in mind that seconds count as you make your way through the traffic in the realistic 3D city. Transport the seriously injured people to the hospital to save their lives, make sure your selected route across the huge city must be the shortest and fastest possible one. Your ambulance driving abilities will be put to the trial. As you need to avoid vehicles on your way to the hospital. Turn your ambulance sirens on to clears the roads from cars, buses and other traffic vehicles. Have you any skills that prove you to be a real ambulance driver, precious lives are in your hands. Lives are at risk so drive with precision and be quick. You will have to be a little bit crazy driver to drive between these massive cars around the city as you are racing to the right destination.
Your duty is to pick up the injured people from emergency and accidental spots and take them to the nearest hospital for medical treatment. You need to park the ambulance at parking area to for quick rescue.
 --- Features of Ambulance Rescue Simulator 3D ---
• It’s absolutely FREE on ios app store !
• Lots of Challenging Missions
• 3D city environment with realistic graphics 
• Explore the beautiful open world
• Realistic Ambulance driving physics
• Smooth controls and fun gameplay
• Realistic intelligent traffic 
• Experience the smooth gameplay of this free driving simulator game
• Detailed 3D HD graphics optimized to run smooth on your mobile phone or tablet device
• iOS Optimization: runs perfectly on anything from the original iPad 1 to the latest 5th Generation widescreen devices.
This is the game you have been waiting for to help the injured people! So… Download it now and help the people by saving their lives.
We hope you will like our Ambulance Rescue simulator game and don’t forget to rate us on iTune Store! Thanks

bluejetty:00178775:ios.summary: Welcome to a fun and super real world of baseball. Ours is the most realistic mobile baseball game with motion captured animations & real 3D graphics. More than 50 animations allows you to play in all possible directions - swing the basebal
bluejetty:00178775:ios.description:
Welcome to a fun and super real world of baseball. Ours is the most realistic mobile baseball game with motion captured animations & real 3D graphics. More than 50 animations allows you to play in all possible directions - swing the baseball bat and smash the ball into the wall or launch it into orbit. Play matches against all top baseball playing nations, beat them all and lift the world baseball championship cups.
Wish to know more why this is the best baseball game? Here is a list of features: 
SUPER REALISTIC GRAPHICS
Unbelievably real looking batter, pitcher and fielder 3D models. We have made an effort to deliver top notch graphics quality to your mobile devices. Play the game on a big screen tablet to see the mesmerizing graphics in full glory.
PLAY OFFLINE
You can enjoy the entire game without being connected to the internet. However, with an active internet connection, you may progress faster by watching rewarded ads.
REALISTIC PHYSICS & GAME-PLAY
Our proprietary algorithm for bat-ball collision detection & response allows us to achieve very realistic feel for all the hits. Realistic physics along with motion captured animations, makes you feel as if you are part of a real baseball game.
SUPER SLOW MOTION
Watch your hits in mesmerizing super slow motion. See closeups of the ball hitting the bat. Capture and share screenshots of the batter in various photogenic poses.
SUPER REPLAYS
Ours is the only Mobile Baseball Game that achieves flawless bat-ball contact. We are so confident about our collision detection technology that we now allow you to watch replays in extreme super slow motion (more than 1000 times slower). Choose from many camera angles and see closeups of the ball hitting the bat at extremely low replay speeds. Unbelievable? See for yourself!
TOURNAMENT / WORLD BASEBALL CHAMPIONSHIP / WORLD CUP
Choose your home country from an exhaustive list of 30+ baseball playing nations. Doesn't matter whether you pick a top country like United States, Japan, Australia, South Korea or whether you pick an upcoming country like India, Pakistan, Bangladesh or Saudi Arabia, you still need to perform well to reach the top. Beat all countries to win the 1, 2, 3, 5, 7 and 9 innings baseball world championships (worldcups). More than 500 games to beat, are you up for it?
EASY & ACCURATE BATTING & BOWLING CONTROLS
Intuitive controls. Play on your phone with ease with a single hand. Strike the ball with millisecond accuracy - see how good your hand-eye coordination is. The unique quantized home rect control allows you to quickly & effortlessly pitch the baseball wherever you like.
PROGRESS BACKUP
When you use Apple or Facebook login, your progress is periodically backed up on our server such that even you if change your device, your progress is not lost and can be restored.
LEADERBOARDS: COMPETE WITH FRIENDS AND OTHER PLAYERS WORLDWIDE
See your friend's score, even if they are playing on a different platform. Share your stats with your friends or on your Facebook wall. Compare yourself with other players from your friends list or from your country or globally.
FREE TO PLAY
Progress through the game without having to spend any real money.
This game can be played by all sports games lovers. If you like cricket, tennis, football or basketball, you will also like this baseball game.
DOWNLOAD NOW!

bluejetty:00113627:ios.description:
Join the biggest growing mobile football community. Unleash your football skills to constantly changing and evolving format of the beautiful game.
Football Master is the most innovative, intriguing and intense Online Football Management Game. Create your prodigy as a legendary Football Manager by building your personal club from scratch to a World-Class champion by development through Scouting, Training, Build Up and participating in thrilling real-time Tournaments and World Leagues.
Download and Play for FREE this year’s leading Football Manager Game, crafted exclusively for your mobile devices. Now live football anytime, anywhere!
DREAM, TRAIN, BECOME:
• Officially Licensed: With official licenses from football pioneer FIFPro, along with premier clubs in the Europe, you can now sign popular strikers, wingers, full-backs and goalkeepers. One Team...One Dream !!
• Thousands of Athletes:
Scout, Develop, Trade and Play with your handpicked ACE XI, selected from thousands of choices. Sign...Train…Win... REPEAT !!
• Stunning 3D Matches: 
Witness your First XI in action in captivating 360 degrees 3D stadium atmosphere. Live the complete football dream !!
• Official Club Marks and Latest Team Kit: 
You can acquire Official Club Logos for personalizing your own club, along with the chance to equip your entire squad with the latest Official Kits!!
• Exciting & Competitive Leagues: 
Lead your team in various global game modes including Super League, Master League, Europa Championship, and Super Club Challenges. All Out... All Game... All Season !!
• World-Class AI Performance: 
The entire football action is boosted by leading and powerful AI game engine promising flawless skills, thrilling goals and most realistic passes, crosses, dribbles and tackles. Flawless Gameplay… Each time.. Every time !!
• Challenge Global Football Masters: 
You can challenge other managers from across the globe and win exciting rewards. To become the Best… Beat the Rest !!

Contact US: In-game by going to Settings -> Customer Service

bluejetty:00064963:ios.description:
A newly redesigned GTWorld application beautifully engineered and enhanced to help you manage your mobile banking and finances
Track, Pay & Grow your Money from one App. 
Introducing the new GTWorld application with a fresh new look and cool features that will allow you open an account, transfer money, pay bills, buy airtime or data, and more – all in one place! 
Key Features: 
- Open an account and onboard easily with a Selfie to verify your identity! 
- Faster login and transaction authentication with biometrics, facial recognition or a PIN 
- New Incognito mode - toggle to hide all your balances 
- Log a dispense error instantly after a transaction 
- 3-tap quick transactions for transfers, airtime and data purchases from springboard 
- Near Me transfer – which automatically locates other GTWorld users near you for you to send money 
- Keep your account funded by ‘pulling’ money from accounts in other bank using your GTWorld app 
- Upgrade your account to gain more flexibility, without coming to the branch 
- Switch between Dark and light mode based on your personal preference 
Manage your Finances: 
- Pay for bills, utilities and other services 
- More efficient transfers using your phone book contacts 
- Smarter transaction history 
- View and share receipts 
- Buy airtime and data for self, phone book contacts and others 
- Card control which allows you block your card payments by channel or by country 
- Download statements up to # months

bluejetty:00065972:ios.description:
[*] Game Features
- Cave levels are randomly generated, providing a new experience each time you play! 
- Hundreds of monsters to defeat!
- Hundreds of equipment to collect!
- Hundreds of quests and achievements to conquer!
- Enchant, Reform, Level up, and collect Gold! An abundant new world to explore!
[*] Back Story
Black Haze is a border town renown for its rich mineral deposits, which has fallen on hard times of late. In this city, it is difficult to tell the difference between good and evil. Following the mysterious disappearance of the former lord, the fragile balance of the city is disrupted. You are Royde, and you have been chosen by the king to bring balance back to Black Haze and investigate the strange reports that have come from the city.
[*] Battle & Classes
- 9 classes, each with unique skills. Build your party however you choose.
- Intricate turn-based combat lets you become the master of the battlefield
- Characters develop traits that can help or hinder. You must decide how to use them.
[*] Maps & Monsters
- Follow the story or venture off on your own to bring your enemies to justice.
- Challenging enemies will keep you on your toes. Do not underestimate them or it will mean your destruction.
- Rare and powerful enemies will challenge you. Defeat them to collect precious loot and prove your valor.
[*] Contact Us
Please contact us with any question, suggestions, concern, or advice!
Support Email: 54276264@qq.com

bluejetty:00171703:ios.name: Royal Romances: Battle
bluejetty:00171703:ios.summary: There is no such thing as a hero without a villain! It's up to you to stop the king and save the kingdom from enslavement in the thrilling "Battle of the Woods Collectors Edition" episode of the "Royal Romances" storytelling series. You're
bluejetty:00171703:ios.description:
There is no such thing as a hero without a villain! It's up to you to stop the king and save the kingdom from enslavement in the thrilling "Battle of the Woods Collectors Edition" episode of the "Royal Romances" storytelling series. You're about to embark on an exciting journey full of riddles, puzzles, object searches, and life-changing decisions that need to be taken very seriously! Are you ready to embark on another unforgettable adventure to save an entire kingdom? Heading into the woods, don't turn off the path.....
A sweet voice drifts from the rich green of the trees. The song beckons and bewitches, but it also brings terrible heartache. This is a story about people and about magic. Just when you think you have finally grasped the essence of the tale, you realize that you have wandered right into the heart of the forest, yet the path is suddenly cut off and the branches wither and die right before your eyes. There are no more birds, no creatures, no people. That is what can happen if you do not intervene. In the distance, you see dark clouds gathering over the royal palace, and you know where you should go next… 
· ENJOY THE PLOT!
Spend your time with pleasure playing adventure fantasy about love. Dynamically developing plot and intriguing story, undoubtedly, will not leave you indifferent!
· SOLVE OVER 100 PUZZLES!
Unique riddles and puzzles await you! Many picturesque locations with mysteries that you have to solve and secrets to find. Immerse yourself in the magical atmosphere of this adventure!
· THINK TWICE!
In this game you can choose a character's phrases for a particular action. Make a fateful decision, on which the development of the story depends. Will you be able to pass the magic game?
· GET READY FOR MORE!
Each quest is an episode of one big romantic story. Make your way through this series, solving riddles and finding hidden objects to move on to the next episode and find out what happens next!
This game includes a free trial. You can unlock the full version through in-app purchase.
Go through the entire "Royal Romances" series to enjoy the great story, visuals, and fully immerse yourself in an atmosphere of adventure, romance, and magic!
-----

bluejetty:00069368:ios.description:

Lyrical Video Status offers an extensive collection of high-quality status videos for all your social media stories. Express your emotions and mood perfectly with our curated library of 30-second lyrical videos, trending clips, and full-screen status updates.

Fubon Life APP allows you to keep track of policy information at any time. Personalized service and a different operating experience. Both the general public and Fubon Life policyholders can get the most immediate and fast mobile service!
"Fingerprint, facial recognition and gesture pattern" login is super easy!

"Policy Loan" allows you to borrow money instantly online to meet your urgent needs.
"Service Channel" quickly checks the address and phone number of service personnel and customer service centers, and you can call them immediately if necessary.
"My Health Management" has the function of taking photos and uploading them, making it convenient and able to manage health insurance policies independently.
★In order to provide better services, Fubon Life APP only supports operating system versions above Android 7.0 (inclusive). Please update the operating system as soon as possible to obtain better services!

-------------------------------------------------- ----------
Minimum and maximum period for repayment
The minimum and maximum periods of personal loan repayment are from the date the insurance company pays the loan amount to the end of this contract during the borrowing period. (The borrower may also repay or partially repay the loan at any time during the loan period.
Repay the principal and interest of the loan (hereinafter referred to as the principal and interest of the loan));
If this contract is an annuity insurance, the loan period will end when the contract is extinguished or
before payment starts. However, this does not apply to cases where the annuity guarantee period is stipulated in this contract or the insurance company cannot apply for an insurance policy loan before the guarantee amount is fully paid.
Maximum Annual Percentage Rate (APR)
The method of determining the borrowing interest rate varies according to the characteristics of each insurance product, as explained below:
1. Traditional products in Taiwan dollars: policy predetermined interest rate + overweight range, with an upper limit of 6.25%.
Overweight range: policy predetermined interest rate <= 2.5%: overweight 1.5%
2.5%＜Policy scheduled interest rate＜=3%: add 1%,
3%＜Policy scheduled interest rate: plus 0.5%.
2. Taiwan dollar interest rate life insurance: Take the maximum (predetermined interest rate of the policy, declared interest rate (Note 1)) + overweight range, with an upper limit of 6.25%.
Overweight range: Take the larger (predetermined interest rate of the policy, declared interest rate) <= 2.5%: Overweight 1.5%
2.5%＜Take the larger (predetermined interest rate of the policy, declared interest rate)＜=3%: add 1%
3%＜Whichever is greater (predetermined interest rate of policy, declared interest rate): add 0.5%.
3. Taiwan Dollar Variable Annuity/Taiwan Dollar Universal Life Insurance: Declared interest rate (Note 2) +1%, upper limit 6.25%.
4. Taiwan dollar investment type/Taiwan dollar Geely series products: General account weighted average interest rate (note 3) + 1%, upper limit 6.25%. ※The weighted average interest rate of the general account this year is 3.26%, and the borrowing interest rate is calculated at 4%
5. Foreign currency traditional commodities: Policy predetermined interest rate +1.5%, upper limit 9%.
6. Foreign currency interest rate life insurance: take the maximum (predetermined interest rate of the policy, declared interest rate (Note 1)) + 1.5%, with an upper limit of 9%.
7. Foreign currency variable annuity/foreign currency universal life insurance: declared interest rate (Note 2) +1.5%, upper limit 9%.
8. Foreign currency investment products/foreign currency linked bond products: General account weighted average interest rate (Note 3) + 2%, upper limit 9%.
9. Fubon Life (International) Global Dolly Universal Whole Life Insurance (FUC): Declared interest rate +0.5%, upper limit 9%.
Note 1: The announced interest rate refers to the interest rate announced by the company on the first business day of each month for the calculation and accumulation of value-added reward sharing funds.
Note 2: The declared interest rate refers to the interest rate declared on the effective date of the contract or the anniversary (month) of each policy and used to calculate the policy value reserve for the policy year (month).
Note 3: The weighted average interest rate of the general account is the "predetermined interest rate of each non-profitable product" and "the higher of the announced interest rate and the predetermined interest rate of each profitable product" for the life insurance industry's general account, based on the deposits of each insurance product. The amount of liability reserves and the interest rate calculated by the weighted average.
2. However, if any of the following circumstances occurs to the insurance product loan interest rate in the preceding paragraph, the insurance company may adjust it and calculate interest based on the new interest rate from the date of announcement of the adjustment:
(1) When an adjustment is required due to an amendment to a law, the insurance company may calculate the interest rate based on the new interest rate stipulated in the law from the date the adjustment is announced in the law.
(2) When an insurance company needs to adjust its borrowing interest rate due to changes in market conditions, the interest rate adjustment range shall not exceed "Taiwan Bank, Cooperative Bank, Third
A bank's average lending rate adjustment range for the year. If the aforementioned banks are merged, merged, eliminated, ceased operations, bankrupt, reorganized or
If one of the circumstances mentioned in Article 62 of the Banking Law is ordered to suspend business, be subject to supervision, take over, etc., it shall be corrected or cancelled, and the insurance company may choose another one.
Bank replaces it.
(3) The loan interest rate adjustment in this article shall be publicly disclosed on the insurance company’s website or in a manner agreed with the borrower.
(4) The insurance company shall notify the borrower of the principal, interest and interest rate of the loan at the notification frequency and method agreed with the borrower.
A representative example of the total cost of the loan
A representative example of the total cost of a personal loan is
Suppose you borrow 100,000 yuan, the annual interest rate of the policy loan is "4%"
One year's interest is 100,000 * 4% = 4,000 yuan, and there are no other related fees.
During the loan period, from the date when the insurance company pays the loan amount to the expiration of this contract, the borrower may repay or partially repay the principal and interest of the loan at any time)
