Welcome to the NIV Bible!
This special NIV Bible app (brought to you by Biblica & Zondervan) allows you to stream and download for FREE the complete New International Version (NIV), New International Revised Version (NIrV), and Nueva Versión Internacional (NVI) text when you create an account. Try out for free the top NIV Bibles like the NIV Study Bible, NIV Application Bible, NIV MacArthur Study Bible and NIV Cultural Backgrounds Study Bible.
The NIV is the most widely read and trusted Bible translation in contemporary English. The NIV delivers the very best combination of accuracy, readability, and clarity, making it easy to read and easy to understand. 
If you would like to learn more about Biblica’s ministry across the globe or support their work, please visit Biblica.com. For more information about the NIV translation, please visit theNIVBible.com.
About the New International Version (NIV):
The NIV Bible is…
Accurate.
The NIV translators are united by their conviction that the Bible is God’s inspired Word. That, along with their individual expertise and years of studying biblical languages, helps them to capture subtle nuances and the depth of meaning in the Bible.
Readable.
The NIV text has been carefully and thoughtfully designed to provide the best reading experience possible. Each phrase has been purposefully crafted with the end user in mind, and the NIV’s 8th- grade reading level makes it accessible to most English readers around the world. 
Clear.
The Bible should be every bit as clear to you as it was to its original audience. The NIV translators take great care to balance accuracy, readability, and clarity using global English as it is spoken today.
Beautiful.
The NIV translators also prioritize literary beauty, resulting in a Bible translation that’s suitable for both private and public reading.
Trustworthy.
The NIV is translated by an independent, self-governing team of Bible scholars using the oldest and most reliable Bible manuscripts available today. No publisher, ministry, or other group can tell the committee how to translate God’s Word and there are safeguards in place to avoid theological bias. 
App Features:
Stream and download the NIV, NIrV, and NVI FREE for offline use when you create an account. Begin your day with a daily verse and devotional reminder. Find Scripture easily using a word or phrase. Personalize your Bible reading experience by using highlights, margin notes and split screens. Listen to the Bible with text-to-speech audio, study with multiple views and take notes with our journal rich-text note editor.
Over thirty Study Bibles and Commentary, including the top selling NIV Study Bible. Other Study Bibles and commentaries include the NIV Application Bible, NIV MacArthur Study Bible, NIV Cultural Backgrounds Study Bible, NIV Biblical Theology Study Bible, Celebrate Recovery Bible, NIV Streams in the Desert Bible, NIV Essentials Study Bible, NIV Faith and Work Bible, NIV First Century Study Bible, NIV Foundation Study Bible, NIV Quest Study Bible, NIV Life Journey Bible and more. 
Other features include the ability to start a group plan or prayer list with family and friends, share verses via email, text, Twitter or Facebook, dark or light mode, read free reading plans or create your own custom plan, change font styles and sizes and sync across your favorite devices (phone, tablet and web).
Have app questions or feature suggestions? Contact us at support@nivapp.bible
See our terms at https://tecarta.com/terms

bluejetty:00121329:ios.description:
Pano Tuner listens, finds your pitch, and shows you exactly how far you are — sharp or flat — clearly enough to trust. Simple to open, accurate enough to rely on, and a favorite of players and teachers for years.
One precision engine, almost any instrument. From the lowest bass string to the top of a piccolo or harp, Pano Tuner tracks the note the instant you play — and shows both the note and its exact frequency, in hertz and cents.
MADE FOR REAL MUSICIANS
• Fast, sensitive, accurate — reacts immediately and holds steady.
• Tune almost anything — guitar, bass, ukulele, violin, viola, cello, harp, brass, woodwinds, voice, and folk & world instruments.
• Match your ensemble — set concert-A (e.g. A=442) to your group or a historical pitch.
• Read notes your way — A B C, Do Re Mi, fixed-Do, German H, and more.
• A clear, readable meter and a clean, distraction-free design.
BEYOND EQUAL TEMPERAMENT
Most tuners know only one tuning. Pano Tuner includes nine historical and microtonal temperaments — Equal, Pythagorean, Just, quarter-/third-/sixth-comma meantone, Kirnberger III, Vallotti, and Werckmeister III — and lets you create and save your own. Made for harpsichord, organ, early music, and anyone tuning beyond the modern standard.
ALSO
• Play a clean reference tone for any note.
• Adjustable tolerance, so "in tune" means what you need it to mean.
Free with ads. Upgrade to the full Pano Tuner to remove them.

Make sure you use this feature to simulate possible outfits and discover stylish ways of wearing before you buy new items!
You can also save your favorite outfits to build your own outfit portfolio. You will never need to re-think what to wear for work, dates, weddings, interviews, and other special occasions. :)
TOP BENEFITS
1. No need to stress about outfits
2. Save up to hours every week
3. Discover fresh outfit combos based on clothes you have
4. Have all my clothes in one place and keep track of outfits
5. Have my closet at my fingertips at all times
6. When shopping, check how a new piece fits into my current wardrobe
7. Save money by reusing what you have better and avoiding purchases of duplicate styles
WHAT MAKES IT DIFFERENT FROM OTHER SIMILAR APPS
1. Unlimited closet and lookbook spaces even for free users
2. Automatic outfit generation and filters optimized for speed (and saving time!)
3. Simple and basic aesthetics
4. Automatic backup of closet data in your iCloud account
5. No extra login needed; your iCloud account on your phone is sufficient.
FEATURES
1. Closet: See your existing and wished for clothes and accessories in one place
2. Collections: Group your items into custom collections and easily switch between seasonal capsule wardrobes.
3. Try On: Get an instant outfit suggestion based on an item you select
4. Add Multiple Items: Import multiple photos of items you have or want from your phone's Photo Library.
5. AI Cutouts: Our tool automatically removes photo backgrounds for cleaner item images.
6. Edit Photo: Crop, resize, and edit colors of imported item photos
7. Change Room: Explore outfit combos based on the items in your digital closet and save your favorite outfits. Include up to 15 clothing and accessory categories in outfit suggestions.
8. Weather: Check the weather forecast of your local area or next travel destination while checking possible outfit combos.
9. Saved Outfits: Check the collection of all the favorite outfits you've saved in the Change Room. Use the PICK button to remember your choice for the day or an upcoming occasion.

WHAT USERS SAY ABOUT LOOKSCOPE

bluejetty:00160568:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00160568:ios.description:
Commercial Use Only
Ekahau Analyzer is part of Ekahau Connect subscription and requires Ekahau Sidekick measurement device.
The Analyzer app is a professional grade Wi-Fi health validation and troubleshooting tool for iPhones and iPads. The auto test function diagnoses your network faster and with more accuracy than any other product on the market. The simple interface provides a quick and easy-to-understand pass/fail indication of Wi-Fi network quality, identifying network problems based on predefined requirements. These predefined requirements are the most common network issues such as channel utilization and co-channel interference
Time is precious. Every second counts. Especially when troubleshooting your network. 
A spectrum analyzer can be critical in the troubleshooting process. It records and measures the strength (power/energy) of both Wi-Fi and non-Wi-Fi traffic that exist in your network environment. This allows you to quickly identify potential interferers such as wireless cameras, cordless phones, or other wireless devices. In addition, a spectrum analyzer can show the channel of the measured traffic. This can allow you to optimize your network channels for peak performance while avoiding interference.
Ekahau Analyzer also has the industry-standard Speedtest by Ookla® integrated into an easy to use solution. With Speedtest, you get trusted internet speed measurements that help you assess your network's performance. But that's not all – complemented with Ekahau Analyzer and Sidekick 2, you also gain access to comprehensive Wi-Fi spectrum and network configuration insights by simultaneously monitoring real time spectrum analysis whilst running a Speedtest. The integration of Speedtest into Ekahau Analyzer solves a fundamental challenge in network troubleshooting: determining whether performance issues stem from your internet service provider or your wireless network.

bluejetty:00021575:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00021575:ios.description:
Spoke: Shift Day Work Calendar
Tracking your shifts has never been easier!
With Spoke, you can see at a glance when you’re working. Suitable for your iPhone and/or iPad, the clear, easily readable calendar allows you to track your working days and hours with minimal effort – you can add or remove a shift with a single tap.
Designed with shift workers in mind, Spoke enables you to see a full month of shifts on the screen, making it easier than ever to manage your working life.
Key features:
- Color-code your shifts and assign short-names for at-a-glance insights
- Intuitive rota interface for quick rotation application
- Add multiple memos for quick reminders of each day’s events
- Shift widget enables you to see upcoming shifts without even opening the app
- Share your schedule easily with friends and family
- Sync with iCloud for real-time updates across your iPad and iPhone
Additional benefits:
- See up to two shifts per day.
- Add unlimited shifts to your calendar.
- Change your shift schedule just by tapping on the calendar.
- Copy and paste shifts for rapid diary updates.
- Add your rotation and automatically fill the calendar in a few simple steps.
- Get push notifications for shift events.
- Week number with four different patterns (1-2, 2-1, 1-52, 0-51).
- Set the start day of your week to any day.
- Email your shift events.
- Share your monthly shift view (via email/SMS/print/photo album)
The intuitive shift managing interface makes Spoke suitable for anyone who wants to take the pain out of their diary management. The app is perfect for those working random hours and days, as well as individuals working fixed shifts on rotation.
People already benefitting from Shift Days include:
- Nurses
- Doctors
- Emergency workers
- Police- Firefighters
- Military- Paramedics
- Security Guards
- Cleaners
- Bartenders
- Reporters
- Students and part timers
- Taxi or Uber drivers
- Waiters and waitresses
- Truckers
- Construction workers
- Men of the Night’s Watch
---

- Spoke's auto-renewing subscription options are $2.99 monthly or $24.99 annually
- This price is for United States customers. Pricing in other countries may vary, and actual charges may be converted to your local currency depending on the country of residence.
- Payment will be charged to your iTunes Account at confirmation of your subscription
- Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period
- The account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period, and at the cost of the chosen package
- Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription to that publication, where applicable.

bluejetty:00036862:ios.summary: Overcoming addiction is hard. With Quitzilla you can follow all of your bad habits or addictions and use the app as help to analyze them and beat them. Stay clean and sober, overcome any addiction or habit which is holding you back from bec
bluejetty:00036862:ios.description:
Overcoming addiction is hard. With Quitzilla you can follow all of your bad habits or addictions and use the app as help to analyze them and beat them. Stay clean and sober, overcome any addiction or habit which is holding you back from becoming a better version of yourself.
BAD HABITS TRACKER
Commit to quit "cold turkey"! You can add the exact day of the last time you did it, the money you usually spend on it, and let it serve as your starting point. From then on you can get tons of interesting statistics about it. The abstinence time and money saved are the leading statistics. 
REWARDS
The rewards feature is actually a calculation of the money saved. For example, if you’ve spent $100 on gambling weekly, and you haven’t gambled for a week, then those $100 are your weekly reward. This serves as great motivation to quit alcohol, cigarettes, junk food, or anything similar that costs us money and is bad for our body and health.
MOTIVATION
Quitzilla also features a motivation tab in which you can add your own reasons to quit your addiction and bad habits. Simply list all of the benefits of quitting and let them serve you as a motivation for you to continue your journey of overcoming addictions. 
USEFUL STATISTICS
The app keeps relevant statistics about each of your bad habits. From entering the day you quit and maximum abstinence period, to keep a record of the money, time spent on addiction, and average abstinence period.
QUOTE OF THE DAY
To keep you motivated and focused in your quest to get rid of the addictions, Quitzilla will display you “Quote of the Day” from various famous authors.
FEATURES:
- track multiple habits simultaneously.
- easy and simple tracking of bad habits and addictions
- help in quitting alcohol, drug, caffeine, food, sugar, etc.
- customize your bad habits
- rewards system
- motivation with reasons why to quit a certain habit
- detailed statistics about each addiction
- quote of the day for motivation and keeping focus
Terms of service: https://www.despdev.com/terms_of_use_quitzilla_ios.html
Privacy policy: https://www.despdev.com/privacy_policy_quitzilla_ios.html

Welcome to the borderless open world of the Empire full of uncharted treasuries, nerve wracking adventures, loyal allies and monstrous enemies! Spice it up
bluejetty:00009424:android.description:
What can be better than a good old RPG game on a sunny day? Gemstone Legends, DUH!
Welcome to the borderless open world of the Empire full of uncharted treasuries, nerve wracking adventures, loyal allies and monstrous enemies! Spice it up with epic match-3 battles in PvP mode and limitless possibilities to level up your heroes. Still not amused? Well, tell it to the dragons of the Empire. They can’t wait to join your alliance or burn it down to ashes…The choice is yours!
THE JOURNEY BEGINS
Gemstone Legends is an epic fantasy puzzle game with a hint of magic of match-3 mechanics. Recruit the mightiest heroes, level up their skills and create alliances with mages, knights and valiant warriors. Choose the fraction you want to side with to fight for the Glory of the Empire! 
DAZE YOUR ENEMIES WITH TACTICS
To do so you will need to collect your courage, stamina and savvy mindset. Along the way you will face numerous foes to fight, have dozens of quests to solve and a pack of dragons to tame! Use the most cunning strategies to battle in turn-based RPG match-3 combats and beat the deadliest monsters to protect your kingdom!
FIGHT TOGETHER
Challenge other alliances of legendary Heroes in real-time, turn-based puzzle battles. Build strength and learn new tactics to win these challenging match-3 battles! The more battles you win the more precious resources you get on daily missions. 
Find allies and play together in a guild. Become a Dragon Rider and join forces with allies to play in a guild. Together you will earn countless treasures!
PVP ARENA
Go head-to-head with other players to show who’s the boss and earn the title of the one and only Gemstone Legend of the Empire. 
EMBRACE THE SPLENDOUR
Enjoy the vastness of picturesque landscapes. Choose a favourite among dozens of majestic hand-drawn characters with unique features and skills carefully animated by hand of masters.
KEY FEATURES
🗺 Open world RPG campaign maps
🛡 Possibility to exercise your imagination
⚡ Power-ups and magical combos to fight the enemies
⛏ Level up your Heroes and upgrade their key characteristics
🧙♂️ Single-player RPG campaign with challenging quests
🎇 Earn amazing rewards throughout the whole game!
🔥 Unleash the dragon's fire-breath and burn your opponents!
🏟 PVP Combat: Battle against other teams to see who’s the be

bluejetty:00096597:ios.description:
Save the Pets, One Bubble at a Time!
Welcome to Pet Adventure: Bubble Drop, a physics-based merge puzzle game. Tap pet bubbles from the cabinet and drop them into the bottom slots. Match three of the same adorable animals to merge and clear them. Free up space, keep merging, and aim for a high score before all slots are full.
Game Features:
- Addictive Merge Gameplay
 Tap and place cute animal bubbles into 8 slots. Match 3 of the same pets to clear them and continue the chain.
- Physics-Driven Bubble Drops
 Bubbles bounce and roll with realistic physics, making each game unique and dynamic.
- Strategic Thinking Required
 Plan your placements wisely. Limited space means every decision matters.
- Helpful Power-Ups
 Unlock powerful tools to assist in tricky situations, including auto-merges and wildcard pets.
- Clean and Colorful Design
 Enjoy polished animations, clear visuals, and a cheerful style that's easy on the eyes.
- Accessible and Relaxing
 Easy to pick up for all ages, with depth for players who love a good puzzle challenge.
- Offline Play Supported
 Play anytime, anywhere—even without an internet connection.
Download Pet Adventure: Bubble Drop today and start your journey in a world of delightful pets, clever merges, and endless fun.

bluejetty:00114844:ios.name: WDAMAGE 2
bluejetty:00114844:ios.summary:

wPhysics - the evolution of damage physics!
To create the game, we developed a unique physics engine called wPhysics, which delivers in
bluejetty:00114844:ios.description:
WDAMAGE 2 is a car simulator with advanced soft-body physics that takes damage realism to a new level.
wPhysics - the evolution of damage physics!
To create the game, we developed a unique physics engine called wPhysics, which delivers incredibly spectacular and realistic vehicle damage. The body crumples where you hit it. Doors, hood, trunk, fenders and bumpers deform separately and can be torn off. Every car part is carefully tuned by hand, we pay attention to creating physical models so that each crash looks as authentic and impressive as possible.
Realistic Vehicle Physics
Vehicle control physics has been completely overhauled. Now you'll feel the true weight of the car, its acceleration, gear shifting effects, and suspension response. The engine roar and behavior of each vehicle are unique, creating an unparalleled driving and crash-testing experience.
Garage
Hatchbacks, sedans, muscle cars, SUVs and pickups, each with its own weight, sound and handling. Upgrade the engine, brakes, gearbox, nitro and drivetrain, pick a drift setup and paint the body in any color. With the right upgrade, cars can even fly!
Polygon
A huge test ground made for crashing cars. Ramps, walls, obstacles and crash zones. Mud that keeps ruts from your wheels and sticks to the body, water, rain, thunderstorms, sunsets and a day-night cycle.
Multiplayer
Crash together with up to 6 players in one arena.
Quests and Rewards
Every crash earns you money and experience. Complete daily and weekly quests, unlock achievements and milestones, collect daily rewards and spend it all on new cars, upgrades and paint.
Future Updates
Plans include adding new vehicles and arenas, including helicopters and planes, which will open up even more possibilities for spectacular damage physics experiments.
Experience the most realistic damage simulator on your device!

bluejetty:00069379:ios.summary:
Is your phone bursting with photos and videos? Running out of storage but can't bear to delete precious memories? Bingo Album helps you accurately declutter redundant files with one tap and brings endless fun to your portrait photos. 
Key
bluejetty:00069379:ios.description:
Is your phone bursting with photos and videos? Running out of storage but can't bear to delete precious memories? Bingo Album helps you accurately declutter redundant files with one tap and brings endless fun to your portrait photos. 
Key Features:
1. Smart & Accurate Cleanup – Say Goodbye to Storage Anxiety
*Accurate Identification: Leveraging content-aware technology, it not only finds duplicate photos but also intelligently identifies burst shots, photos with similar composition, and redundant images from repeated edits, as well as unnecessary screenshots.
*Batch Processing: Automatically groups similar photos for you. With one tap, you can choose to keep the clearest, best-looking one and quickly delete the rest in batches, freeing up space efficiently.
*Dedicated Screenshot Cleanup: Specially optimized to recognize screenshots, helping you quickly clear out expired webpage captures, temporary chat screenshots, and more, keeping your album organized.
*Video Deduplication: The same powerful technology applies to videos, easily finding duplicate recordings or clips with similar content.
*Find "Space Hogs": Quickly scans for and identifies massive video files on your phone, allowing you to prioritize handling them and free up significant space.
2. Magic Photos
*Age Transformation: See yourself age or become younger with just one tap.
Free up space, organize memories, and explore novelty – all in Bingo Album.
———————————————
Data Privacy:
All your content is securely stored locally on your device. All photos are used for on-device processing only. We never upload them, and no third parties have access.
—————————————————————————————
Bingo Album offers an auto-renewable subscription option.
Payment will be charged to your iTunes Account upon confirmation of purchase.
The subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period.
Your account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period, and the renewal cost will be indicated.
Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription to that publication.
Users can manage their subscriptions and turn off auto-renewal by going to their Account Settings after purchase.
Privacy Policy:https://resource.atstudiodev.com/BingoCam/privacy.html

bluejetty:00042571:ios.name: FormaTrack: Body Progress
bluejetty:00042571:ios.summary: FormaTrack is a body progress tracker that shows how your body changes over time. Take progress photos, log your weight and body measurements, and follow your results in clear charts. Whether your goal is weight loss, muscle gain or a full
bluejetty:00042571:ios.description:
FormaTrack is a body progress tracker that shows how your body changes over time. Take progress photos, log your weight and body measurements, and follow your results in clear charts. Whether your goal is weight loss, muscle gain or a full body transformation, you see real progress, not just a number on the scale.
Take a photo right in the app or upload one from your gallery. Line up every new shot with your last one, track up to 25 body measurements, and compare any two photos as before and after.
PROGRESS PHOTOS
- Track 3 body angles: front, side and back
- Overlay the camera with your last progress photo for consistent shots
- Set a camera timer
- Compare any two progress photos as before & after, including changes in measurements
- View your photos in sequence and watch your body transformation
- Download a photo sequence as a GIF
BODY MEASUREMENTS & WEIGHT TRACKER
- Set a weight goal and follow your progress
- Track neck, shoulders, chest, biceps, forearm, waist, abdomen, hips, buttocks, thigh and calf
- Track left and right biceps, forearms, thighs and calves separately
- Add up to 3 custom measurements and name them yourself
- Track body fat %, muscle mass % and BMI
- Estimate body fat percentage, waist and hip circumference from a photo with AI
- See weight and body measurements in charts
REMINDERS, PRIVACY & DATA
- Get reminders when it's time for new progress photos
- Protect the app with a passcode
- Sync with Apple Health
- Add FormaTrack widgets to your Home Screen to see your progress and weight at a glance
- Export photos to your device and measurements to CSV
- Use metric (kg/cm) or imperial (lb/in) units
OPTIONAL MEDICATION TRACKING
- Log GLP-1 doses for injections or pills, such as semaglutide or tirzepatide
- Track injection site rotation
- Set dose reminders
- Note side effects
- See how much weight you lost on each dose in the effectiveness chart
- Export your dose history to PDF or CSV
- Completely optional: use FormaTrack for body progress alone
PREMIUM
- Unlimited progress photos
- Ad-free experience
- Priority support inside the app
FormaTrack – Body Progress Tracker subscription (1 and 12 months):
Payment will be charged to your Apple ID account at confirmation of purchase. The subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Your account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period. Renewal prices may differ depending on the subscription and pricing at the time of renewal. You can manage your subscription and turn off auto-renew anytime in your App Store account settings after purchase.
More about the app:
- Photos are saved on your device by default and can optionally be synced to our server
- Data such as weight and measurements are stored securely in the cloud, so everything is backed up
Healthy habits: FormaTrack is a tracking tool, not medical advice. We recommend discussing your eating habits and goals with a qualified professional and a physician to help prevent developing an eating disorder.

bluejetty:00036030:ios.description:
Harness the power of the world's most advanced AI models right on your phone! An all-in-one AI client that's ready to use right out of the box — no complex configuration needed. 
Core Features:
- Seamlessly Connect Global AI Models
Access ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, and other leading AI models worldwide. Regardless of which model you prefer, Chatbox lets you integrate them seamlessly. Flexibly configure your own model services, switch freely, and maintain full control — one app for all your AI needs.
- Intelligent Document Understanding
Upload PDFs, Excel sheets, images, and more. AI instantly extracts, analyzes, and summarizes your content with precision. Whether it's reading research papers, reviewing contracts, analyzing reports, or identifying objects in images — complex documents become easy to work with.
- Real-Time Web Search
Built-in web search capability enables AI to access breaking news, trending information, market data, and academic insights in real time. Say goodbye to outdated training data and get the latest, most accurate answers. Track technology trends, get current news commentary, or access real-time data — all with a single question.
- Powerful Complex Format Rendering
Support for HTML web previews, LaTeX mathematical formulas, and Markdown rich text. Whether it's AI-generated interactive pages, complex scientific formulas, structured notes, or code snippets — everything is rendered with professional-grade precision instantly.
- AI Image Generation
Powerful image generation at your fingertips. Describe what you want, and instantly create high-quality illustrations, design sketches, and creative posters. Spark inspiration, accelerate creation, and bring every idea to life.

- AI Enthusiasts → Experience multiple models in one place, explore AI frontiers with ease

We prioritize your data security above all else. All your information and conversation history are securely stored locally on your device by default, ensuring you maintain complete control over your privacy.

bluejetty:00038716:ios.description:
At idealista, we offer the most comprehensive app for buying, selling or renting any type of property in Spain, Italy and Portugal.
If you want to sell or rent out a property using our app, you'll have all the tools you need to list it and find a buyer or tenant in record time. And if you're on the hunt for a home, parking space, room to rent or another type of property, we have over a million listings ready for you to explore.
Here are just a few of the things you can do with our app if you're searching for a property:
• Draw your preferred area directly on the map. Open the idealista map and draw with your finger the area where you'd like to live. All available listings will appear instantly, along with their prices, so you can compare them at a glance. It's that simple.
• Find properties available near your current location.
• Save your favourite homes and properties. And with our collaborative lists, you can share your favourites with friends and family. Everyone can add notes, suggest new favourites or remove the ones you're no longer interested in.
• Set up alerts and be the first to know. If you're looking for a room or a new home, you know how important it is to act quickly. Once you've saved a search, turn on instant alerts — that way, every time a new listing matches your criteria or a property drops in price, you'll get a notification straight to your phone.
• Chat directly with advertisers to ask questions or arrange a viewing.
• Create a tenant profile. Advertisers tend to prioritise tenants with a completed profile, giving you a better chance of landing the property you want.
Give our app a try!

bluejetty:00151813:ios.description:
Jigsaw Puzzle Art: Relax Book. Find peace and focus in every puzzle.
Jigsaw Puzzle Art: Relax Book is a calm and beautifully designed picture puzzle game where you can slow down, relax, and enjoy the simple pleasure of fitting pieces together. Each puzzle is a piece of art — soothing, satisfying, and made to bring you moments of quiet joy.
Relax and Reconnect Through Art
- Relax and Unwind
No timers. No pressure. Just you and your puzzle. Take your time finding the right pieces, feel the satisfying click when they fit, and watch the image slowly come to life. It’s the perfect way to relax after a long day.
- Beautiful Artwork
Explore a variety of stunning pictures — from nature and animals to cozy interiors and abstract scenes. Each puzzle tells its own little story, bringing calm and beauty to your screen.
- Simple, Smooth Controls
Drag and place pieces with ease. Designed for everyone, this puzzle game for adults offers a smooth and intuitive experience you can enjoy anytime.
- Play Offline Anywhere
Enjoy puzzles anytime, even without the internet. Perfect for travel, short breaks, or quiet moments at home.
- Gentle Brain Challenge
Puzzles aren’t just relaxing — they’re good for your mind. Each completed picture improves focus and memory while keeping you engaged and stress-free.
FEATURES
- A wide selection of free jigsaw puzzles
- Relaxing sounds and beautiful visuals
- Smooth drag-and-drop gameplay
- Works greatly offline
- A mindful and relaxing brain game experience
If you’re looking for a peaceful escape or just a creative break in your day, Jigsaw Puzzle Art: Relax Book is your great choice.
 Take a moment for yourself — piece by piece, your calm is waiting.

The Crypto App stands as the #1 utility app for cryptocurrency news and tracking. Utilize its live crypto price alerts, crypto tracker, news updates, crypto converter, and portfolio tracker to enhance your trading and investment strategies.
Do you invest in cryptocurrencies? Want to track, compare, analyze, and convert Bitcoin (BTC), Ethereum (ETH), Cardano (ADA), Solana (SOL), and others? The Crypto App is an essential tool for all your needs.
One of the easiest-to-use, yet advanced crypto portfolio tracker, news, and converter apps. Get real-time price alerts for major tokens, including Bitcoin, Ethereum, and thousands more altcoins.
TRACK CRYPTO PRICES
Enjoy tracking real-time Bitcoin and altcoin prices with this coin tracker app. Access crypto charts, market cap stats, and search over over 2.4 million altcoins! It’s the ultimate crypto tracker app.
GET CRYPTO ALERTS
Set advanced crypto alerts in real time. Customize alerts for specified tokens when they hit your targets or conditions. Whether for Bitcoin, Ethereum, or Dogecoin, this crypto tracking app’s alerts keep you updated.
FOLLOW CRYPTO NEWS
Following crypto news is simple with this app. Get the leading feed for breaking cryptocurrency news and market analysis from top media providers. Use the filter to view the latest or hottest news. Set news alerts so you never miss a headline.
CONVERT YOUR CRYPTOCURRENCY INSTANTLY
Convert any coin into other cryptocurrencies or fiat currencies using our powerful cryptocurrency converter, which utilizes live crypto prices.
ANALYZE THE MARKET
Access top-tier cryptocurrency market analysis tools for actionable insights. With technical analysis screens, CoinMarketCap data, detailed charts, and powerful indicators, gain insights any trader or investor will appreciate. Unlock advanced tools with our Pro or Pro+ offering!
STAY CONNECTED WITH WIDGETS
Customize the app’s crypto widgets to monitor the market directly from your smartphone’s home screen.
WHY YOU’LL LOVE THE CRYPTO APP
The Crypto App is among the most comprehensive, powerful, and user-friendly, news, portfolio manager, and coin price tracker apps.
- Integrate with exchanges like Crypto.com, Binance, Coinbase, Kraken, and 300+ more
- Search and filter through over 2.4+ million altcoins
- Set a priority coin list to track your favorite assets
- View charts for your favorite coin
- Set price alerts
- Add crypto widgets
- Convert between numerous cryptocurrencies (BTC, ETH, SOL, ADA, etc.) and fiat currencies (USD, EUR, GBP, CAD, BRL, etc.)
- Stay updated with the latest crypto news
Applicable terms of use: https://thecrypto.app/terms-of-service/

bluejetty:00039082:ios.description:
I found myself in the restroom.
I have to get out of here....
------- features-------
・This game is a short escape game with only one stage.
・All you have to do is tap objects.
・Progress is automatically saved, so you can start from the middle of the game at any time.
・When you are stuck on how to proceed, you can proceed the story by looking at "hints" and "answers".
・Paint notes are available to help you think about solving the puzzles.
・You can enjoy the game for free until the end.
-------How to play-------
・Tap the place you are interested in to check it out.
　You may find a puzzle or an item.
・Tap the item box to zoom in on the item you have obtained.
・Items can be combined with other items or used in the field.
・Hints for solving puzzles are hidden in various places. Tap in various places to find clues.
・If you don't know how to proceed or how to solve a puzzle, you can use the "Hint" button.
　If you still don't know how to solve a puzzle, there is an "Answer" button to help you find the answer.
・If you want to start from the middle of a puzzle, click the "CONTINUE" button on the title screen to continue.
Various riddles are available in the restroom. Click in various places to find clues to solve the riddles. When you reach the end, you should be able to leave the toilet.

WHY US? 
With Raven,
bluejetty:00149086:ios.description:
Raven, “The People’s Bank of Africa”, is a digital bank on a mission to build a financial ecosystem that caters for the banking and financial needs of individuals and businesses across Africa, starting with Nigeria. 
WHY US? 
With Raven, you unlock a world of banking convenience and enjoy: 
LOW TRANSACTION FEES: 
With Raven, there are no hidden charges to worry about. We charge a flat rate of 10 NGN on transfers, giving you the freedom to transact as much as you want at almost no cost. 
BULK TRANSFERS 
Need to send money to multiple people at once? With our bulk transfer feature, you can transfer to multiple across different banks with a single click. 
TRANSPARENT INSIGHTS 
Keep track of where your money goes using our spending insights. Know just how much you spend, and what you spend on to start budgeting efficiently. You no longer have to worry about maintenance costs, debit alerts and card delivery fees. We’re giving you the freedom to bank on your terms. 
EASY BILL PAYMENTS 
Need to pay your electricity, data, cable and airtime bills? We’ve got you covered all the way and at no added costs. And if betting is your pastime, you can easily fund your wallets with Raven.
HIGH INTEREST ON YOUR SAVINGS 
We want to help you secure your financial future, and our savings feature puts you right on track. That’s not all; you enjoy up to 14% interest per annum on your savings, think of this as an investment for the future. All you have to do is choose a savings plan that works for you.
SOCIAL BANKING AT NO COST 
Get your people set up on Raven and build your community seamlessly. Send money to your friends and family without charges using our Username transfer feature. 
PHYSICAL & VIRTUAL CARDS 
With just one click, you can create a virtual card that allows you to shop and pay bills from anywhere in the world. And soon, you can request a physical card and have it delivered to your home at no cost. 
GLOBAL ACCOUNTS 
Receive money from your friends and your clients abroad using our global account feature which is soon to be launched. Bank conveniently across borders with no limits. 
24/7 CUSTOMER SUPPORT 
Have any questions or need some help? You can reach our customer support team 24/7 via the live chat feature in-app. 
Choose the fast, safe & reliable banking partner; choose Raven! 
Download the app today.
All Deposits Are Insured By The Nigerian Deposit Insurance Corporation (NDIC). Raven is powered by Beststar MFB a Licensed MF Bank by the Central Bank Of Nigeria. “Raven” and “RavenBank” are trademarks of Ravenpay LTD.

bluejetty:00022780:ios.description:
Charge to the level you want — and know the moment you get there.
Set your level and arm the alarm. Battery Care Alarm tells you the second your device reaches it, so you are not checking the screen every ten minutes or leaving it plugged in longer than you meant to.
Pick a level. Arm the alarm. That's it.
FREE 
• Set any target level and hear an alarm when it's reached 
• Pick a built-in alarm sound or import your own 
• Alarm sounds while the app is open
BATTERY CARE PREMIUM

• See the estimated time left until your target 
• Follow live progress on your Lock Screen and in the Dynamic Island

• Monthly — $2.99

Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation of purchase. The subscription renews automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel it in your Apple Account settings.

Aspora Money Transfer app - Send Money to India at Google's Live Exchange Rate
Send money to India at Google's exchange rate from the US. Fast, secure, and transparent international money transfers.
Trusted by over 1 million NRIs across the US, UK, UAE, and Europe, Aspora is the all-in-one money transfer app for international money transfers, helping you send money to India quickly, securely, and at Google's live exchange rate.
Money Transfer
- Send Money: Send money from the US to India at Google's live exchange rate with no exchange rate markups or hidden fees.

Military-Grade Security

24/7 Human Support

bluejetty:00170512:ios.description:
Reciting Counter Real LikeElevate your recitation experience with the Authentic Recitation Counter. Designed to provide a genuine and immersive counting experience, this app is perfect for anyone seeking a reliable tool for their recitations, prayers, or meditative practices.
Key Features:
Realistic Interface: Feel every count as if you're using a traditional tally counter. The authentic design and smooth functionality ensure a seamless reciting experience.
Customizable Settings: Adjust the counter to suit your specific needs. Whether it's for prayers, meditation, or any repetitive task, our app is tailored to meet your requirements.
Vibration and Sound Feedback: Enhance your recitation with tactile feedback. Choose from a variety of sounds and vibrations to accompany each count, bringing a real feel to your practice.
Detailed Statistics: Track your progress with comprehensive stats. Monitor your daily, weekly, and monthly recitation habits to stay motivated and consistent.
User-Friendly Design: Enjoy a clean, intuitive interface that makes counting simple and efficient. Our app is easy to navigate, ensuring a smooth user experience.A tally counter and tasbeeh counter app. The design of the counter is very much like the tally counter in the real world.
Features and Details about the App:
Clean and beautiful design
Recite dhikrs
Create and edit dhikrs including goal count
When reciting enable/disable haptic feedback
Reset tasbeeh counter whenever you want
Get feedback when you reached your goal for the dhikr, you will see an info dialog
Enable/disable full screen mode aka immersive mode to focus only reciting and counter
Use theme settings button to customize the counter as you wish
You can use ready to use themes also
Use My Dhikrs button to see all your tasbeeh/dhikr list
Use 3 dot overflow menu for other options like sharing, rating and reaching us
Use star/rate button to rate us on the AppStore
Use edit button to edit a dhikr
Use 3 dot button to edit a dhikr in dhikr list screen
Use add dhikr button to add a new dhikr to your list in dhikrs list screen
See a small and nice summary of your current reciting under the counter when you've made some progress
If you don't want to set a goal for your tasbeeh, don't enter anything for the goal field
See a small summary about your dhikrs and their counts on the dhikrs list screen top section
When you enable full screen / immersive mode please use back button on the top left to disable it, look closely you will see it, it's done only for the better ux in full screen mode / immersive mode
The app will send you some notification rarely to remind you to recite dhikrs

bluejetty:00023315:ios.description:
“Trials of Mana,” the hit console game with over 1 million copies and downloads sold worldwide...is coming to a smartphone near you!
Fun for longtime fans of the Mana Series and new players alike!
◆Story
When the world was shrouded in darkness, the Goddess of Mana drew forth the Sword of Mana to smite the eight Benevodons, monsters of destruction. She sealed the horrors inside the eight Mana Stones, bringing the realm back from the brink.
Weak from rebuilding the world, the Goddess changed into a tree and fell fast asleep for years. However, the forces of evil sought to free the Benevodons to gain control of the world. They started a terrible war to further their plot and destabilize the kingdoms.
Peace was at an end.
Mana itself began to disappear from the world and the Mana Tree to wither...
◆Playable Characters
Players start their adventure by selecting three of the six main characters. The overlapping story of interwoven destinies changes depending on who you choose as your main character and companions!
◆Graphics
See the spectacular world of Mana in full 3D render! Scenes and characters from the original game now in beautifully detailed graphics.
◆Battle System
Use the dynamic fighting system to evade enemies and fight back with aerial and combo attacks. Utilize the signature ring menus of the Mana Series and new shortcut commands.
◆Powering Up Characters
Switch to light or dark classes to strengthen your characters and change their look. In this remake, there’s also a newly added Class 4. With over 300 different kinds of abilities available, there are many different ways to train and power up your characters.
◆Difficulty
You have the option of four difficulty settings: Beginner, Easy, Normal, and Hard. The Beginner setting allows players to resume in the same spot no matter how many times they get a game over. If you find action games hard or want to focus on the story, select this difficulty.
◆Soundtrack
The 60-song soundtrack features arrangements overseen by the original composer, Hiroki Kikuta. Players can switch the BGM to the new version or the SNES version.
◆Voiceover
Full voiceover in English and Japanese! The characters in your party determine which extra conversations happen during your journey.
◆New Game Plus
After you beat the game once, you will unlock new storylines for your party members. You can unlock harder difficulties like Expert and the No Future after playing through the new storylines.
◆New Features
Included in the game is the option to play through flashbacks for each character in your party. You’ll also see a familiar Mana Series face when searching for Li’l Cactus during your adventures. Plus, there are additions like a new type of item seed and the autosave feature.
◆Smartphone-Specific
・Menus are touch-operated. Control characters with the directional pad overlay display.
・Newly added features like auto-target, auto-camera, and auto-battle.
・Graphic quality options available.
・Cloud save compatible.
・Can obtain the starting gear “Rabite Adornment,“ which increases the EXP gained in battle up to level 17 and “Silktail Adornment,” which increases the amount of lucre gained in battle up to level 17.
【App Download】
・This application is approximately 6.7GB in total. Please ensure you have the necessary storage space available on your device before purchasing.
・After starting the game, a large portion of data must be downloaded after defeating the first boss. You can also select “Download” on the title screen to download the entire app at once.
・A Wi-Fi connection is highly recommended when downloading the app. 
【Players】
1
【Recommended Devices】
iPhone 7 and above

No professional skills needed: upload your image, tweak styles or add witty captions, and export HD results in seconds. Our AI acceleration technology completes each transformation in seconds, boosting efficiency and overall user satisfaction.

Quickly save to your camera roll, then share your creations to WeChat Moments, Xiaohongshu (RED), Weibo, or any other social platform to wow your friends.
Who Is It For?

 • Pet Lovers: Wanting to give their furry friends a delightful cartoon or artistic makeover.

Why Choose Pixel Cat AI?
 • User-Friendly: Zero learning curve—beginners can easily start creating.

-Keep your transactions organized by allowing you to add tags, notes and photos of receipts and checks.
-Set up alerts so you know when your balance drops below a certain amount.

-Transfer money between your accounts.

bluejetty:00075147:ios.description:
Hoop Land is a 2D hoops sim inspired by the greatest retro basketball games of the past. Play, spectate, or simulate each game and experience the ultimate basketball sandbox where college and professional leagues are seamlessly integrated into every season.
DEEP RETRO GAMEPLAY
An endless variety of game options give you complete control of the action with ankle breakers, spin moves, step backs, alley-oops, chase down blocks, and more. Every shot is determined by true 3D rim and ball physics resulting in dynamic and unpredictable moments.
BUILD YOUR LEGACY
Create your own player in Career Mode and begin your path to greatness as a young prospect fresh out of high school. Choose a college, build teammate relationships, declare for the draft, and earn awards and accolades on your way to becoming the greatest player of all time.
CUT DOWN THE NETS
Create a school and build your reputation in Campus Mode. Recruit the top prospects coming out of high school and develop your school into a powerhouse program. Follow your player's careers as they get drafted and watch your school's prestige climb as they dominate in the pros.
LEAD A DYNASTY
Become the manager of a struggling team and turn them into contenders in Franchise Mode. Scout for college prospects, make draft selections, develop your rookies into stars, sign free agents, trade away disgruntled players, and hang as many championship banners as possible.
BE THE COMMISSIONER
Take full control of the league from player trades to expansion teams in Commissioner Mode. Enable or disable advanced settings such as CPU roster changes and injuries, choose award winners, and watch your league evolve over an endless amount of seasons.
FULL CUSTOMIZATION
Customize every aspect of both college and pro leagues from team names, uniform colors, court designs, rosters, coaches, and awards. Import or share your custom leagues with the Hoop Land community and load them into any season mode for infinite replay-ability.
*Hoop Land offers unlimited Franchise Mode gameplay with no ads or micro-transactions. Premium Edition unlocks all other modes and features.

bluejetty:00150789:ios.description:
NHPR Public Radio App: 
The New Hampshire Public Radio App allows you to listen to NHPR, pause and rewind the live audio, and view the program schedule for NHPR all at once! You can explore On Demand content, search for programs, bookmark a program for later, and wake up to NHPR with the alarm clock!
Live Streaming
• DVR-like controls (pause, rewind, and fast forward). You can pause the live streams to have a conversation and pick up right where you left off! Or rewind to catch a comment you just missed!
• Listen to live streams from NHPR even while traveling! Start the app and your favorite station starts playing – no clicks to start listening.
• Integrated program schedules for all of the NHPR streams! 
• One click stream switching – flip over to the program you noticed on another stream with a single click.
• Listen to NHPR in the background while browsing the web or catching up on your emails!
On Demand
• Access NHPR’s programs easily and quickly.
• DVR-like controls. Pause, rewind and fast forward your program with ease. 
• When listening to programs, individual segments (when available) are listed so you can review and choose one or listen to the entire program.
• Easy to access past programs.
• The NHPR Public Radio App displays the web page associated with the program or program segment you are listening to On Demand so you can explore for more information.
Radio Bookmarks
• Save what you were listening to (Live or On Demand) so you can replay, follow-up, or share it later by simply clicking “Bookmark”.
• Compatible with the popular Radio Bookmark device (www.radiobookmark.com).
Search
• The unique “Search Public Radio” feature finds stories or programs across hundreds of stations and web pages and makes it easy to play instantly.
Additional features
• Easily share stories and programs with family and friends via the “Share” button.
• A built in Sleep Timer and Alarm Clock allows you to go to sleep and wake up to your favorite station.
The NHPR Public Radio App is brought to you by the people at NHPR and Public Media Apps. We work to provide our valued listeners with great solutions to find what you want, when you want it, and where you want it.

http://www.publicmediaapps.com

bluejetty:00154046:ios.name: NutZen: Relaxing Puzzle Game
bluejetty:00154046:ios.summary: Think you’ve seen all color puzzle games? Think again. NutZen: Relaxing Puzzle Game takes sorting to the next level with satisfying nut-and-bolt mechanics that will tease your brain and calm your nerves – all at once. Ready to put your brai
bluejetty:00154046:ios.description:
Think you’ve seen all color puzzle games? Think again. NutZen: Relaxing Puzzle Game takes sorting to the next level with satisfying nut-and-bolt mechanics that will tease your brain and calm your nerves – all at once. Ready to put your brain to the test while having fun? Dive into the world of Nuts Sort – where logic meets relaxation, and every twist of a nut brings you closer to puzzle mastery!
Welcome to NutZen: Relaxing Puzzle Game, the ultimate color sorting puzzle game designed to provide hours of engaging and relaxing gameplay. Perfect for players of all ages, Nuts Sort challenges your organizational skills and strategic thinking as you sort colorful nuts onto their corresponding bolts.
How to Play:
Tap and Move: Select a nut and move it to a bolt that matches its color. Ensure there's enough space on the bolt for the nut to fit.
Organize by Color: Your objective is to arrange all nuts by color onto their respective bolts to complete each level.
Strategize Your Moves: Plan your moves carefully to avoid getting stuck. Utilize available tools if you need assistance.
Features:
Thousands of Challenging Levels: Enjoy over 10,000 levels that progressively increase in difficulty, keeping you engaged and entertained.
Diverse Themes and Backgrounds: Experience a variety of themes that enhance the visual appeal and keep the gameplay fresh.
Mystery Nuts: Encounter special nuts with hidden colors that add an extra layer of challenge and excitement.
Undo and Shuffle Options: Made an unintended move? Use the "Undo" feature to revert your last action or "Shuffle" to rearrange the nuts for a new perspective.
Extra Bolts: Add additional bolts when you need more space to maneuver and sort the nuts effectively.
No Time Limits: Play at your own pace without the pressure of timers, making it a perfect game for relaxation and stress relief.
Generous Rewards: Earn rewards as you progress, providing a satisfying sense of achievement and motivation to continue.
Why You'll Love NutZen: Relaxing Puzzle Game:
NutZen: Relaxing Puzzle Game offers a unique twist on classic color sorting games by incorporating nuts and bolts, providing a tactile and satisfying gameplay experience. The combination of strategic planning and simple mechanics makes it accessible yet challenging, catering to both casual gamers and puzzle enthusiasts.
Embark on a sorting adventure that not only entertains but also helps improve concentration and cognitive skills. Whether you're looking to unwind after a long day or stimulate your mind during a break, Nuts Sort is the perfect companion.
Download Nuts Sort now and start your journey to becoming a master sorter!
Privacy Policy: https://longsealink.com/privacy.html
Terms of Service: https://longsealink.com/useragreement.html

bluejetty:00016822:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00016822:ios.description:
Your baby has so much to say — before they can say a word.
Babies understand language months before they can speak. My Signing Time gives them a way to tell you they're hungry, tired, scared, or excited — long before "mama" and "dada" become full sentences. The result? Fewer meltdowns. More connection. And a front-row seat to your child's mind.
Trusted by 250,000+ families for over two decades, My Signing Time is the most loved baby sign language program in the world.
What's inside:
500+ award-winning videos in our ever-growing library!
ASL vocabulary, reading, phonics, science, and music — all in one library
Hosted by Emmy-nominated Rachel Coleman, whose warmth and energy kids adore
New content added regularly
No ads, no autoplay, no rabbit holes — just learning you can trust
Who it's for:
My Signing Time grows with your family. Start signing with infants as young as 6 months, build vocabulary with toddlers, explore science and reading with preschoolers, and continue into early elementary. Parents, grandparents, teachers, and speech therapists use it too.
Why sign language works:
Research shows that signing with babies accelerates spoken language development, increases IQ, and reduces frustration — because babies can express themselves before their mouths catch up to their minds. American Sign Language is a complete, beautiful language, and you're giving your child a head start on bilingualism from day one.
Especially powerful for:
Children with Down syndrome, autism, or speech delays
Deaf and hard-of-hearing families
Bilingual households
Any family who wants calmer mealtimes and bedtimes
Watch anywhere, anytime:
Stream on iPhone, iPad, Apple TV — so learning keeps going whether you're at home, in the car, or at Grandma's house.
Start free today.
Our app offers auto-renewing subscriptions.
You'll receive unlimited access to content on all your devices. Payment is charged to your account at confirmation of purchase. Pricing varies by location and is confirmed prior to purchase. Subscription automatically renews each month unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current billing period, or the trial period (when offered). Cancel anytime in Account Settings. 
Terms of Service: https://mysigningtime.uscreen.io/pages/terms
Privacy Policy: https://mysigningtime.uscreen.io/pages/privacy

Remember Spin the Bottle? It's back, and it's way better than you remember.
Over 6,000 truth, dare, and kiss challenges across nine game modes. The bottle decides who goes next. The app does the rest. No prep, no awkward pauses, just chaos.
How it works
- Spin the bottle, see who it lands on
- Truth, dare, or kiss
- The app picks the challenge, you just react
- Player leaderboard tracks who's brave and who's dodging

- Create your own game mode with custom rules
- Add your own questions and dares
- Works with any group size, new content added regularly
Perfect for parties, sleepovers, pre-games, or anytime you want to find out who your friends really are.

bluejetty:00150237:ios.description:
Credicentro-Coop App es un servicio que le permite a los clientes de la Cooperativa acceso fácil y seguro a sus cuentas desde su dispositivo móvil.
Para comenzar a utilizar este servicio solo necesita bajar la App y acceder al mismo utilizando las credenciales de su usuario de Home Banking. Si usted no está inscrito puede registrarse en la misma aplicación.
Con este servicio puede obtener:
- Información de balances y detalles de todas sus cuentas (Ahorros, Certificados, Cheques, etc.)
- Información de balances y detalles de todos sus préstamos 
- Información histórica de pago de facturas de comercios.
- Información de cheques con suspensión de pagos.
Además, podrás realizar:
- Depósitos de cheques (foto depósito móvil).
- Transferencias entre sus cuentas en Credicentro u otras cuentas que posea en otras instituciones financieras.
- Pago de préstamos o tarjeta de crédito.
- Pago de facturas a comercios. 
- Localizador de Cajeros Automáticos y Sucursales.
Para su tranquilidad, al igual que en el servicio de Home Banking, toda información, balances y transacciones están protegidas en un ambiente de seguridad en todo momento.

bluejetty:00155860:ios.description:
Aksent Jewelry & Boutique is a well known Midwest store and a growing online boutique located in the center of the United States. Aksent offers amazing jewelry, clothing and accessories for every lady that wants to keep up with fashion and at Midwestern prices. 
Jamie started out in 2006 with a small store front in Abilene, KS that included one of a kind jewelry made by her and her employee. The business kept growing and in March of 2011 Aksent Jewelry & Boutique moved across the street to a larger modern store front. Aksent now offers more than just jewelry which includes new clothing at affordable prices from sizes Small to 3XL, shoes, handbags, sunglasses and outerwear.
In January 2018 Jamie had a dream of becoming an online Jewelry & Boutique and in March 2018, it became a reality. Since becoming an online boutique, Aksent clothing can be found in closets from England to New Zealand and all the united state in the middle.

bluejetty:00042428:ios.description:
Meet Felix, the first AI journaling companion that gets to know you over time. Felix is always by your side, ready to listen and offer guidance as you navigate life's ups and downs.
Ever feel like your own worst critic? Felix is there to help you build a positive mindset and push back on you when you're too hard on yourself. When things are looking up, we help celebrate the good times and appreciate the little moments. You'll never feel alone in your journey towards mental wellness.
Ready to gain clarity on your thoughts and emotions, pursue personal growth, and improve your mental well-being? Build a rewarding self-care routine with the help of KnownWell. Our approach combines the benefits of journaling and therapy with AI to provide you with:
DAILY INSIGHTS
Each day, you'll receive a message from Felix, offering support and encouragement tailored to your needs. These daily doses of motivation will help you stay focused on your goals and celebrate your achievements.
PERSONALIZED PROMPTS
Every morning, you'll receive a carefully crafted prompt based on your journal entries, helping you reflect on your thoughts and emotions. These prompts are designed to help you identify patterns, challenge negative self-talk, and cultivate a growth mindset.
MOOD TRACKING
Understand what factors impact your happiness with advanced mood tracking and AI sentiment analysis. KnownWell helps you identify the people, places, and activities that influence your mood, so you can make informed decisions about your life.
ASK YOUR JOURNAL
Want to know what moments have had the biggest impact on your mental health? Or what you can do to be happier? KnownWell's "Ask" feature pulls these insights from your journal, providing you with actionable advice and personalized recommendations.
THE SCIENCE OF HAPPINESS
Learn about positive psychology, cognitive behavioral therapy, and other evidence-based tools to help you live a more fulfilling life. Our lessons are designed to educate and empower you, so you can make lasting changes to your mental well-being.
WHAT OUR USERS SAY
"I love this app. The support I get is better than from my own family."
“It’s especially good if you’re looking for something that gives you insightful prompts! The scanning feature is really cool too if you like to write things down.”
“I have tried other journaling apps before and this one stands out. The daily insights make it a lot more engaging, and I'm excited to keep journaling!”
CONNECT WITH US
Your experiences, insights, and feedback are what shape our community. Join us and be a part of a growing family dedicated to mental wellness and mindful living.
• Get in touch with us - nick@knownwell.io
For our complete terms and privacy policies:
• https://knownwell.io/terms-of-service
• https://knownwell.io/privacy-policy

bluejetty:00187925:ios.description:
The CEL-FI WAVE app allows you to easily set up and manage your CEL-FI Smart Signal Booster (sold separately).
The app does not work with any other manufacturer’s equipment. CEL-FI products supported by the app are CEL-FI CONNECT, CEL-FI GO, CEL-FI PRO, CEL-FI PRIME, CEL-FI ROAM, and CEL-FI SOLO. 
WAVE features:
- Register your booster (required by some network operators)
- Monitor and optimize the booster’s performance
- Troubleshoot any coverage issues
- Update the booster software
- External antenna aiming
The app can also be used to configure advanced settings (check the specific product), these include:
- Select a network operator to boost
- Antenna settings 
- Bands to relay
- Switch between Mobile and Stationary mode (GO G31 & GO G32)
CEL-FI is the safest, most advanced, smart signal booster available, designed to eliminate in-building dead zones and improve indoor mobile 3G, 4G and 5G service.
For more information and troubleshooting help, go to https://nextivityinc.com/support/

bluejetty:00134880:ios.description:
Keep your home or business connected, protected and one step ahead with Alarm.com. Our technology connects your security, locks, lights, video cameras and more into a single system that protects you from crime, fire, carbon monoxide and even water damage.
Our all-in-one app for iPhone, iPad or Apple Watch makes it easy to:
• Control your entire property remotely
• Know what’s going on with intelligent alerts and live video feeds
• Automate your daily security routine and other time-consuming tasks 
Our Apple Watch-supported features make connecting with home or work as easy as checking the time, with alerts, video clips and a full range of smart controls accessible right on your wrist.
Note: This app requires a compatible system and an interactive Alarm.com service plan. Feature availability varies based on system, equipment, and service plan. Visit www.alarm.com for more information.
Our smarter home security features include: 
• Control your security panel, locks, lights and more from anywhere
• Get alerts when people enter and leave, or when there’s unexpected activity
• Watch live and recorded video from indoor and outdoor cameras
• Customize your video alerts to see specific activity only
• Talk to visitors through your doorbell camera and unlock your door from the same screen
• Use Scenes commands to activate multiple devices with one touch
Our smarter business security features include:
• Arm or disarm your security panel across multiple locations
• Get alerted if the store opens late or an employee accesses a restricted area 
• Get smarter video alerts that highlight specific types of activity
• Automate your lights, locks, thermostats and more
• Track and manage access to multiple properties
• Buzz open your access control doors from the Doorbell Call screen
• Respond to alarm events and alert emergency personnel 
Dependable in emergencies and helpful every day, Alarm.com is the all-in-one solution for the connected, protected home or business.

bluejetty:00150300:ios.summary: Automile offers robust tools for fleet management, vehicle & asset tracking and mileage logging. Get real-time access to your car by simply plugging Automile Box to the vehicle’s OBD-II socket, or monitor any equipment by connecting an Auto
bluejetty:00150300:ios.description:
Automile offers robust tools for fleet management, vehicle & asset tracking and mileage logging. Get real-time access to your car by simply plugging Automile Box to the vehicle’s OBD-II socket, or monitor any equipment by connecting an Automile Tracker. Keep an eye on your drivers, vehicles and assets wherever you are.
Note that the Automile mobile app doesn’t support signing up or demo mode, which means that you need to be a registered user to access the features. Please contact sales@automile.com to get started, or support@automile.com to activate your user on an existing account.
Fleet Management & Mileage Log (Automile Box)
• Fleet management: Manage drivers and vehicles in the field
• Mileage tracking: Get automated trip logs
• Live map: Follow vehicle movement in real-time
• Driving Score: Become a more aware driver with continuous follow-up regarding driving behavior. The organization's best driver gets the coveted crown in the app!
• Expense management: Keep track of receipts and expenses
• Custom alerts: Receive a push, sms or email if someone is speeding, or idling too long
• Reports: Create reports based on your fleet and mileage data
• Geofencing: Be notified when vehicles enter and leave designated areas
• Secure archive: Access movement, trip and checkin history
GPS Asset Tracking (Automile Trackers)
• Asset management: Manage equipment, tools and work machines in the field
• Live map: Track your assets in real-time
• Theft alert: Receive a push notification, text or e-mail if an asset is moved
• Battery monitoring: Be informed if the equipment battery is running low
• Geofencing: Avoid getting alerts in safe areas by creating geofences
• Reports: Create reports based on your asset and route data
• Secure archive: Access movement, route and event history

bluejetty:00127063:ios.name: TUNY: Tuner for Guitar & more
bluejetty:00127063:ios.summary:
FOR BEGINNERS AND PROS: A smooth and accurate tuner optimized for Guitar, Bass, Ukulele & more. It integrates more than 100 tunings and can be customized to your needs. 
100+ TUNINGS
The app integrates all common tunings as well as many
bluejetty:00127063:ios.description:
FOR BEGINNERS AND PROS: A smooth and accurate tuner optimized for Guitar, Bass, Ukulele & more. It integrates more than 100 tunings and can be customized to your needs. 
100+ TUNINGS
The app integrates all common tunings as well as many alternative tunings. Use the "Search" function to find what you're looking for quickly.
Predefined tunings are available for:
▶ Guitar | 6, 7, 8, and 12 strings.
▶ Bass | 4, 5, and 6 strings
▶ Ukulele
▶ Violin
▶ Viola
▶ Cello 
CAPO SUPPORT
Adjusts the tuning to the capo position. When you use a capo, the notes on your guitar change. This can get fiddly when tuning, especially if you're using alternate tunings that you're not as familiar with. With the app, you don't have to think about transposed strings. Tip: When tuning with the capo, it is particularly important that you first tune the string a little lower and then tune "from below" towards the tone. Because the capo clamps the strings, you have to pull the string gently after you have tuned it a little lower and then tune it.
CUSTOM TUNING
Do you have special ideas on how your instrument should be tuned? "Custom Tuning" lets you create tunings for 1-12 strings and specify a different concert pitch from 440 Hz for each tuning.
CHROMATIC TUNER
Tune any instrument as you wish with the chromatic tuner. If you know which note you want to tune, this is the easiest way.
APP SETTINGS
The app can be customized to your needs.
▶ In-tune Range 
Define your "in-tune" range. A smaller range makes tuning more difficult but results in a more precisely tuned instrument.
▶ Concert pitch
You can specify a different concert pitch if, for example, you are playing with an instrument that has been tuned differently. Or you want to give your music a different timbre.
▶ Reactivity and microphone sensitivity
Set how quickly you want the tuner to respond and adjust the microphone sensitivity to your environment. If you are in a quiet environment (recommended) or your instrument is relatively quiet, you can set the sensitivity higher. In a noisy environment, your instrument should be clearly audible. You can try lowering the sensitivity a bit.
▶ String numbers
The strings are numbered consecutively. Starting with the lowest (usually thinnest) string. You can have these numbers permanently displayed to keep a better overview.
▶ Octave
You can display the octave of the string.
▶ Note names
You can choose between English (B), German (H), and Do-Re-Mi variants.
▶ Accidentals
The accidentals (# as well as b) will differ depending on the tuning. If you have a preference for one of the two variants, you can specify this in the settings.
COLOR THEMES
You can choose from different app themes. A dark mode is included in the Free version.
CONNECT WITH TONALY AND UNLOCK TUNINGS
If you are also a user of the app "Tonaly: Write & Practice Songs" you can unlock more tunings.
Privacy Policy
https://tunytuner.com/privacy/app
Terms of Service
https://tunytuner.com/legal/terms-of-service

East Trade Tycoon is a trading simulator game. In the game, you can from zero to hero. By trading markets, build a business, earn money, level up, investing accurately, and manage family to become a trading tycoon！
While running a business
bluejetty:00079162:ios.description:
East Trade Tycoon is a trading simulator game. In the game, you can from zero to hero. By trading markets, build a business, earn money, level up, investing accurately, and manage family to become a trading tycoon！
While running a business, we can also experience life simulator, you can get married, have children, and mark your family stronger. With the growth of family members, they can also do business with you, work and earn money, which is an indispensable help for us to grow into a trading tycoon.
The ultimate goal of the game is to be the richest man, to be the biggest businessman in every city, and to have a strong family so that our career can be passed on forever.
Game feature：
-80 cities, nearly 100 kinds of goods, have a real simulation economic system, commodity prices go up and down, you need to buy low and sell high at the most appropriate time, earn money through price differences, achieve wealth growth, and become a trade master.
-Strengthen your caravan, increase the number of your caravan, increase the carrying capacity of goods, so that each transaction can make more money and profits!
-Exercise eloquence, management, charm, improve yourself and family members, and make trade more powerful.
-Mysterious props can increase the quantity of each transaction and the ability to reduce the price during the transaction. Try to reach the conditions and get them！
-Life simulation, family members will be born, old age, sickness and death, each person has an independent appearance system, talent system, train your strongest heir!
-You can set up a business in every city, which will automatically and extra ear money and fame for you. You just need to invest in it, upgrade it, and the business will give you a good return.
-Accomplishing a variety of trade tasks is the secret to becoming a trade tycoon quickly.
-The game will record all kinds of growth data and trade data, and when you become a trading tycoon, it must be very impressive to look back on the road you have traveled.
Finally, I hope this trade simulation game can bring you happiness. If you have any questions, please contact us via email: hiwhalex@gmail.com

bluejetty:00007192:ios.description:
Welcome to Coinlytics - Widgets (Home Screen & Lock Screen), News and Alerts for your Bitcoin, Mempool fees and other crypto assets.
Coinlytics gives you nearly unlimited customization in how to visualize your Bitcoin, mempool and crypto tokens. It comes with over 50 distinct designs/themes, over 170 foreign exchange currencies, 14 Widget types, 13 timeframes and access to thousands of coins and tokens. You can track crypto prices or your own portfolio by specifying your holdings.
Coinlytics is secure and totally anonymous. Just open up the app and start using it straight away. There is no log in and no personally identifiable information that is shared with us.
Once you've set up your watchlist, jump back to your home screen and start adding widgets! You can add as many as you like and each widget can be totally customized. You can choose which coins to visualize, which currency you want to see pricing in, which timeframe to use for graph visualizations and of course which coins you want to see. Whether you're a pure Bitcoiner or if you're into all the alt-coins - Coinlytics is the best way for you to keep track of your Bitcoin and crypto.
Want to check your Bitcoin, Mempools fees or crypto pricing on the go on your Apple Watch? You can track as many coins as you want and customize your watch faces with complications for nearly every watch face. Our Apple Watch app talks to your iPhone for real time updates, if you're on the go with only your cellular Apple Watch, Coinlytics will work independently and pull pricing straight off the network.
Coinlytics supports over 100 currencies including fiat, metals and of course the most popular cryptocurrencies. 
You can check pricing for thousands of coins. If there's a coin that we don't support, just drop us a line and we'll add it to our database.
Our alerting engine gives you a powerful way to keep up to date with the most important events happening in the world of crypto. Coinlytics supports 9 different categories of alerts including Market Cap, Volume, Periodic Updates, Wallet Alerts, News, Price and Percent Change. We also have a new (free) daily market update alert with up to three coins per alert.
Pricing and terms: We offer monthly, subscription or a lifetime subscription for advanced features such as alerting, premium widget designs and unlimited coins on your Apple Watch. The annual subscription is available with a 7 day free trial. Subscriptions automatically renew unless turned off in your iTunes account at least 24 hours before your current period ends. Go to your Apple ID settings to manage your subscription and turn off auto-renew. Your iTunes account will be charged when the purchase is confirmed.
See our terms, conditions and privacy statements at:
 Terms: https://www.coinlytics.com/terms
 Privacy: https://www.coinlytics.com/privacy

bluejetty:00038633:ios.description:
Avec eDocPerso, stockez et partagez vos documents en toute sécurité !
À utiliser sans modération, votre coffre-fort numérique est individuel, gratuit et disponible à vie.

- Accédez à votre coffre-fort de façon pratique et sécurisée par Touch ID/Face ID. 
- Retrouvez de manière automatique vos bulletins de salaire et autres documents administratifs dans la catégorie “Mes employeurs”. 
- En quelques clics, stockez et archivez vos fichiers numériques sensibles grâce aux fonctions d’import et scan de documents. 
- Partagez vos documents avec un tiers via l’envoi d’un lien sécurisé.
- Personnalisez votre espace de stockage à votre guise avec une classification par catégories et dossiers. 
Accessible à tout moment, votre coffre-fort numérique vous garantit une gestion simple et une protection optimale de vos données. 
Avec l’application mobile eDocPerso, stockez, organisez et partagez des documents devient un jeu d’enfants !
