bluejetty:00023129:ios.name: Heart Rate Plus: Pulse Monitor
bluejetty:00023129:ios.summary:
Check your heart rate anytime, anywhere with the Heart Rate Plus app - at your home or office - when you wake up, relax, before and after exercise.
AMAZING FUNCTION
The Heart Rate Plus app will measure your heartbeat using your smartphone
bluejetty:00023129:ios.description:
Check your heart rate anytime, anywhere with the Heart Rate Plus app - at your home or office - when you wake up, relax, before and after exercise.
AMAZING FUNCTION
The Heart Rate Plus app will measure your heartbeat using your smartphone's camera by processing the images of your pulse on your finger!
The app detects color changes in your fingertip when your heart beats and uses an advanced algorithm to count the heart rate, similar to how a pulse oximeter works.
FAST RESULTS
Instant, accurate, and excellent for monitoring your fitness and wellness.
Use your smartphone's camera; this app can be your heart rate monitor anywhere while being physically active.
APP FEATURES
- Fast, continuous, and accurate measurement.
- Save unlimited results with tags for access later.
- Real-time pulse graph (PPG - photoplethysmogram).
- Reminder: Automatically reminds you to measure your heartbeat every day.
- Share your heart rate screenshot to Facebook, Twitter, or Instagram.
- Export history to CSV or PDF file format; PDF file includes PPG graph. (Premium)
- Apple Health support (optional, check on Settings).
- Back up, restore and transfer your data. (Premium)
USER GUIDE
- Hold the tip of your index finger over the back camera lens of your phone.
Do not press too hard, or you will restrict circulation, which will result in an inaccurate reading.
- After a second or two, you should see your heart pulse graph.
Hold your finger still for five more seconds to compute your heart rate and update the number.
Hold your finger for 10 seconds to get a stable and accurate heart rate.
DISCLAIMER
- Our app should not be used as a medical device or product; designed for general fitness and wellness purposes only.
Consult your doctor or primary care physician if you require medical purposes.
- Our app is not intended for use in diagnosing disease or other conditions or in the cure, mitigation, treatment, or prevention of disease.
*** If you like this app, you can remove ads and unlock pro features from the menu by purchasing Premium.
*** We welcome your ideas and suggestions; please email us at: support+heartrate@pvdapps.com
Follow our official Facebook page: https://www.facebook.com/HeartRatePlusApp or Twitter account: https://twitter.com/pvdapps.

bluejetty:00157704:ios.name: The Electric State: Kid Cosmo
bluejetty:00157704:ios.summary:
NETFLIX MEMBERSHIP REQUIRED.
Kid Cosmo needs your help! Blast through an '80s-inspired puzzle adventure game-within-a-game alongside boy wonder Chris and his big sister Michelle.
Wichita, Kansas — 1985: Go on a journey through the eyes of
bluejetty:00157704:ios.description:
NETFLIX MEMBERSHIP REQUIRED.
Kid Cosmo needs your help! Blast through an '80s-inspired puzzle adventure game-within-a-game alongside boy wonder Chris and his big sister Michelle.
Wichita, Kansas — 1985: Go on a journey through the eyes of Chris, an intellectually gifted child, and his older sister Michelle as they navigate coming of age in the retro-futuristic world of "The Electric State." This narrative-driven game takes place before the events of the movie and spans five years, blending gameplay with emotional storytelling to create an immersive experience.
ALWAYS REMEMBER, KID COSMO'S YOUR PAL!
Experience "Kid Cosmo: Martian Marooner," a fully realized retro game on Chris's handheld console, the PX-1. Inspired by classic 1980s games, this top-down puzzle adventure features grid-based movement and creative problem-solving. Guide Kid Cosmo through each dungeon, using boosters like the Zoomerang and Jet Pack to overcome challenges and defeat robots.
BECOME PART OF THE STORY
Transition seamlessly between solving puzzles on the PX-1 and witnessing key moments in Chris and Michelle's lives. A reactive dialogue system pairs the characters' commentary with your gameplay in real time, drawing you into their sibling relationship.
TAKE CARE OF YOUR CONSOLE
Use your phone’s tilt and touch functions to interact with the PX-1 in different ways throughout the story. You might need to wipe dust from the screen, muffle the speaker to avoid detection, choose where to place a sticker or rush to a save point before the battery dies.
- Created by BUCK Games.

Earth Class Mail helps people make their postal mail paperless. As a leading provider of virtual mailboxes and virtual business addresses in the United States, we give individuals around the world and companies of all sizes the ability to access their mail from anywhere, anytime.
We scan your mail, automatically deposit checks, and integrate with popular cloud services, all while keeping your mail and data secure. Customers can deposit checks, pay bills, and share documents online, all without ever touching an envelope.
HOW EARTH CLASS MAIL WORKS
- Select a preferred virtual business address from our network of 40+ addresses. We receive your mail and process it at our secure facilities.
- We scan your mail items, convert them into a PDF with searchable text, and securely deliver them to your account.
- You access your postal mail and deposit checks online. View your digital mail and decide what you want to do with it: shred it, share it, or ship it with the Earth Class Mail app.
OUR MAIN PRODUCTS
- Mailbox: We offer small businesses and individuals a way to digitize their postal mail. We’ll forward your mail to our secure processing facility from one of our virtual business addresses and you’ll receive high-resolution PDFs that you can access anywhere.
- Business Address: Our national network of 40+ U.S. addresses and PO boxes give your business the prestigious address you want—without the price tag. Share your virtual business address with customers, business partners, and investors.
THE MAIN FEATURES EARTH CLASS MAIL OFFERS
- Mail scanning: View the contents of your digitized mail with our full-text search feature that allows you to find any piece of mail, no matter when you received it. We'll convert your postal mail into high-resolution PDFs so you can search them like you do with emails.
- Mail forwarding: Forward the original copies of your postal mail anywhere or share the PDF of the document with anyone. Receive push notifications when your shipment is on its way.
- Secure shredding: Safely destroy documents and keep the digital copies you need. Enable secure shredding on any plan and safely destroy documents you don't need anymore – keep the digital copies if you want.
- Check deposit: Get paid faster and save time you would've spent scanning checks or making a trip to the bank. Our check deposit feature automates your workflow by mailing your check directly to your bank for deposit. 
Managing your mail has never been easier. All you need is an Earth Class Mail account to get started!

bluejetty:00186873:ios.summary: The BibleStudyTools.com Bible app gives you free access to the largest library of study Bible versions including the King James Bible (KJV), New International Version (NIV), The Message (MSG), English Standard Version (ESV) and more. As wel
bluejetty:00186873:ios.description:
The BibleStudyTools.com Bible app gives you free access to the largest library of study Bible versions including the King James Bible (KJV), New International Version (NIV), The Message (MSG), English Standard Version (ESV) and more. As well as various language translations, commentaries, concordances and more. Download this Bible app to begin using all the amazing Bible study resources at BibleStudyTools.com, in an easy to use mobile version!
In addition to your basic Bible search function, the Bible app from BibleStudyTools.com also allows for personalization of your Bible study on your device. Highlight verses and take notes on your favorite Scripture! A great way to challenge your personal Bible study time is with Bible reading plans – choose from different daily reading plans to fit your schedule!
Features:
READ YOUR FAVORITE TRANSLATION
- Easy to use Bible search functions for all available Bible versions
including the popular New International Version (NIV), King James Version
(KJV), English Standard Version (ESV), American Standard Version (ASV), the
Message (MSG), New Living Translation (NLT) and more.
- Translations of the Bible in different languages like Spanish, Portuguese, Chinese, German, Italian and others.
PERSONALIZE YOUR STUDY BIBLE
- Save Bible notes 
- Highlight Bible verses or passages 
- Change font size for easier reading
- Select the font of your choice
- Change the app color theme to your liking
- Change to night theme for lowlight conditions
- Access and sync your personal account from BibleStudyTools.com for use on the Bible app
DAILY READING PLAN
- Bible verse of the day 
- Start a daily Bible reading plan and track your progress
- Free Bible reading plans by topic, Book of the Bible, Chronological and more.
- Bible reading plans for 90 days, yearly or at your own pace.
FREE BIBLE STUDY LIBRARY
- Engage with the Scriptures by accessing the Libraries with each verse with Commentaries, Reference notes, Encyclopedias, and Study Bibles.
- Get a deeper understanding of the Bible with free Commentaries from Matthew Henry, Scofield, Jon Wesley, Martin Luther and others.
- Free well know Concordances like Strong’s, Torrey’s, Nave’s & the Treasury of Scripture Knowledge.
- Explore the meaning of the of the text with dictionaries like Baker’s Evangelical Dictionary, Easton’s Bible Dictionary, King James Dictionary amongst others.
- Learn about the historical facts surrounding the Bible with Fox’s Book of Martyrs, The Works of Flavius Josephus and more. 
- Start Bible word studies with Lexicons for the New Testament and Old Testament.
- Read Hymns, Classics and timeless sermons 
VERSES BY TOPIC
- Be inspired with Bible verses by topic with verses for encouragement, friendship, forgiveness, hope, love, strength, inspiration and more
BIBLE STUDY COMMUNITY
- Join in the community Bible study with notes focusing on specific topics and passages
- Tap verses to share through social media like Twitter and Facebook or through email and text messages.
Now available to install for free. Grow closer to Jesus Christ and in your Christian walk with the Bible Study Tools app from BibleStudyTools.com. Take your favorite Bible version, verse studies, devotional notes, and daily reading plans on the go!

bluejetty:00100243:android.description:
🚀 Advanced AI & Plagiarism Scanning Platform
The Ultimate Toolkit for Students, Professionals, and Educators
Stop worrying about originality and integrity. This Advanced AI & Plagiarism Scanning Platform is your all-in-one solution for creating, optimizing, and verifying content with unparalleled accuracy and speed. Leveraging state-of-the-art AI technology, we help you ensure every document is authentic, well-written, and entirely your own.
✨ Key Features
1. Cutting-Edge Plagiarism Detection
Deep Scan Technology: Go beyond basic text matching. Our advanced algorithms scan billions of documents, web pages, and academic sources to detect subtle forms of plagiarism, including paraphrasing and mosaic plagiarism.
Source Citation & Report: Get instant, detailed reports highlighting matched text and providing direct links to the original sources for easy review and correction.
Multiple File Formats: Easily upload and scan documents in formats like DOCX, PDF, TXT, and more.
2. Advanced AI Content Detection
Verify Authenticity: Are you reviewing a submission? Our platform accurately distinguishes between human-written and AI-generated text from leading models (like GPT-4, Gemini, etc.), helping you maintain academic and professional standards.
Transparency & Trust: Use our AI detection tools to provide confidence in the originality of your work or the submissions you receive.
💡 Who Is This App For?
Students: Ensure essays, papers, and thesis submissions are 100% original and academically sound.
Educators/Teachers: Quickly and reliably check student assignments for both intentional plagiarism and AI-generated content.
Content Creators & Bloggers: Verify the originality of drafted articles before publication to protect your reputation and SEO ranking.
Business Professionals: Create high-impact, error-free reports and communications.
🔒 Security & Privacy
Your documents are safe with us. We prioritize your data security and privacy. All uploaded documents are encrypted, and we never share, sell, or claim ownership over your content.
Download the Advanced AI & Plagiarism Scanning Platform today and write with confidence!
➡️ Get started now and unlock the power of originality!

bluejetty:00121257:ios.description:
TOP 5 REASONS TO DOWNLOAD EURONEWS
 #1 — All time access to the news, reports, and magazines
 #2 — TV in live-streaming
 #3 — Video On Demand (VoD) : Various programs on International News, Sport, Politics, Finance Environment, Travel, Tech and more
 #4 — Special features of mobile data saving & offline mode
 #5 — Giving access to trusted & relevant news from a European Independent newsroom.
STAY CONNECTED ANYTIME, ANYWHERE WITH EURONEWS FOR IOS
Euronews covers news and human stories to bring a comparative view on how things are going in European countries.
Catch the latest breaking news, watch the hot topic and world news in the Euronews app. Follow live-streaming videos, live TV and VoD, top stories, headlines and various programs on International News, Europe, Politics, Sport, Finance, Environment, Tech and much more available in our different sections: My Europe, World, Business, Sport, Green, Next, Travel, Culture, and Video.
THE EURONEWS APP OFFERS
 — Up-to-date European and world news in video streaming or text
 — Live 24/7: Euronews TV in live-streaming to watch video news of European countries
 — Home: our Editor’s choice for global news
 — Latest: constantly updated timeline of all the news, reports, and magazines
 — Your favorites programs in VoD (Video On Demand) : No Comment, The Europe Conversation, European stories, Europe in motion, EU decoded 
 — Must have features:
 A dark mode to optimize the reading comfort
 An offline mode - Read breaking news articles without Internet connection
 A data savings feature to use less mobile data
EURONEWS AVAILABLE ON APPLE TV AND APPLE WATCH 
Find all the European and international news about politics, culture, business, travel, and sports on your Apple TV and Apple Watch
MANAGE DATA SPEND AND USAGE 
 This app has been designed to let you manage your data plan with: 
 — The data savings feature: choose if you want pictures, enriched stories or simply a text raw version 
 — The offline mode: download the articles for an offline reading. Once you enable Euronews’ offline mode, you can safely switch your smartphone to Airplane mode. 
 Note: the offline mode can be combined with the data savings feature. In that case, downloading content will use less data.
THE EURONEWS APP IS AVAILABLE IN 13 EDITIONS
— English
— French
— German
— Italian
— Spanish
— Portuguese
— Russian
— Turkish
— Greek
— Hungarian
— Persian
— Arabic
— Polish
ABOUT US
The number 1 international news channel in the European Union. Resolutely impartial and independent. Euronews broadcasts multilingual global news with a distinctive European perspective on both TV and digital platforms. Reaching over 400 million TV households in 160 countries, including 82% of households in the EU and UK, and 29 million followers across all social media platforms. Since 1993, Euronews has been the leader in European news, resulting in a unique European identity and multilingual model across 13 language editions and five branded affiliates.
HELP US MAKE EURONEWS APP BETTER
Thanks for your support and useful comments!
Your feedback is essential for us to continue developing our app. Send us your comments and suggestions on these new features via the application on the menu "Your feedback" or by email at appsupport@euronews.com.
JOIN US ALSO ON
 https://www.euronews.com
 https://facebook.com/euronews
 https://www.instagram.com/euronews.tv
https://x.com/euronews
 https://youtube.com/euronews
DISCOVER & DOWNLOAD THE EURONEWS APPS
www.euronews.com/apps
*Euronews live stream
• Available in English only on Arabic, Persian and Turkish editions.
— Functionality not available in Turkey and Singapore due to distribution rights, in the English language.

bluejetty:00061409:ios.description:
MiFinity is a secure digital wallet for online payments, money transfers and multi-currency money management. Trusted by more than 1 million customers, MiFinity lets you pay online, add funds, send money and manage multiple currencies from one easy-to-use app. 
PAY ONLINE WITH MIFINITY 
• Use your MiFinity eWallet to pay at participating online merchants. Choose from more than 75+ payment methods, depending on your location, account status and availability. 
ADD FUNDS YOUR WAY 
• Top up using available cards, bank transfers, local payment methods or a MiFinity eVoucher. The funding options shown in your account depend on your country, verification status and eligibility. 
SEND MONEY AND WITHDRAW FUNDS 
• Make money transfers to other MiFinity users using their registered email address or account number. You can also withdraw funds to supported bank accounts where available. Fees, limits, currencies and processing times vary. 
MANAGE UP TO 9 WALLETS IN 18 CURRENCIES 
• Keep your balances organised across up to nine eWallets. Move money between your own wallets and convert supported currencies. Terms and conditions apply subject to your acceptance. 
EARN REWARDS WITH MIREWARDS 
• Earn MiPoints through qualifying wallet activity and redeem them for available cash credit rewards. Progress through MiRewards tiers to access additional benefits. Eligibility, availability and programme terms apply. 
VIRTUAL IBAN FOR ELIGIBLE CUSTOMERS 
• Verified customers in the UK and EEA may be able to request a GBP or EUR Virtual IBAN, subject to eligibility and availability. Use it to add funds by supported bank transfer with no MiFinity deposit fee. Your bank or any another provider may apply additional charges. 
SECURITY AND ACCOUNT CONTROL 
• Biometric sign-in on supported devices 
• Two-factor authentication 
• PCI DSS Service Level 1 compliance 
• Strong Customer Authentication 
• Transaction history and account notifications 
GLOBAL ACCESS, LOCAL CHOICE 
• MiFinity is available in more than 223 countries and territories and supports 21 languages. Services, features, payment methods and currencies vary from country by country and are subject to eligibility, verification, limits, T&Csand applicable fees. 
Download MiFinity to manage online payments, money transfers, eVouchers and multiple currencies from one secure eWallet. 
Fees and limits: https://www.mifinity.com/fees/ 
Learn more: https://www.mifinity.com/ 
COMPLIANCE AND MONITORING 
• Transactions are monitored for compliance with applicable laws and regulations. 
• We may request additional information and/or supporting documentation to process or complete a payment. 
• Providing false or misleading information may result in account termination and closure. 
REGULATORY INFORMATION 
MiFinity UK Limited, trading as MiFinity, is authorized by the Financial Conduct Authority under the Electronic Money Regulations 2011 [Register Ref. 900090] to issue electronic money. Registered in Northern Ireland. Suite B 6th Floor, City Exchange, 11-13 Gloucester St, Belfast BT1 4LS, United Kingdom. Registration number NI611169. 
Mifinity Malta Limited is a limited liability company incorporated and registered under the Laws of Malta with company registration number C 64824. Moreover, Mifinity Malta Limited is authorised by the Malta Financial Services Authority (MFSA), bearing Authorised Person ID: MFT, to carry out payment services and e-money services and is a local Financial Institutions licensed to provide Payment Services under the 2nd Schedule and issue electronic money under the 3rd Schedule to the Financial Institutions Act (Electronic Money Institutions) exercising the freedom to provide services outside Malta.

bluejetty:00014973:ios.description:
Zbuloni një mënyrë të re, argëtuese dhe interaktive për mësimin e alfabetit në gjuhën shqipe!
Ky aplikacion edukues është krijuar për fëmijët që po mësojnë shkronjat për herë të parë — për t’i ndihmuar të mësojnë 36 shkronjat e Alfabetit të Gjuhës Shqipe përmes lojës, ilustrimeve dhe narracionit të gjallë.
Në vend që mësimi të jetë i vështirë, fëmijët sfidohen e argëtohen duke kaluar nivele të ndryshme dhe duke fituar yje për çdo sukses. Muzika, efektet zanore dhe zërat e fëmijëve krijojnë një përvojë të ngrohtë e të afërt për çdo vogëlush.
Veçoritë kryesore:
- Mësimi i shkronjave me narracion dhe interaktivitet
- Shkrimi i shkronjave në tabelë të zezë me katër ngjyra të ndryshme
- Vlerësim me yje për çdo përpjekje — 3 yje për shkrim perfekt!
- Përdorim i lehtë me dizajn miqësor për fëmijët
Lojërat për argëtim dhe sfidë përfshijnë:
- Madhështori – Bashko shkronjat e mëdha me të voglat
- Sfiduesi – Zbulo shkronjën e duhur nga copëzat
- Zbuluesi – Mbaje mend shkronjën dhe gjej ilustrimin përkatës
- Treni – Gjej shkronjën e saktë sipas ilustrimit në tren
Një mënyrë unike për të mësuar, luajtur dhe dashuruar alfabetin shqip!

bluejetty:00177436:ios.description:
Welcome to the Doll Finder app. We are here to help you to identify your favorite dolls. Dolls recognition is the best way to find more details about your "unknown" doll. It's super easy to identify your doll today: 
1. Take a picture of your doll
2. Get results on "My Results" screen.
We will find it among hundreds of dolls of the most US / America popular series and brands and provide information about your doll, like Brand and doll name, and more. Today, we covered US brands and other worldwide doll brands. 
Don't see the doll in the list and would like to see it on the Home tab? Email us and we will add it to the app in the next release! Have suggestions or feature requests we are always open to chat and discuss them.
The app is going to be very helpful for people who are reselling dolls and can't identify dolls or find them on the internet as well as for just curious people and kids, who are looking for names and doll stories.
Search for and recognize the best and most popular American doll. For girls and boys!
IDENTIFY:
• Go to Identify tab and tap "Get Started" button
• Take a picture or upload existing pictures of your dolls
• And get results in the "My Results" view!
SHOP:
• Find available dolls for sale
• We ship as fast as we can on any available inventory.
• Only verified sellers
• Secure checkout
• Shipping is available within US ONLY.
SELL ("Marketplace for dolls") - MAKE THE DOLL FINDER APP WORK FOR YOU:
• Have dolls for sale? Try our marketplace for dolls and more.
• Available categories: Dolls, Toy (doll) Furniture, Doll Clothes, Toys Accessories
• Take a picture or upload multiple pictures of your product, add details, set your price, and publish.
• Unlimited Products for posting
• Free listings
• List items in seconds with handy features to help you make money.
FILTERS:
• Manually identify your dolls from the list by using available filters
• Select eyes color and hair color and get results
• Know the name? Start typing the name to see if the doll is on the list.
QUIZ:
• Would like to check your doll knowledge? Try out our quiz feature!!
• Try to hit 5 stars by answering all the questions correctly! We love dolls and hope you do!
• This app and quiz are all about your favorite dolls. 
********** Less ads and more action and information **************
KEEP IN TOUCH
Your feedback is important to us. Please contact us with any questions by tweeting @DollFinderApp or https://studiogoal.com/#contact
This is awesome! You have your "unknown doll" and we can help you to recognize it! Download the app to start identification today.

“A must-have Personal Assistant” – MSN
“Top iPhone App for Busy Women” – Forbes
“Simple yet ingenious” – Popular Science
“What’s Hot” – App Store
YOUR CYCLE. YOUR HEALTH. YOUR WAY.
Whether you're tracking periods, planning for pregnancy, observing fertility signs, or navigating perimenopause, iPeriod helps you record what matters to you.
WHY WOMEN CHOOSE iPERIOD
• Trusted since 2008, with millions of downloads
• Beautifully redesigned Home screen and interactive cycle ring
• Intuitive calendar with cycle history and predictions
• Easy daily tracking of periods, symptoms, moods, and more
• Expanded symptom library, including perimenopause and menopause-related symptoms
• Personalized period and fertile-window estimates
• Customizable tracking, charts, and reports
• Discreet reminders and familiar “iP” app icon
TRACK WHAT MATTERS TO YOU
Record periods and flow, fertility signs, ovulation information, physical and emotional symptoms, moods, basal body temperature, weight, sleep, activity, and personal notes.
Find symptoms quickly with the new search feature, customize your tracking, and explore patterns in your health history over time.
A BEAUTIFULLY REDESIGNED EXPERIENCE
Explore your cycle with an interactive ring, a clearer calendar, redesigned daily details, easier navigation, and smoother performance. Everything is designed to make tracking feel effortless.
PRIVACY YOU CAN TRUST
Your health information is your business.
• We never sell your private health data
• We never share your cycle or symptom history with advertisers or data brokers
• Your backed-up health information is encrypted
• Password protection helps keep your information secure
• You control when to export or share your health reports
Your health. Your history. Your choice.
SMART, DISCREET REMINDERS

CHARTS, REPORTS & APPLE HEALTH
Explore cycle patterns and past entries with charts and reports. Export PDF reports to review your history or bring to a healthcare appointment.

MAKE iPERIOD YOUR OWN

iPERIOD PREMIUM

• Ad-free experience
• Advanced, customizable charts
• Additional symptom and mood customization
• Unlimited PDF report exports
Choose a monthly or annual subscription. Eligible annual subscribers can try Premium free for 7 days. PDF export is also available as a separate one-time purchase.
Since creating iPeriod in 2008, we've remained an independent small business dedicated to thoughtful women's health tools and respecting your privacy. Your support helps us keep improving.

Cycle predictions and fertility estimates are informational only. iPeriod is not a contraceptive method or a substitute for professional medical advice.

bluejetty:00158204:ios.description:
Introducing the new M-PESA Safaricom App! Enjoy safe, easy, and convenient financial and communication services all in one app. Send money, pay merchants and bills, pay for fuel, buy airtime and bundles, check airtime usage, and withdraw money with just a few taps on your mobile phone. With the new and simplified user experience, you can manage your finances effortlessly. Plus, you can track your spends, and authenticate transactions with biometrics. Simplify your life and download the M-PESA Safaricom App today.
• M-PESA transactions - Access all core M-PESA transactions with a simplified experience - Send money, pay merchants, bills and fuel with M-PESA, withdraw at agent or ATM and buy airtime.
• Core Safaricom transactions - Manage your Safaricom account with ease. Check your airtime, voice and internet balances, check your consumption, top up, buy bundles, get PUK, and much more.
• Statement - Review, interact and action your M-PESA transactions, as well as filter, download and export your M-PESA statement in PDF form 
• Receipts - Download and share e-receipts for send money, pay with M-PESA, and withdraw to share transaction information with other users via pdf 
• My Spend - Allows you to track your M-PESA spend per month with aggregate and daily average spend, as well as a more detailed view with transactions broken down by category. You can change transaction categories to fit your lifestyle 
• Biometric Authentication - Log in and transact on the app using face or fingerprint authentication without having to enter M-PESA PIN manually every time 
• Frequents and Favorites - Get an automatically generated list of people or businesses you frequently send money to, or save them to your favorite's list so you don’t have to manually enter their details every time you want to make a payment 
• Profile picture - Take or upload your profile picture, other users will see it when transacting with you.

bluejetty:00185339:ios.description:
"هذه اللعبة لعبة متعددة اللاعبين على الإنترنت تجمع بعمق بين عناصر استراتيجية الحروب وخلفية الحروب الحديثة، مصممة خصيصًا للاعبين العرب الذين يعشقون التخطيط الاستراتيجي وتنافس المعارك. 
في هذه اللعبة، ستتقمص دور قائدة صقر العرب يشبه النسر يحلق عاليًا، وتجد نفسك في عالم افتراضي مليء بالنيران والدخان، تبني التحالفات مع أصدقائك المقربين وتتنافسون معًا للفوز بموارد الأراضي الثمينة.
【مميزات اللعبة بالتفصيل】
1. تجنيد وحدات النخبة: جمع وحدات ""أشباح"" النخبة الخاصة بك، واستخدم القنابل والمتفجرات بذكاء لترتيب الخطط والسيطرة على ساحة المعركة.
2. انشاء القاعدة القوية: ابدأ من الصفر في بناء قاعدتك العسكرية لتصبح حصناً منيعاً لا يمكن هزيمته داخل السيرفر.
3. تطوير الإمدادات العسكرية الحديثة: قم بصناعة قوات ميكانيكية ثقيلة مثل الدبابات والمدرعة بقيادة الضباط لترقية القوة.
4. المشاركة في صراع الحروب: انخرط في حروب نووية قارية مثيرة ومشحونة بالتوتر في اللعبة، وواجه خصومك بقوة.
5. إتقان ردع الأسلحة النووية: احتل المنشآت العسكرية الحيوية، واستخدم الأسلحة النووية للرد على أولئك الذين يجرؤون على تحديك.
6. توظيف الذكاء التكتيكي: استخدم التكتيكات الأكثر براعة وتدميرية للقضاء بشكل كامل على المعتدين القادمين.
7- إقتحام جانب العدو: قم بقيادة الهجوم على قواعد اللاعبين الآخرين وأسر قادتهم العسكريين بنجاح.
8- الاغتيال والعمليات المشتركة: قم بالداعم لحلفائك في التحالف للتخطيط معًا لعمليات اغتيال سرية ضد الأعداء لتفكيك قوى العدو.
ستقود جيشك نحو العزة وتكتب فصلاً أسطوريًا خاصًا في تاريخ الحروب الحديثة في هذه المغامرة المليئة بالدخان ونيران الحروب!"
 لمزيد من المعلومات الإستخباراتية
invasionarb@menamobile.net

سعر الإشتراك الشهري الإختياري المتجدد تلقائيا 9.99$ ومدة الإشتراك هي 30 يوما و سيتمتع المشتركون بالتعزيزات و الميزات التالية بعد الإشتراك:
1-زيادة سرعة تجميع الموارد +10%
2-زيادة سرعة إنتاج الوحدات +10%
3-زيادة حمولة الوحدات +10%
4-زيادة سرعة الإنشاء +10%
ملاحظة:
1-سيتم إقتطاع مبلغ الإشتراك الشهري الموضح من رصيد حسابك في متجر ابل بعد تأكيد الإشتراك.
2-الإشتراك الشهري سيتم تجديده تلقائيا في حسابك إلإ إن قمت بايقاف خدمة الإشتراك الشهري 24 ساعة على الأقل قبل نهاية فترة الإشتراك الحالي.
3-ستستلم تنبيها و تأكيدا في حسابك بخصوص الإشتراك الشهري التالي 24 ساعة قبل إنتهاء فترة و خدمات الإشتراك الشهري الحالي.
4-بإمكانك إغلاق خدمة الإشتراك الشهري في إعدادات جهازك بعد إتمامك لعملية الإشتراك الشهري.
5-لا يمكنك إلغاء الإشتراك الحالي بعد قيامك بتفعيله وإلى حين إنتهاء فترة صلاحيته.

bluejetty:00122066:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00122066:ios.description:
Your princess is locked up in the last room of an intricate dungeon, guarded by a dragon.
The keys to open the doors, are split in 16 parts.
The only way to get these parts is solving a card game with magic cards.
Let the adventure begin!
The card game consists in clearing the board by taking a card that is one above or below than the card on the deck.
Among the 80 levels available to play (Full version has 160), you would find several missions such as:
- Have a sequence of X number of cards.
- Obtain X points.
- Find the card-key to open the lock.
- Solve the game in X amount of time.
- Get a golden card by having a sequence of 5 cards.
- Solve 2 rounds of the game.
From level 6 you would have available a wild card, that you would be able to use any time replacing the card that you need. It's very useful for building long sequences.
Each card taken off from the board has a value of 100 points, and if it follows a sequence then its value would have 50 bonus points. This means that the longer the sequence is then more points you get.
No in-app purchases!

bluejetty:00161354:ios.summary:

↳ Step into the exciting worl
bluejetty:00161354:ios.description:
Carnivals are all about coming together, celebrating, and indulging in delicious food. And now, you can experience the excitement of cooking up a storm at a festival with our new cooking game, Yummy Carnival.
↳ Step into the exciting world of cooking with Yummy Carnival - Lucy's Cooking Adventure! Lucy, a talented chef who grew up in a family of famous pastry shop owners, is facing a difficult situation in her life. After her marriage falls apart, she decided to leave empty-handed with her little daughter. Lucy and her daughter Kelly move to a new city in search of a fresh start.
But things start to turn around when Lucy discovers that the city is holding a cooking festival in its largest park. With her culinary talents and passion for cooking, Lucy decides to participate in the festival and make a name for herself in the culinary world.
► As you play the game, you'll get to help Lucy create delicious dishes using simple ingredients and her unique cooking style. You'll have to satisfy the taste buds of hungry customers from all over the world, who will be looking for different types of cuisine, from Italian to Japanese to Mexican and more.
The game is simple to play: you'll start by selecting your ingredients and cooking tools, and then it's time to get to work! Use your culinary skills to chop, mix, and sauté your way to delicious dishes that will leave your customers begging for more. But be careful, you'll need to work fast and keep up with the orders, or your customers will get impatient and leave!
As you progress through the game, you'll unlock new recipes, ingredients, and cooking tools, giving you even more options to create the perfect dishes. You'll also have the opportunity to upgrade your kitchen and customize your restaurant or food truck to make it truly your own.
But the real challenge comes from satisfying your customers' unique tastes and preferences. Some customers will want healthy meals, while others will crave something spicy or indulgent. You'll need to pay attention to their requests and create dishes that will make them happy, or risk losing their business.
◈ As you grow your restaurant or food truck business, you'll face tougher challenges and competition from other chefs. But with dedication, hard work, and a passion for food, you can rise to the top and become the ultimate Yummy Carnival chef!
So, are you ready to join Lucy on her exciting cooking adventure and become the top chef of the town? Download Yummy Carnival today and start cooking!

bluejetty:00149243:ios.description:
Redesign your home effortlessly with the power of AI!
Your personal interior design expert is now at your fingertips. With just a photo, transform any space—inside or out—in seconds, preview it in your real room with AR, and even shop the look with Furniture Search.
Snap or upload a picture, choose a style you love, and instantly receive AI-generated designs with incredible precision and detail. Homeowner, renter, or realtor—Interior AI is your go-to design companion.
【Design Any Space】
► Instant Room Transformation — photograph any room and get beautiful, tailor-made design concepts in seconds.
► Exterior & Garden Redesign — reimagine facades, patios, and gardens, not just indoors.
► Floor Plan Design — upload a 2D floor plan and instantly get a fully furnished, styled layout viewed from above.
► Virtual Staging — upload an empty room and let AI furnish and style it from scratch. Perfect for realtors.
► Create Your Space — start from a blank canvas and generate a fully designed room from your imagination.
► Change Walls & Floors — instantly repaint walls or swap flooring to test new colors, materials, and finishes.
► Replace Furniture & Objects — select any item, describe what you want, and swap it with AI.
► Furniture Search (Shop the Look) — tap an item to find similar products from popular stores with direct links.
► Refine Every Detail — magic recolor, style transfer, remove objects, upscale, and clean up backgrounds.
► A Variety of Design Styles — from modern chic to soothing zen, find the look that speaks to you.
【See It in 3D and in Your Space】
► 3D Floor Plans — turn your home into an explorable 3D layout you can view from every angle.
► AR Preview — place furniture and visualize new floors and walls in your real room before you commit.
► 3D & LiDAR Scanning — scan rooms, spaces, and objects in 3D for true-to-life results.
► Free Measuring Tools — a built-in level, screen ruler, and wall guide, always free.
【Your AI Designer, On Demand】
► Chat with Your AI Designer for advice, style recommendations, and ideas in a natural conversation.
【Designed Around Your Trust】
Your privacy comes first at every step—Interior AI is built to keep your home and your data safe.
► Secure by Design — your photos and designs are kept on protected, secure infrastructure.
► You're in Control — your designs are yours, and we respect your data privacy at every step.
► Trusted Worldwide — used by homeowners, renters, and design enthusiasts around the globe.
► Clear & Honest — we're transparent about the data we use and keep collection to what the app needs.
Save & share your favorite concepts, gather feedback, and find endless inspiration—from a small refresh to a full renovation.
Download Interior AI today and create the home you've always dreamed of, all with the power of advanced AI.

bluejetty:00177183:ios.summary:

Understanding counting, numbers, and mathematics are extremely important for children. From their toddler and p
bluejetty:00177183:ios.description:
Help your kids learn math and numbers the right way with this collection of fun math games and Montessori style learning tools!
Understanding counting, numbers, and mathematics are extremely important for children. From their toddler and preschool years until they’re in 1st and, 2nd grade. Kids need to pick up all sorts of math skills. It starts with learning numbers and understanding basic counting, then moves on to ascending and descending numbers, comparing numbers, and so on. There’s a lot to learn in these formative years, so anything parents can do to help supplement their child’s education is helpful!
Kids love learning by doing, which can be difficult with numbers and mathematics. That’s where our fun Montessori and math learning games come into play. We’ve created a series of colorful counting and comparing games that are perfect for children of all ages. They’re designed to make learning easy, successful, and fun. But best of all, these games are FREE to enjoy!
Our learn to count and montessori game includes the following modes:
Math with Beads
Kids can learn counting and math skills using the time-tested beads method. Choose between various math exercises for kids, then watch how quickly your child learns! Games in this mode include counting exercises, learning place values (ones, tens, hundreds), and simple math operations like adding and subtracting.
Learning Numbers
Help your child learn to count numbers through simple but fun matching and number-arranging exercises. Choose a number range to focus on to help facilitate learning for different ages -- smaller is best for younger kids!
Learning math Montessori style has never been so easy and fun, especially not for toddlers, kids, preschoolers and grade school children. When it’s time to learn counting, number arranging, and comparing, this app will get your family started the right way. Kids love these fun and colorful games, and parents will love all of the extra features.
• Clean and clear interface designed for children
• Learn with colorful and friendly cartoon characters
• Monitor your child’s progress with report cards
• Unlock special stickers, certificates, and other bonuses
• No third party ads, no in-app purchases
Start your child’s education right with these fun, free, and effective Montessori math and counting games. It’s easy to get started, and the whole family will find something to enjoy! Download this educational game today and start learning right away.

bluejetty:00084588:ios.description:
每日冥想是一款正念冥想、睡眠、身心放松、专注力、情绪管理的健康应用。
在每日冥想中，我们根据你的选择与行为来为个人制定出专业的冥想计划，并提供正念冥想指导、睡眠助眠引导和音乐、以及睡眠闹铃、自由练习、呼吸练习等各类工具帮助你练习，有海量引导音乐和音频供你随时随地的进行学习，帮助你从快节奏的工作和生活中锻炼大脑，进入一个平静和安宁的良好状态，平衡你的焦虑与压力，保持专注平静、放松情绪、睡眠质量管理。
#适合的人群#：
1，精神压力大和焦虑的人。
2，有心理健康问题的人。
3，工作和学习压力大的人。
4，有睡眠问题的人(失眠者、睡眠质量差、多梦)。
5，寻求身心平衡的人。
6，专注力不集中的人。
7，追求内在探索的人。
无论是哪个人群，冥想都可以为他们带来益处。
然而，对于有严重心理健康问题的人，建议在专业指导下进行冥想练习。冥想可以成为促进整体健康和福祉的工具，但它并不能够代替专业医疗治疗。
目前冥想服务包括：
1，定制个人冥想练习计划，遇见美好的自己。
- 睡眠质量管理：通过冥想引导，呼吸练习，睡眠音乐等定制化方案与练习工具来管理失眠、睡眠质量不佳等问题。
- 压力焦虑管理：通过有效的冥想注入平静、安宁和平衡感，对情绪健康和整体健康都有益。
- 专注力管理：通过有效的正念冥想训练大脑专注力，平衡进入专注状态的时间，保持专注的时间，以来应对外界干扰。
2，失眠、睡眠质量不佳，每日冥想提供平衡音频。
- 睡眠引导：由我们录制睡前引导、睡眠冥想、调节失眠问题、睡眠质量管理，让您享受更深度的睡眠。
- 大自然声：白噪音、大自然声让你拥抱大自然，场景有：小溪、篝火、森林、鸟语、瀑布、动物、下雨天、雷雨、风吹等。
- 睡眠工具：专业的睡眠工具，让您享受睡眠引导、大自然声、白噪音的同时，可以被轻唤醒音乐轻柔的过渡。
3，冥想工具，冥想提醒，帮助您坚持冥想，给于鼓励、挑战自我。
- 冥想挑战赛：挑战自己，培养良好习惯。
- 官方推荐：晨间、午休、睡前、专业推荐冥想，每天都有不一样的冥想，帮助调节自我。
- 自由练习工具：让您随时可以自定义符合自己节奏的冥想练习，冥想由你掌控。
- 呼吸练习：多种呼吸练习方式帮助您调整呼吸节奏，平复情绪，放松身心。
* 每日冥想已接入HealthKit，支持将冥想数据同步至健康应用（打开每日冥想App中“我的-设置-Apple Health”开关，并同意每日冥想写入数据即可）。
* 支持桌面小组件，锁屏小组件。

-续费：苹果iTunes账户会在到期前24小时内扣费，扣费成功后订阅周期顺眼一个订阅周期。
* 单次会员购买服务说明：

bluejetty:00158400:ios.description:
Untangle holds your hand through all the emotional and logistical challenges that come after a bereavement, making it easier to rebuild your life.
*How Untangle can help you*
- Feel less overwhelmed
- Feel less alone after your bereavement
- A forum to be honest about how you’re feeling
- Meet like-minded people who understand your grief
- Discover why you feel so tired, teary, heavy, achey, etc.
- Realise that what your feeling is normal
- Find out what you need to do after someone dies
- Get answers to questions about all the confusing death admin
- Understand grief
- Learn to live and cope with your grief
*What we offer*
MEET LOCAL PEOPLE LIKE YOU
Connect with people who share a similar loss experience to you. Browse our member directory and connect via moderated groups, one-on-one chats, or our weekly events.
SUPPORT GROUPS TO SHARE STORIES
Join support groups and realise that everything you’re going through is normal. Send messages any time of day or night, there’s always someone to listen. Share stories in our live weekly video and audio calls - they’re like peer therapy.
PRIVATE CHAT HELPLINE
Get help from real humans anytime through our private chat helpline. Our team is like your companion, always on-hand to talk if you feel low, or assist you with everything from registering the death to applying for time off work.
GET EXPERT ADVICE
Every week we host live video events with bereavement experts, so you can learn about grief and ask questions. There’s also a library of articles and videos to help you with every step of the way, from the first weeks to ten year anniversary.
SAFE MODERATED COMMUNITY
Your safety is really important so we moderate the community. Grief can make you feel like everything is pointless or you don’t want to be here anymore. Whilst we’re not a crisis service, we do have a specially trained team to spot and support people who are feeling very low.
SELECTED SERVICES FOR YOU
Whatever you need help with, our team can match you to the right expert to help. We work with carefully selected partners such as funeral directors, account/asset locators, therapists, solicitors, house removers, financial advisors. This is a paid-for service, and how we are able to offer everything else for free.

bluejetty:00187906:ios.description:
Now, you can transform your smartphone into a mini pocket scanner and enjoy the high quality images in your device within just one touch with the best ever mobile scanning app “Clear Scanner Pro: Fast PDF Scans”. Clear Scanner allows you to quickly scan any kind of documents in your office, images, bills, receipts, books, magazines, class notes and anything that needs to be there in your device within no time. This is the fastest means to get the scanned document in the highest quality and convert it immediately into PDF or JPEG format so that you can share the scanned document, image, books, bills, important notes or any type of paper that you can think of.
“Clear Scanner” is a must-have for every person be it a school student, college student, business person or any other person. The app lets you scan your photographs and documents in high quality which makes it easy for the person to read the texts present. The app automatically detects the corner of the file that you want to scan for better quality, and you can also crop the part of the document that you want to scan. This feature is really cool and gives the liberty of choice to the user. Apart from this, there are many auto correcting features that the app provides like adjusting the brightness, removing shadows and straightening the image for the better and higher quality result.
Get the faster processing speed for scanning your document with Clear Scanner and share the files immediately over mail, Dropbox, OneDrive, SkyDrive, Google Drive, Evernote and other to enjoy the joy of scanning. Clear Scanner allows the user to convert the scanned document to JPEG format or PDF format. You can even print the scanned document or image over Cloud Print. The app also offers various professional editing features even after saving the images along with various multiple filters. You can also save the image using an appropriate name and reorder the scanned files that makes it easier for the user to find the file, document, image, or other scanned notes. You can choose to email a specific document or an entire folder with faster processing speed.
***********************
APP FEATURES
***********************
+ Automatic document edge detection and perspective correction
+ Extremely fast processing
+ Professional quality results with multiple filter options: photo, document, clear, color or black & white
+ Flexible editing, allowing to edit file after save
+ Folders and subfolders, You can easily manage your files and folders, in order to organize your documents better.
+ Document naming, storage inside the app and search
+ Adding or deleting one page or the entire document
+ Page reordering after adding or deleting
+ Set page sizes for PDF (Letter, Legal, A4, and more)

EASY & RELAXING MATCH 3 GAME
Relax & Calm yourself with this easy & relaxing matching game. Solve easy match three puzzles to progress on your zen journey.
HUNDREDS OF CHALLENGING PUZZLE LEVELS
Swap and MATCH three or more similar items to blast your way through hundreds of easy match 3 levels. Play Relaxing Match 3, Zen Matching Puzzle game for free and beat challenging yet rewarding & calming levels. New levels are added every week so you keep on moving forward on your zen journey.
AWESOME BOOSTERS & POWER UPS
Match 4 or more items to obtain free BOOSTERS. Make various combinations for different kind of boosters & power ups. Score high with multiple boosters. Use the Power ups to LEVEL UP faster. Play Relaxing Match 3 game with one of 5+ available Boosters, each with its own strategy and effect.

Participate in calming events to win free REWARDS. Solve zen puzzle games with your match 3 solving skills and stay on TOP of ‘Relaxing Match 3’ leaderboard by collecting maximum stars.

apple-macos:489417480.name: More Fun With Directions
apple-macos:489417480.description:
If you liked our “Fun with Directions” app, you’ll also love our More Fun with Directions too! Developed by a speech-language pathologist, Patti Hamaguchi, M.A., CCC-SLP, this app continues with the same playful, colorful and engaging format with a focus on 12 concepts: turn on/turn off; up/down, front/behind, on/under, put in/take out, above/below. This is a great speech-language therapy app for early language learners or children new to the English language! The uncluttered background is also perfect for autistic children so they can focus better and have multiple repetitions of a concept.
Help the monkey go up the tree, but watch out! He likes to throw those coconuts! Pop the bubble that is above the bird. Put the elephant under the larger table. Help the squirrel go down the tree. Turn off the red radio. Want more advanced directions? You got it! 
More Fun with Directions is designed to provide a fun and engaging way to practice listening, following directions, colors, comparatives (larger/smaller) spatial concepts, auditory memory and auditory processing. From the simplest of directions (“Turn on the lamp”) to the more complex (“Do you see a musical instrument with black and white keys? Put it behind the couch”) your child can grow and learn with this game over time. Colorful, vivid art and animations against a white background combine to create a complete game experience without visual clutter. Sound effects and surprises keep the game engaging! This app is a great choice for a toddler/preschooler, or any young child who would like to practice listening to or reading directions!
Features include settings for text on/off, (to practice reading vs. listening) selecting specific concepts, replaying missed items and selecting the desired level of play: easy, intermediate or advanced.
An added bonus that is included in this app is the optional “Superstar Direction” which allows additional practice for remembering (“What did you have to do?”) but also expressive language. The child’s response is recorded and played back. Superstar Directions are surprise questions that pop up at random times, but can easily be turned off if desired.
PRIVACY POLICY: We do NOT collect personal data from our users and have no ads. Personal data regarding user performance on the tasks on this app are self-contained and not transmitted in any way. There are no in-app purchases in this app. There is a link to our other apps in the iTunes store which requires an internet connection if viewing is desired, but we have a parent gate in place to restrict internet access.
*Please contact our tech support if you are experiencing any technical issues with our apps. We will always help you troubleshoot it and get back to you generally within one business day. We cannot respond to reviews and there are generally easy solutions to every issue. info@hamaguchiapps.com
Hamaguchi Apps is dedicated to the mission of bringing high-quality apps to the general public and professionals for affordable prices.
Developed by Patti Hamaguchi, M.A., CCC-SLP, a noted speech-language pathologist and author of Childhood Speech, Language & Listening Problems: What Every Parent Should Know, as well as books on the treatment of auditory processing disorders, a co-author of the RESCA-E test, TAPS-4, ELCI and RESCA-ELD.
To find out more about this app and our other upcoming projects, visit our website: www.hamaguchiapps.com

firefox-addons:3131652.name: Battery Gauge: Battery Level Indicator Theme
firefox-addons:3131652.summary: Turns the Firefox tab strip into a battery gauge: it fills to your charge level, shifts from green to amber to red as it drains, and turns blue while charging. Needs a small helper script, because Firefox can't read the battery itself.
firefox-addons:3131652.description:
Battery Theme turns the browser itself into a battery indicator, so you notice a low battery without looking for it.
A gauge you can't miss. The tab strip fills up to your charge level with a bright leading edge, a thin ten-cell meter line runs along the top of the window, and the active tab is a solid card in the battery colour.
Louder as it drains. The colour shifts from green through amber to red, spreading to the active tab and then the toolbar. At 10% the whole top of the browser is red.
A nudge at 20% and 10%. The top of the browser flashes once as the battery drops through each.
Prefer it quieter? Pick "Quiet until low" for a tint that stays almost neutral until the battery gets low, and turn the flash off.
Blue while charging, so plugged in never looks the same as full.
Light and dark. Pick one, or let it follow the system setting, on any operating system.
Vertical tabs and right-to-left. With vertical tabs the gauge sits in the top bar; in right-to-left Firefox it fills from the right.
Pause any time. One switch hands the browser theme back to you while the button keeps showing the battery.
Colour-blind-safe option. A neutral-to-orange palette that doesn't rely on telling red from green.
Toolbar button. Shows the exact percentage, time remaining and the settings.
This add-on needs a helper. Firefox does not let extensions read the battery, so Battery Theme uses a small open-source shell script on your computer that reads the battery level and passes it to the extension. Without it the add-on does nothing except show you how to install it. Setup takes one terminal command, shown on a setup page the first time you run the add-on:
 https://github.com/william-ricchiuti/battery-theme#install 
macOS is fully supported. Linux is supported, including Flatpak Firefox (Snap Firefox is untested). Windows support is experimental.
Privacy. Battery Theme collects nothing and makes no network connections. The helper only reads the battery state, the light/dark setting and the low-power setting from your operating system.
When the helper isn't connected, or the computer has no battery, Battery Theme leaves your own Firefox theme alone.

apple-macos:6832707487.name: Kinboard: Family Calendar
apple-macos:6832707487.description:
Kinboard is a family calendar that works like the cork board in your kitchen. You write it down and it's on the board for everyone to see.
Who it's for
Kinboard is made for young families whose weekly schedules never stop changing. When your kids are little, something new comes up almost every week: a new routine, a new stage, or a new school with its own pile of emails. The last thing a busy family needs is to learn how a fully loaded smart calendar works.
If you have a kid or two and want something low maintenance that you'll actually keep using, Kinboard is a good fit.
What it looks like
Most calendar apps look like work. Kinboard is meant to look like something you'd hang up at home, with cream paper, colored symbols, notes that look handwritten, and push pins on cork.
How it works
• Write it the way you'd say it, like "Leo's haircut sat 10am".
• Everyone in the family gets their own colored symbol, so you can see at a glance who has what this week.
• Pin the dates you can't forget above the week. You can leave each other notes up there too, like "Good luck on your big meeting today!" or "Dinner's on me tonight." They're the best part.
• Paste in the weekly school newsletter and Kinboard pulls out the dates. It finds them with simple built-in rules, not AI.
• Send the other parent a one-time code and they're on the board with you. When one of you writes something down, the other sees it. You can add the kids yourself, each with their own colored symbol.
• Add the Kinboard widget to see today's plans and your pinned notes right on your home screen.
A few other things
• A week view for what's coming up and a month view for the big picture
• Sign in with Apple to save your board and bring it back on any iPhone or iPad. Kinboard never sees your name or email.
• Light and dark mode
• Small sounds, like a page turning or a pin dropping into cork, which you can turn off anytime
One plan for the whole family
Every board starts with a 14-day free trial. After that, one subscription, monthly or yearly, covers everyone on the board.
Payment is charged to your Apple ID when you confirm your purchase. Your subscription renews automatically unless you cancel it at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage or cancel it anytime in your Apple account settings.
Terms of Use: https://kinboard.family/terms
Privacy Policy: https://kinboard.family/privacy
